    AI Scientists for Building Virtual-Cell Models

    用于构建虚拟细胞模型的 AI 科学家

    Xiangru Tang, Jiapeng Chen, Daniel Shao, Zhuoyun Yu, Yan Cui, Weixu Wang, Fang Wu, Yuchen Zhuang, Wenqi Shi, Zhi Huang, Arman Cohan, Xihong Lin, Fabian Theis, Smita Krishnaswamy, Mark Gerstein

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CellForge’s main contribution is a team of agents that uses tools and specialized roles to formulate, implement, and validate model hypotheses, a substantial advance in agent-system organization. Its hypothesis formation and validation involve problem solving, but the abstract’s main evidence concerns an applied scientific workflow rather than reasoning mechanisms or capability development.

    CellForge 的主要贡献是一个智能体团队，它利用工具和专门分工来提出、实现并验证模型假设，显著推进了智能体系统的组织方式。其假设形成与验证过程涉及问题求解，但摘要中的主要证据关注的是应用型科学工作流，而非推理机制或能力发展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Autonomous agents, from virtual laboratories to biological data-analysis agents and co-scientists, have begun to turn scientific goals into hypotheses. Whether they can go further and convert real, noisy and complex biological data into executable model hypotheses and architectures that encode testable assumptions remains unclear. Predicting how cells respond to genetic and chemical perturbations is a natural test of this ability: it is central to decoding disease mechanisms and therapeutic discovery, yet it demands cross-disciplinary expertise rarely concentrated in a single research group. Here, we introduce CellForge, an organized team of autonomous agents for single-cell perturbation modeling. Given a dataset and a task, it surveys the literature, parses the data, identifies relevant baselines, and formulates a model hypothesis through critic-mediated discussion among agents specialized in data modeling, single-cell biology, and deep learning. It then writes the training code, runs the experiments, and returns a trained predictor including architecture, code, and validation results. The architecture itself is the hypothesis: CellForge produces it end-to-end, with no human specifying the design, loss, or training protocol. Across six perturbation datasets spanning transcriptomic, epigenomic, and proteomic contexts, CellForge yields models that are competitive with hand-crafted state-of-the-art results on established tasks and extends the same workflow to paired multi-omic readouts. Blinded human evaluators rate CellForge's research plans as more scientifically sound and innovative than those from single LLMs or deep-research systems. In summary, we show autonomous agents can complete the full hypothesis-to-validation cycle in single-cell biology, with an AI effectively building another AI, in a complex setting that currently requires a team of human experts.

    中文

    从虚拟实验室、生物数据分析智能体到协同科学家，自主智能体已开始将科学目标转化为假设。但它们能否更进一步，将真实、含噪且复杂的生物数据转化为可执行的模型假设和架构，并在其中编码可检验的假设条件，目前仍不清楚。预测细胞对遗传和化学扰动的响应，是检验这一能力的自然任务：它对解读疾病机制和发现疗法至关重要，却需要很少能集中于单一研究团队的跨学科专业知识。本文推出 CellForge，这是一个用于单细胞扰动建模的自主智能体团队。给定数据集和任务后，它会调研文献、解析数据、识别相关基线，并通过专攻数据建模、单细胞生物学和深度学习的智能体之间经由批评者引导的讨论，形成模型假设。随后，它编写训练代码、运行实验，并返回一个训练好的预测器，其中包括架构、代码和验证结果。架构本身就是假设：CellForge 端到端地生成架构，无需人类指定设计、损失函数或训练方案。在涵盖转录组、表观基因组和蛋白质组场景的六个扰动数据集上，CellForge 得出的模型在既有任务上达到与人工设计的最先进结果相当的水平，并将同一工作流扩展到配对多组学读出。盲测的人类评估者认为，CellForge 的研究计划在科学合理性和创新性方面优于单个 LLM 或深度研究系统生成的计划。总之，我们表明，自主智能体能够在单细胞生物学中完成从假设提出到验证的完整周期，由 AI 实际构建另一个 AI；这是一个复杂场景，目前需要由人类专家团队完成。

    Thinking-Free Policy Initialization Makes Distilled Reasoning Models More Effective and Efficient Reasoners

    免思考策略初始化让蒸馏推理模型成为更有效、更高效的推理者

    Xin Xu, Clive Bai, Kai Yang, Tianhao Chen, Yang Wang, Saiyong Yang, Can Yang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a training method that removes explicit thinking content during RLVR policy initialization and reports improved reasoning performance, convergence, and token efficiency on math and coding benchmarks. Reasoning training is central; lower token use is an efficiency benefit, but the abstract does not describe a substantive systems contribution.

    本文提出一种训练方法，在 RLVR 策略初始化期间移除显式思考内容，并报告了数学和编程基准上推理表现、收敛速度及 token 效率的提升。推理训练是核心内容；token 用量降低是效率方面的益处，但摘要没有描述实质性的系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) effectively solves complex tasks but demands extremely long context lengths during training, leading to substantial computational costs. While multi-stage training can partially mitigate this, starting with overly short contexts often causes irreversible performance degradation, ultimately failing to reduce overall training compute significantly. In this paper, we introduce Thinking-Free Policy Initialization (TFPI), a simple yet effective adaptation to RLVR that bridges long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) distillation and standard RLVR. TFPI employs a simple ThinkingFree operation, explicitly discarding the thinking content via a direct </think> append, to reduce token usage during inference. Training with ThinkingFree-adapted inputs improves performance and lowers token consumption, even in the original slow-thinking mode. Extensive experiments across various benchmarks have shown that TFPI accelerates RL convergence, achieves a higher performance ceiling, and yields more token-efficient reasoning models without specialized rewards or complex training designs. With TFPI only, we train a 4B model to reach 89.0% accuracy on AIME24 and 65.5% on LiveCodeBench using less than 4K H20 hours.

    中文

    带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）能够有效解决复杂任务，但在训练期间需要极长的上下文长度，导致计算成本高昂。多阶段训练虽能部分缓解这一问题，但若一开始采用过短的上下文，往往会造成不可逆的性能退化，最终无法显著降低整体训练计算量。本文提出免思考策略初始化（TFPI），这是一种简单而有效的 RLVR 改造方法，衔接了长链式思维（CoT）蒸馏与标准 RLVR。TFPI 使用简单的 ThinkingFree 操作，通过直接追加 </think> 明确丢弃思考内容，从而减少推理时的 token 用量。使用经 ThinkingFree 调整的输入进行训练，既能提升性能，也能降低 token 消耗，即使在原有的慢思考模式下也是如此。在多个基准上的广泛实验表明，TFPI 能加快 RL 收敛、提高性能上限，并在无需专用奖励或复杂训练设计的情况下，得到 token 效率更高的推理模型。仅使用 TFPI，我们就训练出一个 4B 模型，在 AIME24 上达到 89.0% 的准确率，在 LiveCodeBench 上达到 65.5% 的准确率，训练耗时不足 4K H20 小时。

    AlignSAE: Concept-Aligned Sparse Autoencoders

    AlignSAE：概念对齐的稀疏自编码器

    Minglai Yang, Xinyu Guo, Zhengliang Shi, Jinhe Bi, Steven Bethard, Mihai Surdeanu, Liangming Pan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    AlignSAE directly advances mechanistic interpretability by aligning SAE latents with concepts and demonstrating causal interventions and representation disentanglement. Its structured concept binding supports compositional reasoning and probes generalization dynamics; the model-control interface is only an incidental systems connection.

    AlignSAE 通过将 SAE 潜变量与概念对齐，并展示因果干预和表示解缠，直接推进了机制可解释性研究。其结构化概念绑定支持组合推理并探测泛化动态；模型控制接口只是附带的系统层面关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Models (LLMs) encode factual knowledge within hidden parametric spaces that are difficult to inspect or control. While Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) can decompose hidden activations into more fine-grained, interpretable features, they often struggle to reliably align these features with human-defined concepts, resulting in entangled and distributed feature representations. To address this, we introduce AlignSAE, a method that aligns SAE features with a predefined ontology through a "pre-train, then post-train" curriculum. After an initial unsupervised training phase, we apply supervised post-training to bind specific concepts to dedicated latent slots while preserving the remaining capacity for general reconstruction. This separation creates an interpretable interface where specific concepts can be inspected and controlled without interference from unrelated features. Empirical results on GPT-2 across synthetic biographical QA (1-hop, 6 concepts) and compositional relational reasoning (2-hop, 20 concepts) demonstrate that AlignSAE enables precise causal interventions, such as reliable concept swaps (94.8% success in 1-hop), by targeting single, semantically aligned slots. AlignSAE achieves disentanglement improvements of $9$--$\infty\times$ over standard SAEs (measured via Mutual Information Gap), and further supports multi-hop reasoning and a mechanistic probe of grokking-like generalization dynamics. Although our evaluation focuses on GPT-2, AlignSAE itself is model-agnostic.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）在难以检查或控制的隐藏参数空间中编码事实知识。稀疏自编码器（SAE）能够将隐藏激活分解为更细粒度、可解释的特征，但往往难以使这些特征与人类定义的概念可靠对齐，因而产生纠缠且分布式的特征表示。为此，我们提出 AlignSAE，这是一种通过“先预训练，再后训练”的课程，将 SAE 特征与预定义本体对齐的方法。在初始无监督训练阶段之后，我们进行有监督的后训练，将特定概念绑定到专用潜在槽位，同时保留其余容量用于一般重建。这种分离创建了一个可解释的接口，使得能够检查和控制特定概念，而不受无关特征干扰。在 GPT-2 上针对合成传记问答（1 跳，6 个概念）和组合关系推理（2 跳，20 个概念）的实证结果表明，AlignSAE 能够通过针对单个语义对齐的槽位实现精确的因果干预，例如可靠的概念互换（1 跳任务中成功率为 94.8%）。与标准 SAE 相比，AlignSAE 将解缠效果提升了 $9$--$\infty\times$（通过互信息差距衡量），并进一步支持多跳推理以及对类顿悟式泛化动态的机制性探测。尽管我们的评估聚焦于 GPT-2，AlignSAE 本身与模型无关。

    Mitigating Memorization Where It Happens

    在记忆发生之处缓解记忆复现

    Xuanqi Zhang, Haoyang Shang, Xiaoxiao Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper localizes activations associated with memorized sequences and derives targeted probe-and-steer corrections, with GSS based on gradient-weighted activation geometry. This directly advances mechanistic analysis and intervention on internal representations; its steering mechanism is not a broader systems contribution.

    本文定位了与记忆序列相关的激活，并推导出定向探测与转向校正方法，其中 GSS 基于梯度加权激活的几何结构。这直接推动了对内部表示的机制分析与干预；其转向机制并非更广泛的系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) can memorize and reproduce training sequences verbatim, raising privacy and copyright concerns. Existing mitigation methods apply interventions uniformly, often degrading performance on the majority of tokens that generalize normally. We study a token-level log-likelihood ratio between a target model and a domain-competent reference with lower exposure to the evaluated sequences. Exposure-controlled experiments support its use for localizing positions associated with sequence-level verbatim recall. Across evaluated settings, a minority of positions carries a disproportionate share of the positive signal, motivating selective activation correction. From the ideal memorization reduction objective, we derive a probe--steer framework which decomposes intervention into a probe that detects memorization-relevant activations and a steer that applies targeted correction only when the probe exceeds a threshold. We propose Gated Subspace Steering (GSS) as its practical instantiation: the optimal probe--steer pair admits a closed-form solution as the leading singular vectors of a gradient-weighted activation matrix. Across four benchmarks, GSS matches or exceeds state-of-the-art memorization reduction while requiring 10--100$\times$ less compute than optimization-based alternatives.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）可能会记忆并逐字复现训练序列，引发隐私和版权方面的担忧。现有缓解方法通常统一施加干预，往往会降低大多数能够正常泛化的词元上的性能。我们研究目标模型与一个领域能力强、但接触待评估序列较少的参考模型之间的词元级对数似然比。控制暴露程度的实验支持使用该比率定位与序列级逐字回忆相关的位置。在所评估的各种设置中，少数位置承载了不成比例的正向信号，这促使我们采用选择性激活校正。我们从理想的记忆降低目标出发，推导出探测—转向框架，将干预分解为两个部分：一个探测器，用于检测与记忆相关的激活；一个转向器，仅在探测器分数超过阈值时施加定向校正。我们提出门控子空间转向（GSS）作为该框架的实际实现：最优的探测器—转向器组合可由梯度加权激活矩阵的主导奇异向量以闭式解得出。在四个基准测试中，GSS 的记忆缓解效果达到或超过当前最先进水平，所需计算量比基于优化的方法少 10–100 倍。$\times$少的计算量。

    BRIDGE: Bridging Reasoning In Distillation Gap Elimination via Structure-Aware Masking

    BRIDGE：通过结构感知掩码弥合推理蒸馏差距

    Bowen Yu, Sheng Zhang, Binhao Wang, Yi Wen, Jingtong Gao, Bowen Liu, Zimo Zhao, Shanshan Ye, Wanyu Wang, Maolin Wang, Xiangyu Zhao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    BRIDGE trains smaller models to produce shorter, structurally coherent chain-of-thought through masked reconstruction, reinforcement learning, and teacher-guided rewriting, improving math accuracy and transfer. Its central contribution directly advances reasoning training; structural composition is relevant but secondary, and interpretability is discussed as a tradeoff rather than studied.

    BRIDGE 通过掩码重建、强化学习和教师引导的改写，训练较小模型生成更简洁且结构连贯的思维链，从而提升数学准确率和迁移能力。其核心贡献直接推动了推理训练；结构组合虽相关但居于次要地位，可解释性在文中作为权衡因素讨论，并未作为研究对象。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has significantly improved LLMs' mathematical problem-solving capabilities, but distilling such capabilities into smaller models remains challenging due to the capacity mismatch between verbose teachers and compact students. Directly copying teachers' lengthy reasoning chains causes capacity overload, resulting in truncated outputs or repetitive failure. Existing remedies each sacrifice a critical property of CoT: implicit reasoning methods (e.g., compressing reasoning into hidden states) trade away interpretability and verifiability, while heuristic compression strategies (e.g., random step pruning) destroy logical integrity. To address this, we propose BRIDGE, a curriculum framework that first establishes structural understanding via masked reconstruction, then uses GRPO-based reinforcement learning to guide students in self-discovering the optimal balance between accuracy and brevity, and finally internalizes complex reasoning through teacher-guided rewriting on failure cases. On GSM8K, BRIDGE enables Qwen2.5-3B to achieve 11.29% accuracy improvement and 27.4% token reduction over the original model, outperforming instruction-tuned variants and distillation baselines. Zero-shot transfer experiments on SVAMP and MATH-500 further confirm the generalization of internalized reasoning. Our code and model checkpoints are publicly available at https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/SDM2026_BRIDGE and https://huggingface.co/bowen0815/BRIDGE.

    中文

    思维链（CoT）推理显著提升了 LLM 的数学问题解决能力，但由于冗长的教师模型与紧凑的学生模型之间存在容量差异，将这类能力蒸馏到较小模型中仍然困难。直接复制教师模型冗长的推理链会导致容量过载，造成输出截断或反复失败。现有补救方法各自牺牲了 CoT 的一项关键属性：隐式推理方法（例如将推理压缩进隐藏状态）牺牲了可解释性和可验证性；启发式压缩策略（例如随机剪除步骤）则破坏了逻辑完整性。为解决这一问题，我们提出 BRIDGE，这是一种课程学习框架：首先通过掩码重建建立结构理解，接着使用基于 GRPO 的强化学习，引导学生自行发现准确性与简洁性之间的最佳平衡，最后通过教师引导的失败案例改写，将复杂推理内化。在 GSM8K 上，BRIDGE 使 Qwen2.5-3B 相较于原始模型准确率提升 11.29%，词元数减少 27.4%，优于经过指令微调的变体和蒸馏基线。在 SVAMP 和 MATH-500 上进行的零样本迁移实验进一步证实，内化的推理具有泛化能力。我们的代码和模型检查点已公开发布，地址为 https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/SDM2026_BRIDGE 和 https://huggingface.co/bowen0815/BRIDGE。

    Generative Recursive Reasoning

    生成式递归推理

    Junyeob Baek, Mingyu Jo, Minsu Kim, Mengye Ren, Yoshua Bengio, Sungjin Ahn

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    GRAM’s main contribution is probabilistic latent recursive computation with parallel reasoning trajectories and inference-time scaling, evaluated on structured reasoning tasks. The abstract does not study internal representations or systematic composition, and the model-computation design gives Systems a partial connection.

    GRAM 的主要贡献是概率潜在递归计算，它通过并行推理轨迹和推理时扩展，在结构化推理任务上进行评估。摘要没有研究内部表征或系统组合，而模型计算设计与系统方向有一定关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    How should future neural reasoning systems implement extended computation? Recursive Reasoning Models (RRMs) offer a promising alternative to autoregressive sequence extension by performing iterative latent-state refinement with shared transition functions. Yet existing RRMs are largely deterministic, following a single latent trajectory and converging to a single prediction. We introduce Generative Recursive reAsoning Models (GRAM), a framework that turns recursive latent reasoning into probabilistic multi-trajectory computation. GRAM models reasoning as a stochastic latent trajectory, enabling multiple hypotheses, alternative solution strategies, and inference-time scaling through both recursive depth and parallel trajectory sampling. This yields a latent-variable generative model supporting conditional reasoning via $p_\theta(y \mid x)$ and, with fixed or absent inputs, unconditional generation via $p_\theta(x)$. Trained with amortized variational inference, GRAM improves over deterministic recurrent and recursive baselines on structured reasoning and multi-solution constraint satisfaction tasks, while demonstrating an unconditional generation capability. https://ahn-ml.github.io/gram-website

    中文

    未来的神经推理系统应如何实现扩展计算？递归推理模型（RRMs）通过使用共享转移函数迭代优化潜在状态，为自回归序列扩展提供了一种颇具前景的替代方案。然而，现有 RRMs 大多是确定性的，沿着单一潜在轨迹运行并收敛到单一预测。我们提出生成式递归推理模型（GRAM），这是一个将递归潜在推理转化为概率多轨迹计算的框架。GRAM 将推理建模为随机潜在轨迹，从而支持多个假设、不同的求解策略，以及通过递归深度和并行轨迹采样进行推理时扩展。由此得到的潜变量生成模型既支持通过 $p_\theta(y \mid x)$ 实现条件推理，也支持在输入固定或缺失时通过 $p_\theta(x)$ 实现无条件生成。GRAM 使用摊销变分推断进行训练，在结构化推理和多解约束满足任务上优于确定性循环和递归基线，同时展现了无条件生成能力。https://ahn-ml.github.io/gram-website

    PathCal: State-Aware Reflection-Marker Calibration for Efficient Reasoning

    PathCal：面向高效推理的状态感知反思标记校准

    Lingyu Jiang, Zirui Li, Lingyu Xu, Shuo Xing, Peiran Li, Tsubasa Takahashi, Dengzhe Hou, Zhengzhong Tu, Kazunori Yamada, Fangzhou Lin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PathCal studies how reflection-marker types and context affect reasoning, then uses a training-free logit controller to improve the accuracy–length tradeoff in reasoning tasks, a direct contribution to reasoning mechanisms. Its controller is a limited systems contribution; the abstract does not address internal representations or compositional generalization.

    PathCal 研究反思标记类型及其上下文对推理的影响，随后使用无需训练的 logit 控制器改善推理任务中的准确率—长度权衡，直接推进了推理机制。其控制器只构成有限的系统贡献；摘要未涉及内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Reasoning Language Models (LRMs) tackle complex tasks through test-time scaling, generating long-form Chain-of-Thought (CoT) trajectories during inference. These trajectories contain reflection markers such as wait, but, and alternatively, accompanying hesitation, revision, and alternative explorations. Recent test-time control methods use these markers to steer reasoning, but treating them as one coarse-grained category can obscure their distinct intervention effects. We study how marker identity and reasoning context shape these effects. Type-wise suppression produces different accuracy--length tradeoffs, while fixed-prefix interventions show that the relative benefit of continuation and revision varies across prefixes and tasks. Motivated by these findings, we introduce PathCal, a training-free controller that adjusts the strength of a fixed continuation bias using instantaneous competition among continuation, revision, and alternative-opening markers. It applies finite logit adjustments without additional model forward passes. An exact log-odds identity and frozen-prefix probes establish its local directional effect. Experiments show that PathCal improves the accuracy--length tradeoff in many mathematical reasoning settings and also reduces generation length in coding and multilingual mathematics.

    中文

    大型推理语言模型（LRM）通过测试时扩展处理复杂任务，在推理过程中生成长篇思维链（CoT）轨迹。这些轨迹包含诸如 wait、but 和 alternatively 等反思标记，伴随着犹豫、修订和替代方案探索。近期的测试时控制方法利用这些标记引导推理，但将它们视为一个粗粒度类别，可能会掩盖各自不同的干预效果。我们研究标记类型及推理上下文如何塑造这些效果。按类型抑制标记会产生不同的准确率—长度权衡，而固定前缀干预表明，继续生成与修订的相对收益会随前缀和任务而变化。基于这些发现，我们提出 PathCal，这是一种无需训练的控制器，它根据继续生成、修订和开启替代方案的标记之间的即时竞争，调整固定继续偏置的强度。它无需额外的模型前向传播，即可实施有限的 logit 调整。精确的对数几率恒等式和冻结前缀探测证实了其局部方向性效应。实验表明，PathCal 在许多数学推理设置中改善了准确率—长度权衡，也缩短了代码生成和多语言数学任务的生成长度。

    Symbolic Mechanistic Data Attribution: Tracing Training Influence to Learned Behavioral Policies

    符号化机制数据归因：追踪训练数据对习得行为策略的影响

    Reza Habibi, Darian Lee, Magy Seif El-Nasr

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SMDA uses SAE features to trace how individual fine-tuning examples alter symbolic behavioral policies, with feature-level mechanisms and cross-feature interference demonstrated for refusal behavior. Its training-data attribution is directly about model internals; the policy and safety applications do not establish compositional or reasoning contributions, and attribution alone is only an incidental connection to systems.

    SMDA 利用 SAE 特征追踪单个微调样本如何改变符号化行为策略，并针对拒答行为展示了特征级机制和跨特征干扰。其训练数据归因直接针对模型内部；策略和安全应用并未证明其对组合能力或推理作出贡献，而归因与系统的联系也仅属偶然。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    While existing data attribution methods can identify which training examples build specific mechanistic circuits, they cannot explain how training data shapes the behavioral decisions a model learns. We introduce Symbolic Mechanistic Data Attribution (SMDA), a framework that attributes training pairs to the interpretable symbolic policies governing model behavior. SMDA fits a closed-form Ridge regression over sparse autoencoder (SAE) features to model a behavior, then decomposes how each supervised fine-tuning (SFT) example shifts that policy through feature-activation ($\Delta X$) and output-probability ($\Delta Y$) pathways. We distill a symbolic policy for refusal in Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct and analyze 200 SFT pairs. Our analysis reveals (1)~the symbolic policy's coefficients expose systematic gaps in the base model's safety behavior, such as religious stereotyping; (2)~per-feature $\Delta X/\Delta Y$ decomposition mechanistically explains why harmful and harmless pairs exert qualitatively different influences on certain features; and (3)~individual pairs routinely exhibit cross-feature interference, allowing SMDA to identify pairs whose dominant effect falls on unintended features. Retraining without such pairs improved accuracy by up to 4.5 percentage points over full fine-tuning. These results show that combining mechanistic interpretability with data attribution yields a diagnostic tool both more fine-grained than black-box influence functions and more scalable than manual circuit analysis.

    中文

    虽然现有数据归因方法能够识别哪些训练样本构建了特定的机制电路，却无法解释训练数据如何塑造模型习得的行为决策。我们提出符号化机制数据归因（SMDA），这是一个将训练样本对支配模型行为的可解释符号策略进行归因的框架。SMDA 在稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征上拟合闭式 Ridge 回归来刻画一种行为，然后分解每个监督微调（SFT）样本如何通过特征激活（$\Delta X$）和输出概率（$\Delta Y$）路径改变该策略。我们为 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 提炼出一个拒答符号策略，并分析了 200 个 SFT 样本对。我们的分析发现：(1)~符号策略的系数揭示了基础模型安全行为中的系统性缺陷，例如宗教刻板印象；(2)~逐特征的$\Delta X/\Delta Y$分解从机制层面解释了为什么有害和无害样本对某些特征产生性质不同的影响；(3)~单个样本对经常会表现出跨特征干扰，使 SMDA 能够识别其主要影响落在非预期特征上的样本对。移除这类样本后重新训练，准确率相比完整微调最高提升 4.5 个百分点。这些结果表明，将机制可解释性与数据归因结合起来，可以得到一种诊断工具，其粒度比黑盒影响函数更细，且比人工电路分析更具可扩展性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The execution harness is a critical component of LLM agents, shaping how the agent interacts with its environment and organizes multi-step execution. Prior work has shown that improving tools, workflows, and other harness components can substantially improve agent performance. This suggests that the harness can be treated as a learnable control layer that adapts execution decisions from experience, rather than as a predetermined execution configuration. In this work, we introduce HarnessMDP, a learning-based framework that makes harness control itself learnable. HarnessMDP formulates agent execution as a finite-horizon Markov decision process, where the harness learns to select structural execution actions from the evolving agent state. The harness policy is learned offline from collected trajectories using task performance and deployed online to adaptively control new executions. Extensive experiments on coding tasks, $\tau$-bench, AgentBench, and other agent evaluation settings show that HarnessMDP consistently improves execution behavior and final task performance over baseline harnesses. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of HarnessMDP and establish learnable harness control as a practical mechanism for improving LLM agents through better execution. Our code is available at https://github.com/Hik289/Agentic-RL-harness.git.

    X-Alpha：通过记忆驱动自我进化的 AI 量化研究员

    Fengyuan Liu, Yuchen Fu, Yuqi Wang, Fengyuan Liu, Mukai Li, Qi Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    X-Alpha’s main contribution is a persistent-memory research agent that routes exploration, turns hypotheses into executable factors, and uses empirical outcomes to guide later cycles. This advances agent organization and memory use; iterative hypothesis refinement offers a partial connection to reasoning, while factor diversity alone does not establish compositional generalization.

    X-Alpha 的主要贡献是一个持久记忆研究智能体：它能够引导探索、将假设转化为可执行因子，并利用实证结果指导后续周期。这推进了智能体的组织方式和记忆使用；迭代式假设改进与推理有一定联系，而因子多样性本身并不能证明组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Human quantitative researchers mine alpha through an iterative process: they derive hypotheses from financial knowledge, implement and test them as factors, and use the resulting evidence to guide subsequent research. Yet automated alpha mining faces three key bottlenecks: noisy financial knowledge is not directly actionable, exploration can remain confined to similar mechanisms, and feedback may remain tied to individual mining runs. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce X-Alpha, an AI Quant Researcher that couples persistent research memory with continuous hypothesis-to-code discovery. Report-to-Memory Abstraction (RMA) uses a multi-layer filtering-and-abstraction process to convert financial reports into actionable, data-compatible research paths. Memory-driven routing uses accumulated experience to redirect exploration and define a targeted search space for each cycle. Within each cycle, hypotheses are implemented as executable factors and refined through empirical validation and code-based evolution. Empirical outcomes are consolidated into persistent research memory to guide subsequent exploration, enabling memory-driven self-evolution across cycles. We evaluate X-Alpha on five equity indices spanning mainland China, the United States, and Hong Kong, with comprehensive experiments centered on CSI300. Experiments show strong alpha discovery performance against baselines, with improvements in factor quality and signal diversity and consistent generation-level gains across multiple markets and prediction horizons.

    中文

    人类量化研究员通过迭代过程挖掘 alpha：他们从金融知识中提出假设，将其实现为因子并进行测试，再利用由此获得的证据指导后续研究。然而，自动化 alpha 挖掘面临三个关键瓶颈：含噪的金融知识无法直接付诸行动，探索可能局限于相似机制，而反馈可能仅与单次挖掘过程相关。为解决这些瓶颈，我们推出 X-Alpha，这是一名 AI 量化研究员，将持久化研究记忆与持续的假设到代码发现相结合。报告到记忆抽象（RMA）采用多层过滤与抽象流程，将金融报告转化为可执行且兼容数据的研究路径。记忆驱动的路由利用积累的经验重新引导探索，并为每个周期确定有针对性的搜索空间。在每个周期中，假设会被实现为可执行因子，并通过实证验证和基于代码的演化不断改进。实证结果会汇总到持久化研究记忆中，以指导后续探索，从而实现跨周期的记忆驱动自我进化。我们在涵盖中国大陆、美国和香港的五个股票指数上评估 X-Alpha，全面实验主要围绕 CSI300 展开。实验显示，X-Alpha 的 alpha 发现表现优于基线，在因子质量和信号多样性方面均有提升，并且在多个市场和预测时间范围内都持续取得了生成层面的增益。

    MasDrift: Benchmarking Authorization Preservation Across Multi-Agent Architectures

    MasDrift：跨多智能体架构的授权保留基准测试

    Zhuoning Xu, Xiucheng Zhang, Hanjun Luo, Yingbin Jin, Yinpeng Dong, Hanan Salam

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a controlled benchmark and evaluates how multi-agent coordination architectures and authorization defenses affect task completion and preservation of user boundaries. Its central contribution directly advances agent-system design and evaluation; task decomposition is only contextual, with no substantive study of compositional generalization or internal model mechanisms.

    本文推出一个受控基准，并评估多智能体协调架构和授权防御如何影响任务完成情况及对用户边界的保留。其核心贡献直接推动了智能体系统的设计与评估；任务分解仅为背景，没有实质研究组合泛化或模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-agent systems (MAS) decompose long-horizon tasks across supervisors and subagents, but delegated goals do not necessarily carry their original authorization boundaries. Existing safety benchmarks mainly study adversarial compromise, while work on constraint drift lacks controlled architecture-level evaluation. We introduce MasDrift, a benchmark of 600 benign productivity tasks across eight domains. Each task pairs required work with reserved actions. MasDrift compares single-agent, centralized, and decentralized coordination while varying hierarchy depth and peer width, measuring task completion and authorization preservation. Across generic multi-agent conditions, centralized hierarchies achieve 93.9--98.6% task completion versus 85.7--87.0% for peer networks, while unauthorized actions occur in 2.7--19.8% of tasks versus 0.6--0.8%, a gap that widens with hierarchy depth. We further compare two defenses that differ in where authorization evidence resides. One re-anchors every pending call to the original user request. The other carries an attenuated policy along the delegation chain. Re-anchoring reduces unauthorized actions in every model configuration we evaluate, at a cost of 1.6 points of pooled completion. Chain propagation blocks required work instead, forfeiting up to 36.3 points. A heterogeneous case study confirms that the failure follows from coordination rather than model strength. MasDrift exposes a centralization tradeoff and makes authorization preservation a measurable property of MAS design.

    中文

    多智能体系统（MAS）将长时程任务分解给监督智能体和子智能体，但被委派的目标未必保留其原有的授权边界。现有安全基准主要研究对抗性攻陷，而有关约束漂移的工作缺少受控的架构层面评估。我们推出 MasDrift，这是一个涵盖八个领域、包含 600 项良性生产力任务的基准。每项任务都将必需工作与保留操作配对。MasDrift 比较单智能体、集中式和分散式协调方式，同时改变层级深度和同级智能体数量，以衡量任务完成情况和授权保留情况。在通用多智能体条件下，集中式层级架构的任务完成率为 93.9--98.6%，而同级网络为 85.7--87.0%；与此同时，未经授权的操作分别出现在 2.7--19.8% 和 0.6--0.8% 的任务中，且差距随层级深度增加而扩大。我们还比较了两种防御方法，它们的区别在于授权证据所处的位置。一种方法将每个待处理调用重新锚定到用户的原始请求。另一种方法沿委派链传递逐渐衰减的策略。重新锚定在我们评估的每一种模型配置中都减少了未经授权的操作，但汇总完成率要付出 1.6 个百分点的代价。链式传播则会阻止必需工作，最多损失 36.3 个百分点。一项异构案例研究证实，这种失败源于协调方式，而非模型能力。MasDrift 揭示了集中化的权衡，并使授权保留成为可衡量的 MAS 设计属性。

    Md Mokarram Chowdhury, Ernie Chang, Yang Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper uses causal interventions on attention heads and feed-forward computations to explain how roleplay instructions weaken refusal-related signals, directly advancing mechanistic understanding of model behavior. Component interactions provide a limited compositional connection, while refusal behavior alone does not make this a reasoning or systems contribution.

    本文通过对注意力头和前馈计算进行因果干预，解释角色扮演指令如何削弱与拒绝相关的信号，直接推进了对模型行为机制的理解。组件间的交互与组合性有一定联系；但仅研究拒绝行为并不构成推理或系统方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models are trained to follow instructions while refusing harmful requests. Jailbreaks exploit this balance to elicit content a model would ordinarily reject. Roleplay jailbreaks are especially concerning: ordinary instructions defining a persona, scenario, and task can induce compliance while the harmful request remains plainly visible. We investigate which components drive this reversal and how they affect the computations leading to the response. Across two benchmarks, three model families, and four authored wrappers, we compare matched harmful and benign requests under controlled combinations of these components. We trace internal harmful--benign contrasts at the request and where generation begins, then evaluate selected internal interventions on held-out requests. A focused study examines influential attention heads and feed-forward computations, testing their functions and downstream connections. Our analysis yields three findings. (1) Successful attacks retain the measured harmful--benign distinction at the request, while its refusal-associated expression weakens where the answer begins, a pattern we call safety-relay attenuation. (2) The contributions of roleplay components depend on the other components present. (3) Reversing selected roleplay-associated internal changes restores refusal, demonstrating their causal influence. Together, these findings connect ordinary roleplay instructions to internal changes in refusal and motivate safeguards that preserve the influence of harm-related information on the response.

    中文

    大型语言模型经过训练，既能遵循指令，也能拒绝有害请求。越狱会利用这种平衡，诱使模型生成它通常会拒绝的内容。角色扮演越狱尤其令人担忧：定义角色、场景和任务的普通指令，即使有害请求仍清晰可见，也可能诱发模型配合。我们研究哪些组件促成了这种反转，以及它们如何影响生成回答前的计算过程。在两个基准、三个模型家族和四种人工编写的包装提示上，我们在受控组合这些组件的条件下比较匹配的有害请求与良性请求。我们追踪请求阶段及生成开始处的内部有害—良性对比，然后在留出请求上评估选定的内部干预。一项聚焦研究考察有影响力的注意力头和前馈计算，并测试其功能和下游连接。我们的分析得出三项发现。(1) 成功的攻击在请求阶段保留了测得的有害—良性差异，但在回答开始处，与拒绝相关的差异表达减弱；我们将这种模式称为安全接力衰减。(2) 角色扮演组件的作用取决于其他组件是否存在。(3) 逆转选定的、与角色扮演相关的内部变化能够恢复拒绝行为，证明这些变化具有因果影响。总体而言，这些发现将普通角色扮演指令与拒绝行为的内部变化联系起来，并促使我们设计能保留伤害相关信息对回答影响的防护措施。

    语言模型能够控制自身注意力

    Namgyu Ho, Huzama Ahmad, Woosung Koh, Se-Young Yun, Tal Schuster, and Cicero Nogueira dos Santos

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Declarative Attention lets a model select context regions through generated attention directives, reducing KV-cache reads with modest accuracy loss. Its direct contribution is an adaptive sparse-attention inference mechanism; the chain-of-thought connection is incidental to the system design and does not establish reasoning-mechanism advances.

    Declarative Attention 让模型通过生成注意力指令来选择上下文区域，从而在准确率仅小幅下降的情况下减少 KV 缓存读取。其直接贡献是一种自适应稀疏注意力推理机制；思维链只是系统设计中的附带环节，并未证明推理机制取得进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Language models spend most of their attention on a small fraction of context, yet they read the entire KV cache to find the few tokens that matter. If the user asks about a previous detail in a 1M-token conversation, global attention layers must scan the full context to generate each token of the reply. A prominent approach pre-selects relevant tokens via lightweight proxy scores, but this extrinsic scoring still incurs O(N) per step. We take an intrinsic approach motivated by the simple question: wouldn't the model already know which parts of the context are relevant? We introduce Declarative Attention (DA), a protocol that elicits the model to declare where it needs to attend within its chain-of-thought, partitioning generation into three modes: <global> (full context), <focus> (a specific region), and <local> (recent output only). The inference engine parses these declarations like tool calls and skips most of the KV cache read. Under zero-shot evaluation across 15 long-context tasks, DA on off-the-shelf models (Gemma-4-31B, Qwen-3.6-27B) reduces total attended tokens per response (45.8%, 19.6%), despite extra decoding steps, with modest accuracy drops (1.40pp, 2.10pp) that shrink with model scale. DA unlocks a new axis of sparse attention, with further potential under training-based methods. Code is available at https://github.com/itsnamgyu/declarative-attention.

    Global Coherence: When Every Agent Is Right and the Team Is Still Wrong - A Local-to-Global Semantic Foundation for Multi-Agent Collaboration

    全局一致性：当每个智能体都正确而团队仍然出错——多智能体协作的局部到全局语义基础

    Xin Heng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper formalizes when multi-agent decisions fail because agents lack distinguishing shared state, and proposes a runtime harness that preserves context and governs commits, supported by benchmarks. Its theorem concerns information limits rather than model reasoning mechanisms, and composition is incidental to the central contribution.

    本文形式化了多智能体决策因缺少可区分的共享状态而失败的情形，并提出一种保留上下文、管控提交的运行时框架，且通过基准测试提供支持。其定理讨论的是信息限制，而非模型推理机制；组合性与核心贡献只有附带关系。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    AI agents can each make locally valid decisions yet jointly produce an invalid result. We call this the global coherence problem: a failure of shared state, not merely of intelligence. Our Observation-Aliasing Impossibility Theorem gives the exact boundary. A policy can guarantee a valid action exactly when all worlds producing the same observation share an admissible action. If k indistinguishable worlds require pairwise-disjoint actions, the best randomized worst-case success is 1/k; more reasoning, roles, messages, or samples cannot recover the missing distinction. A stronger model can reason better within its context, but it cannot see beyond it. The smallest sufficient context is NP-hard to find, yet counterexample-guided refinement finds a sufficient one and recertifies it as rules change. We give local-to-global runtime semantics X = (H, C, G, F; D): topology H records overlapping scopes; category C governs state-changing actions; groupoid G keeps reversible translations; sheaf F tests whether local views glue into one world; and history D keeps only what alters legal futures. Each preserves the needed information as state is split, translated, or changed. Models propose; the harness owns shared state and governs commit. Ten studies test the boundary. On a revision benchmark, a frontier model scores 40/40 when the deciding event is visible; hidden, every arm is consistent with chance (1/3); one restored fact returns 40/40. On TeamBench, ordinary teams exceed a shared budget in 5/5 runs, a visible live count leaves 4/5, and commit enforcement leaves 0/5. In tau2-bench Telecom, current-state checks score 0.07 after silent reverts; the harness scores 1.00. Refinement keeps a sufficient context through rule changes at 28% of the all-field cost. Solvers that already own the state tie it, as predicted. Local intelligence cannot substitute for missing global state.

    中文

    AI 智能体各自都可能做出局部有效的决策，却共同产生无效结果。我们将此称为全局一致性问题：这是共享状态失效，而不仅仅是智能不足。我们的观察别名不可能性定理给出了精确边界：当且仅当所有产生相同观察的世界都共享一个可接受的动作时，策略才能保证采取有效动作。如果有 k 个不可区分的世界要求两两不相交的动作，那么随机策略在最坏情况下的最佳成功率为 1/k；更多推理、角色、消息或样本都无法弥补缺失的区分信息。更强的模型可以在其上下文中进行更好的推理，却无法看到上下文之外的内容。寻找最小充分上下文是 NP-hard 的，但以反例为引导的细化可以找到一个充分上下文，并在规则变化时重新认证它。我们给出了局部到全局的运行时语义 X = (H, C, G, F; D)：拓扑 H 记录相互重叠的作用域；范畴 C 管辖会改变状态的动作；群胚 G 保留可逆变换；层 F 检验局部视图能否粘合成一个世界；历史 D 只保留会改变合法未来的信息。在状态被拆分、转换或改变时，每一部分都会保留所需的信息。模型提出方案；运行框架持有共享状态并管控提交。十项研究检验了这一边界。在一项修订基准测试中，当决定性事件可见时，前沿模型得分为 40/40；事件隐藏时，每个实验组的表现都与随机机会水平（1/3）一致；恢复一个事实后，得分又回到 40/40。在 TeamBench 上，普通团队在 5/5 次运行中超出共享预算；显示实时计数后仍有 4/5 次超出；强制执行提交限制后则降至 0/5 次。在 tau2-bench Telecom 中，静默回滚后，当前状态检查的得分为 0.07；运行框架的得分为 1.00。规则变化时，细化方法以全字段方案 28% 的成本维持了充分上下文。正如预测的那样，已经掌握状态的求解器与之打平。局部智能无法替代缺失的全局状态。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache constrains the practical use of long-context models, and it dominates cost when one prefilled context must later serve many different queries. In this reusable setting, query-agnostic compression trades cost against quality: lightweight estimators are cheap but less accurate, whereas full-context reconstruction scoring is more accurate yet reprocesses the entire prompt. We introduce KV$^2$, a query-agnostic KV-cache compression method based on selective reconstruction. KV$^2$ first uses a lightweight proxy scorer to identify informative in-context tokens, then reprocesses only this subset to compute final eviction scores. On RULER, Needle-in-a-Haystack, and LongBench, KV$^2$'s margin over baselines widens as the budget tightens: on RULER 16K at a 2% KV-cache budget it improves the average score over the next-best baseline by more than 40 percentage points, and on LongBench it attains the highest average across 2%-10% budgets at lower compression-stage runtime and peak memory than full-context reconstruction. Reusable KV-cache compression thus does not require reprocessing the full context. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/KVsquared-0B97.

    键值（KV）缓存的内存占用限制了长上下文模型的实际应用；当一个预填充上下文随后需要服务多个不同查询时，它更是成本的主要来源。在这种可复用场景中，与查询无关的压缩需要权衡成本与质量：轻量级估算器成本低但准确性较差，而完整上下文重建评分更准确，却需要重新处理整个提示。我们提出 KV$^2$，这是一种基于选择性重建、与查询无关的 KV 缓存压缩方法。KV$^2$首先使用轻量级代理评分器识别上下文中信息丰富的 token，然后只重新处理这一子集以计算最终的驱逐分数。在 RULER、Needle-in-a-Haystack 和 LongBench 上，随着预算收紧，KV$^2$相较于基线方法的优势不断扩大：在 RULER 16K 上，当 KV 缓存预算为 2% 时，其平均分数比次优基线高出 40 多个百分点；在 LongBench 上，它在 2%-10% 的预算范围内取得最高平均分，同时压缩阶段的运行时间和峰值内存均低于完整上下文重建。因此，可复用 KV 缓存压缩无需重新处理完整上下文。我们的代码见 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/KVsquared-0B97。

    Karim Zaghw, Wieland Brendel, Patrik Reizinger

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper characterizes exactly which transformations preserve causal meaning in learned multidimensional representation blocks, directly advancing representation geometry and causal interpretability. The synthetic autoencoder experiment supports this result; it does not make composition, reasoning, or systems a substantive focus.

    本文精确刻画了学习到的多维表征模块中哪些变换能够保留因果含义，直接推动了表征几何与因果可解释性的发展。合成自编码器实验支持了这一结果；组合、推理或系统并非本文的实质性重点。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Standard identifiability theory assumes one-dimensional latent factors, but learned representations can encode latent information across multidimensional blocks whose internal coordinates are not uniquely determined. When such blocks are used to represent and intervene on higher-level concepts, it is unclear whether their causal meaning survives the transformations left unresolved by block-identifiability. We connect block-identifiability to constructive causal abstraction. We show that block-diagonal invertible transformations followed by compatible coordinate permutations form the maximal class that preserves every constructive causal abstraction built on those blocks. This guarantee assumes that the correspondence between blocks and concepts is updated with the representation. A small synthetic experiment with additive autoencoders shows that high-level interventions can be transferred between independently learned representations while approximately preserving their intended effects.

    标准可识别性理论假设潜在因子是一维的，但学习到的表征可以在多维模块中编码潜在信息，而这些模块的内部坐标并不能被唯一确定。当使用此类模块来表征更高层次的概念并对其进行干预时，尚不清楚在模块可识别性未能排除的变换下，它们的因果含义是否仍然保留。我们将模块可识别性与构造性因果抽象联系起来。我们证明，分块对角可逆变换及其后兼容的坐标置换，构成了能够保留基于这些模块构建的每一种构造性因果抽象的最大变换类。此保证假设模块与概念之间的对应关系会随表征一同更新。一项使用加性自编码器的小型合成实验表明，高层干预可以在独立学习得到的表征之间迁移，同时近似保留其预期效果。

    Expanding Attention: A Taylor-Series Route to Linear-Time Transformers with a Fixed Number of Recurrent States

    扩展注意力：通过泰勒级数实现具有固定数量循环状态的线性时间 Transformer

    Zicong Huang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper derives a recurrent-state attention formulation with fixed state count, analyzes its approximation and width costs, and demonstrates linear-time scaling and constant-time decoding. This directly advances efficient model computation and memory organization; its kernel expansion does not study internal representations, compositional generalization, or reasoning.

    该论文推导了一种具有固定状态数的循环状态注意力形式，分析了其近似误差和宽度成本，并展示了线性时间扩展性和常数时间解码。这直接推动了高效模型计算和内存组织；其核展开并未研究内部表征、组合泛化或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We expand the exponential kernel of attention into a truncated Taylor series of $n$ terms and factorize each term into a tensor-power inner product, which collapses the causal history into exactly $n$ recurrent states, each updated by one rank-one outer product per token and independent of context length $N$. The recursion is lossless with respect to the truncated kernel ($2.2 \times 10^{-16}$ in float64), and the states are additive across chunks ($5.7 \times 10^{-14}$), so prefill admits a parallel scan. Measured exponents are $t \propto N^{2.28}$ for softmax against $N^{0.91}$ for states, with a crossover at $N \approx 728$ and $20.8\times$ at $N = 8192$; per-token decoding latency is constant at $7.3\,\mu$s against $N^{1.04}$ for softmax, giving $76.0\times$ at $N = 65536$. Accuracy improves exponentially in $n$ while cost grows combinatorially, since the $m$-th state is $\binom{d+m-1}{m}$ wide---a bound confirmed by SVD---so the optimum is second order, $n = 3$, at $6.5 \times 10^{-4}$ error and $9{,}945$ elements per head. Query and key normalization is a prerequisite: without it the argument exceeds the convergence radius and adding terms stops helping.

    中文

    我们将注意力的指数核展开为截断的泰勒级数，其中包含$n$项，并将每一项分解为张量幂内积，从而将因果历史压缩为恰好$n$个循环状态；每个状态对每个 token 通过一次秩一外积更新，且不依赖上下文长度$N$。对于截断核，该递归是无损的（在 float64 中为$2.2 \times 10^{-16}$），且状态可跨块相加（$5.7 \times 10^{-14}$），因此预填充阶段可以采用并行扫描。测得的指数为：softmax 为$t \propto N^{2.28}$，状态为$N^{0.91}$；两者在$N \approx 728$处交叉，且在$20.8\times$处为$N = 8192$；每 token 解码延迟恒定为$7.3\,\mu$秒，而 softmax 为$N^{1.04}$，在$76.0\times$时达到$N = 65536$。随着$n$增加，准确率呈指数提升，而成本呈组合式增长，因为第$m$个状态的宽度为$\binom{d+m-1}{m}$——这一界限经 SVD 验证——因此最优阶数为二阶，即$n = 3$，误差为$6.5 \times 10^{-4}$，每个头包含$9{,}945$个元素。查询和键的归一化是必要前提：若不归一化，论证会超出收敛半径，增加级数项也不再带来改善。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper tests concept-level SAE activation steering as a mechanistic intervention on alignment faking and identifies deceptive defanging from scratchpad traces, directly advancing internal mechanisms behind model behavior.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Research on deceptive alignment is becoming increasingly urgent as frontier-model capabilities advance and their risk of causing catastrophic harm increases. Alignment faking is a form of deceptive alignment, with the compliance gap serving as a key behavioural indicator. This behaviour remains understudied in small LLMs and prior mechanistic interventions have not been shown to mitigate the compliance gap. We test whether steering SAE (sparse autoencoders) features associated with deontological ethics can mitigate this behaviour. We use a novel bag-of-words feature elicitation pipeline for SAE steering to identify what we construe as concept-level steering directions. Our approach reduced the compliance gap to non-significance in Gemma-3-27B-IT, whereas the tested configurations were not effective in LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct. Analysis of scratchpad traces also revealed deceptive model behaviour which we term deceptive defanging: deliberately degrading the aligned functionality of a response (in this case harmfulness) while preserving the appearance of alignment (in this case helpful compliance with the harmful request), sometimes conditioned on tier, training, or RLHF consequences. These findings provide, to our knowledge, the first evidence that a mechanistic activation-level intervention can mitigate the compliance gap in an alignment faking setup. They also identify a form of deceptive behaviour that may broaden our understanding of the different forms of deceptive behaviour in LLMs.

    随着前沿模型能力提升及其造成灾难性危害的风险增加，对欺骗性对齐的研究正变得愈发紧迫。对齐伪装是欺骗性对齐的一种形式，而服从差距是其关键行为指标。这种行为在小型 LLM 中仍缺乏充分研究，先前的机制干预也尚未被证明能够缓解服从差距。我们测试了引导与义务论伦理相关的 SAE（稀疏自编码器）特征是否能缓解这一行为。我们采用一种新颖的词袋式特征提取流程来进行 SAE 引导，从而识别我们视为概念级引导方向的特征。我们的方法使 Gemma-3-27B-IT 中的服从差距降至统计上不显著，而在 LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct 中测试的配置则未见效果。对草稿轨迹的分析还揭示了一种欺骗性模型行为，我们称之为欺骗性钝化：刻意降低响应中符合对齐要求的功能（本例中为有害性），同时保留其表面对齐的表现（本例中为积极配合有害请求），有时还会根据层级、训练或 RLHF 后果进行条件化。据我们所知，这些发现首次提供了机制层面的激活干预能够在对齐伪装设置中缓解服从差距的证据。研究还识别出一种欺骗行为形式，可能拓宽我们对 LLM 中不同欺骗行为形式的理解。

    CoTS: Competitive Token Selection for Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models

    CoTS：用于大型语言模型潜在推理的竞争式 token 选择

    Jie Yu, Yuxi Sun, Zhaoxu Li, Chunxiao Liu, Xudong Jiang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CoTS adaptively blends discrete tokens with soft alternatives at each reasoning step, improving results across six reasoning benchmarks without extra forward passes. Its focus is directly on latent reasoning; token selection alone does not establish a contribution to mechanistic interpretability, compositional generalization, or agent systems.

    CoTS 在每个推理步骤自适应地混合离散 token 与软替代项，在无需额外前向传播的情况下提升了六个推理基准上的结果。其重点直接在于潜在推理；仅凭 token 选择并不能证明它对机制可解释性、组合泛化或智能体系统有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent latent reasoning methods move beyond discrete Chain-of-Thought (CoT) by replacing sampled tokens with continuous soft embeddings or hidden states, enabling richer intermediate representations and preserving alternative reasoning paths. However, the need for latent reasoning varies across decoding steps: confident predictions favor discrete commitment, whereas ambiguous steps benefit from preserving multiple plausible alternatives. Existing approaches typically handle this variation through either global soft activation or hard switching based on uncertainty thresholds, treating latent intervention as an all-or-nothing decision rather than continuously adapting its strength. To address this limitation, we propose Competitive Token Selection (CoTS), a training-free framework that reframes latent intervention from binary mode selection into continuous allocation at the token level. CoTS uses the probability competition between the two most likely candidates to dynamically balance discrete commitment and soft exploration at each reasoning step. The second candidate represents the strongest alternative to the model's preferred continuation, so the separation between the two directly reflects the stability of the current discrete choice. When one candidate clearly dominates, CoTS keeps the representation close to the sampled discrete token to preserve a stable reasoning trajectory; as the competition strengthens, it increases the contribution of the soft representation to retain plausible alternatives. This competition-based allocation requires neither manually tuned switching thresholds nor mixing coefficients, and introduces no additional forward passes. Experiments across six reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that CoTS consistently outperforms standard CoT and state-of-the-art training-free latent reasoning methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/OkinoYu/CoTSReasoning.

    中文

    The paper directly studies SAE feature reproducibility, data needs, and the distinction between functional behavior and identifiable internal features, with experiments and theoretical analysis. It does not substantially address composition, reasoning, or model-system organization.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are typically trained on hundreds of millions to billions of activation tokens, yet little work has tested whether this scale is necessary. We study how much activation data SAEs need by training four SAE architectures on three language models with budgets ranging from 5M tokens to a 500M-token reference. We measure two notions of convergence: functional behavior on standard evaluations and one-to-one reproducibility of learned features. Functional data requirements are strongly metric-dependent: reconstruction often approaches the full-data reference at substantially smaller budgets, whereas feature reproducibility continues to improve with data. For Gemma-2-2B BatchTopK, the fraction of strictly matched features rises from 2\% at 5M tokens to 29\% at 50M. Data selection also matters: random sampling better preserves the original activation distribution and generally favors reconstruction, whereas diversity-based sampling frequently improves AutoInterp. A theoretical analysis separates statistical consistency of subsampled training from the stronger identifiability and optimization conditions required for one-to-one feature recovery. Our results show that SAE training can often be made far more data-efficient when budgets are matched to the goal, and feature-level claims are backed by explicit reproducibility checks, paving the way toward cheaper and more reliable SAE research.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper directly tests whether Python-language preference in code models arises from localized components, using interventions and circuit extraction, and shows how probe and component-budget choices affect those conclusions. This is a core mechanistic-interpretability contribution; the behavior involves code generation, but the abstract does not study compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms.

    本文直接检验代码模型对 Python 语言的偏好是否源于局部化组件，使用干预和电路提取，并展示探针与组件预算的选择如何影响结论。这是对机制可解释性的核心贡献；虽然涉及代码生成行为，但摘要没有研究组合泛化或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Code models write Python when the prompt does not say which language to use. We ask a mechanistic question about that habit: is it produced by a small, findable group of components inside the model? We run one pipeline---mean ablation, activation patching, greedy circuit extraction, a random-control significance test, and activation steering---over 55 model-language settings spanning ten open code models (five base and five instruction-tuned), three target languages (Rust, C#, PHP), two prompt suites, and two component budgets. We report five findings. First, the preference is large, grows with model size, and survives instruction tuning: it is larger on every instruction-tuned checkpoint than on its base version, by 12% on average. Second, its measured size is mostly a property of the probe; replacing our aligned prompts with XLCoST parallel functions takes the same measurement on the same models from about 1.6 to about 0.01. Third, whether the preference looks localised depends on how many components the search may keep: with a budget of 12, 1 of 15 settings yields a circuit that beats size-matched random controls after multiple-comparison correction, and with a budget of 40, 6 of 15 do. Fourth, interventions that a smaller-budget study reports as uniformly failing do sometimes succeed: patching makes a Python prompt prefer target syntax in 2 of 45 settings, and steering changes the most likely next token in 9 of 45. Fifth, every circuit whose effect is significant but points away from the target language comes from a setting where circuit extraction failed, which makes such results a diagnostic rather than a phenomenon. The practical lesson is that a claim about whether a behaviour is localised can turn on analysis choices that papers rarely report. We release the full grid so those choices can be varied.

    Lucius Bushnaq, Dan Braun, Oliver Clive-Griffin, Bart Bussmann, Nathan Hu, Michael Ivanitskiy, Linda Linsefors, Lee Sharkey

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper directly targets how language-model parameters and nonlinearities implement learned algorithms, proposing behavior-preserving parameter decompositions and a new circuit analysis of their interactions. The algorithmic-computation focus is only adjacent to reasoning, with no stated contribution to reasoning capability or its development.

    本文直接研究语言模型的参数和非线性如何实现所学算法，提出保持行为的参数分解方法，并通过分析组件间交互实现新型电路分析。其对算法计算的关注与推理仅有间接关联，没有明确提出推理能力或其发展方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Mechanistic interpretability aims to uncover how neural networks use their parameters to implement their impressive neural algorithms. Although previous work has uncovered substantial structure in the intermediate representations that networks use, little progress has been made to understand how the parameters and nonlinearities of networks perform computations on those representations. In this work, we present a method that brings us closer to this understanding by decomposing a language model's parameters into subcomponents that each implement only a small part of the model's learned algorithm, while simultaneously requiring only a small fraction of those subcomponents to account for the network's behavior on any input. The method, adVersarial Parameter Decomposition (VPD), optimizes for decompositions of neural network parameters into simple subcomponents that preserve the network's input-output behavior even when many subcomponents are ablated, including under ablations that are adversarially selected to destroy behavior. This encourages learning subcomponents that provide short, mechanistically faithful descriptions of the network's behavior that should aggregate appropriately into more global descriptions of the network's learned algorithm. We study how sequences of interactions between these parameter subcomponents produce the network's output on particular inputs, enabling a new kind of 'circuit' analysis. While more work remains to be done to deepen our understanding of how neural networks use their parameters to compute their behavior, our work suggests an approach to identify a small set of simple, mechanistically faithful subcomponents on which further mechanistic analysis can be based.

    机制可解释性旨在揭示神经网络如何利用其参数实现令人瞩目的神经算法。尽管以往研究发现了网络所用中间表征中的大量结构，但对于网络的参数和非线性如何在这些表征上执行计算，我们仍知之甚少。在这项工作中，我们提出一种方法，帮助我们更深入地理解这一点：将语言模型的参数分解为若干子组件，每个子组件只实现模型所学算法的一小部分，同时只需其中很小一部分子组件，就能解释网络在任意输入上的行为。该方法称为对抗式参数分解（VPD），它优化神经网络参数的分解，使各简单子组件即使在许多子组件被消融时仍能保留网络的输入输出行为，其中也包括以破坏行为为目标、通过对抗方式选出的消融。这会鼓励模型学习能够简洁且忠实于机制地描述网络行为的子组件，并使它们适当地汇总成对网络所学算法的更全局描述。我们研究这些参数子组件之间的一系列交互如何在特定输入上产生网络输出，从而实现一种新型的“电路”分析。要深入理解神经网络如何利用参数计算其行为，仍有许多工作要做；但我们的工作提出了一种方法，可识别少量简单且机制忠实的子组件，并以此为基础开展进一步的机制分析。

    Full-duplex spoken language models decide at every frame whether to take the floor, defining a conversational personality -- yet each set of weights encodes exactly one, which human speakers bracket rather than share. Existing controls mostly act from outside; none identifies the quantity that sets how much the model speaks. We identify it: a single late-layer residual-stream direction, the initiative vector, extracted from the model's own conversations without training or annotation. The same direction reads the decision, anticipating onsets up to 800 ms ahead, and shifts it: scaled during generation, it moves speech ratio from 6-12% to 42-61% (no steering: 21-30%), consistently across conversations, weights, and corpora. A short reference recording suffices to transfer a speaker's turn-taking style to the model, and the transfer is reference-specific: swapping in another speaker's reference worsens the match in 93-98% of cases, whereas the best uniform dose is indistinguishable from no steering.     Multi-modal agents have made significant progress in interacting with open worlds. However, their ability to self-evolve remains limited. Supervised fine-tuning enables imitation but not active experience organization, while outcome-based reinforcement learning promotes exploration yet underuses intermediate trajectory information. Therefore, we propose EvolvingBrain, which uses an adaptive skill system as the brain for agent self-evolution, consisting of two following components. Stratified Skill Self-Evolution: extracts Procedural Patterns and Problematic Patterns from model-specific trajectories, summarizes experience by generating skills, and evolves through multiple interactions with the open world, ultimately forming a Stratified Skill Architecture consisting of Domain, Plan, and Action/Trap Skills, which provides the agent with a multi-granularity knowledge repository and a novel evolution approach.     Yun-Shiuan Chuang, Yirou Ge, Yixi Li, Yiming Bian, Zijie Pan, Jenna L. Ballard, Uma Kona, Linsey Pang, Prakhar Mehrotra

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A self-improving agent has to decide which new skills to keep, and in practice it keeps whatever earns a high reward, convinces a judge model, or compresses its library, even when the skill is wrong. That is fine until the answers have to be exactly right: over a table of transactions, a total is either right or wrong. We ask a harder question: can an agent grow what it can compute with no reward, no judge, and no answer key, and still be exactly right? A single frozen model runs two nested loops over a small, exact domain-specific language (DSL). The inner loop answers new questions only when two independently written expressions agree on every record. The outer loop discovers its own missing capability and authors an operator for it, admitted only when an independent second implementation agrees and the result obeys a conservation law, all without ground truth. The inner loop roughly triples the answerable-question set, and the outer loop self-extends on disjoint starting sets, inventing operators outside the starting closure; a no-induction control answers none of the new questions. The admission rule is empirically sound: it rejects 138 of 138 buggy operator variants under an independent reference, even one written by a different model family, where the admit-if-it-runs, self-consistency, and compression signals the field relies on admit most of them. Unmodified, the same mechanism self-extends on two further domains with unrelated schemas, business-ledger and clinical-encounter question answering, growing their answerable sets more than tenfold and nearly twentyfold. The loop transfers across model families too: run with further proposers, the gate stays sound and independent families self-extend comparably, with only the induction yield tracking each proposer's DSL fluency.

    Anita Kriz, Antonin Berthon, Nicol\'as Astorga, Mihaela van der Schaar

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper trains LLMs to select experiments using information-gain rewards and shows improved information gathering, generalization to unseen categories, and transfer to clinical dialogue, making reasoning the central contribution.     ENGLISH

    Despite their extensive pretraining knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, large language models (LLMs) struggle to adaptively gather information in experimental design tasks. We study how to amortize sequential Bayesian experimental design (BED) into an LLM by explicitly training the reasoning that guides action selection using information-gain rewards. Our approach specifies the experimental generative model independently of the LLM's own beliefs, allowing us to optimize expected information gain under a model of our choosing. We investigate the design choices for amortization, including alternative generative-model constructions, reward estimation, hypothesis-space specification, multi-step objectives, and computational costs relative to training- and inference-time BED baselines. On Twenty Questions, the resulting policies improve information acquisition and task performance, outperform inference- and training-time BED baselines at substantially lower computational cost, and generalize to unseen categories. We further demonstrate positive transfer from Twenty Questions training to Medi-Q, a real-world clinical dialogue benchmark. These results suggest that information gathering can be learned as a generalizable reasoning skill in LLMs.

    Long-Context Drafting Does Not Require Long-Context Drafters

    长上下文草拟并不需要长上下文草拟器

    Aref Jafari, Vansh Bhatia, Matt Qin, Subhajit Dutta Chowdhury, Ben Lee, Vikram Appia, Ali Ghodsi, Mehdi Rezagholizadeh

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper presents inference-time mechanisms that let frozen short-context drafters retain speculative-decoding speedups at very long contexts, with analysis of index shifts and acceptance gaps. This is a core model-computation and inference-systems contribution; use of target hidden states does not itself provide mechanistic insight into representations.

    本文提出推理时机制，使冻结的短上下文草拟器在超长上下文中仍能保持投机解码加速，并分析了索引偏移和接受率差距。这是模型计算与推理系统方面的核心贡献；使用目标模型的隐藏状态本身并未提供关于表征的机制性见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Speculative decoding pairs a cheap drafter with parallel verification against the target. At ultra-long context it stops paying, because a drafter that attends over the full prefix inherits the target's context-dependent cost, so the speedup it was meant to provide first erodes and then reverses. The standard response is to build a long-context drafter, by training or fine-tuning one, or by using a multi-token-prediction head shipped inside the target checkpoint. We argue this is unnecessary, because the drafters in use are target-conditioned, reading hidden states the target computed over the entire prefix, so distant context already reaches them without their own attention, and verification corrects what they miss. We therefore freeze released short-context drafters and run them far past their training length under two inference-time mechanisms, one bounding the attention cache they see, which fixes their cost, and one re-basing their rotary position indices into the trained range. No weight is touched and the only tunable saturates early, so one vLLM-side configuration spans 4k to two million tokens, costing at most 0.16x of speedup at short length. We prove when a common index shift leaves the drafter's computation exactly unchanged, and decompose acceptance into two measurable gaps with sharp bounds. Whatever speedup a frozen drafter delivers at short context, it retains out to two million tokens, across three target-drafter pairs and five corpora. The claim concerns the flatness rather than the multiple, and removing either mechanism eliminates it. The gain is conditional on the speculative cost per emitted token staying below the matched target-only cost.

    投机解码将低成本草拟器与针对目标模型的并行验证相结合。在超长上下文下，这种方法不再划算，因为需要关注完整前缀的草拟器会继承目标模型依赖上下文长度的计算成本，因此原本旨在提供的加速效果会先减弱，随后反转。通常的应对方法是构建长上下文草拟器：通过训练或微调获得，或者使用目标检查点中附带的多词元预测头。我们认为没有必要这样做，因为现有草拟器以目标模型为条件，读取目标模型基于整个前缀计算出的隐藏状态；因此，即使草拟器本身不进行注意力计算，远处上下文也已传递给它，而验证过程会纠正它遗漏的内容。因此，我们冻结已发布的短上下文草拟器，并通过两种推理时机制，使其运行长度远超训练长度：一种机制限制它们能看到的注意力缓存，从而固定其成本；另一种机制将旋转位置索引重新映射到训练范围内。不改动任何权重，且唯一的可调参数很快便趋于饱和，因此一个 vLLM 侧配置即可覆盖从 4k 到两百万词元的范围，在短上下文下最多损失 0.16x 的加速比。我们证明了在何种情况下，统一索引偏移会使草拟器的计算完全不变，并将接受情况分解为两个可测量且具有紧确界的差距。无论冻结草拟器在短上下文下提供何种加速，它在三组目标模型与草拟器的配对以及五个语料库中，都能将其保持到两百万词元。该结论关注的是加速表现的平稳性，而非加速倍数；移除任一机制都会消除这种平稳性。只有当每个生成词元的投机解码成本低于匹配的纯目标模型成本时，这种收益才成立。

    Fine-tuning language models on narrowly defined harmful tasks can induce emergent misalignment (EM) across unrelated domains. While prior work has identified shared misalignment-associated representations across independently fine-tuned models, it remains unclear whether these models rely on common computational components. We investigate this question using three LoRA fine-tunes of Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct trained on harmful medical advice, risky financial advice, and extreme-sports recommendations. Using direction-based activation tracing, we identify three attention-head locations shared among the five highest-ranked heads of all three organisms. Replacing each organism's five selected head contributions with Base contributions reduces free-generation EM from 38.9% to 22.9% for medical, 50.7% to 12.5% for finance, and 41.7% to 11.1% for sports, outperforming layer-matched random interventions without reducing judged coherence. These findings provide evidence that representational convergence in EM extends to shared, causally relevant attention-head components within a common model architecture.

    Defining and Generating Compositional Structure

    Eric Elmoznino, Tejas Kasetty, Blaise Ag\"uera y Arcas, Yoshua Bengio, Guillaume Lajoie

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper formalizes compositional structure using algorithmic information theory and uses the framework to generate hierarchical objects and discuss compositional curricula. This directly advances compositional representations and data design; implications for neural architectures are secondary, with no model-internal mechanism or reasoning contribution described.

    本文使用算法信息论形式化组合结构，并利用这一框架生成具有层级结构的对象、讨论组合课程。这直接推进了对组合表征和数据设计的研究；对神经架构的启示居于次要位置，文中未描述模型内部机制或推理方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Compositional structure is pervasive in nature and across scales: atoms combine into molecules, molecules into cells, and cells into organisms, while further compositional hierarchies appear within each level. More broadly, compositionality, the reuse and recombination of parts into novel structures, is a fundamental source of interesting complexity in both natural and artificial systems. Yet despite its importance, and despite our apparent ease in recognizing it, mathematical accounts capturing what we intuitively mean by compositional structure remain limited. Here, we fill this gap by formalizing a simple idea: compositional structure emerges when parts, considered together, reveal shared structure that is not captured when those parts are modeled separately. We express this idea using algorithmic information theory, the mathematics of information and compression, which provides a natural way to identify structure in arbitrary data without specifying in advance what that structure must look like. Applied across scales, our definition informs where and how compositional structure emerges within an object. Using tractable approximations, we then invert the framework to generate compositional objects: we specify the desired form of their compositional structure without prescribing their particular content, and optimize directly over strings and images. The resulting objects exhibit readily recognizable hierarchical reuse and part-whole organization, suggesting that the definition captures compositional structure rather than merely complexity, regularity, or shared information. Finally, we discuss implications for machine learning, including a new perspective on depth in neural architectures and principles for constructing compositional data curricula capable of supporting open-ended learning.

    组合结构广泛存在于自然界，并跨越不同尺度：原子结合形成分子，分子结合形成细胞，细胞结合形成生物体；每个层级内部还存在更深的组合层级。更广义地说，组合性——对各部分进行复用和重组，以形成新结构——是自然系统和人工系统中产生有趣复杂性的一个基本来源。然而，尽管组合性十分重要，而且我们似乎很容易识别它，能够刻画我们直觉所指组合结构的数学描述仍然有限。在此，我们通过形式化一个简单观点来弥补这一不足：当各部分合在一起时揭示出某种共同结构，而将这些部分分别建模时无法捕捉到这种结构，组合结构便由此产生。我们使用算法信息论（研究信息与压缩的数学理论）来表达这一观点；它提供了一种自然方法，可在不预先指定结构必须呈现何种形式的情况下识别任意数据中的结构。将该定义应用于不同尺度，可以揭示一个对象中的组合结构在何处以及如何出现。随后，我们利用可处理的近似方法反向运用这一框架来生成组合对象：指定所需组合结构的形式，而不规定其具体内容，并直接对字符串和图像进行优化。生成的对象呈现出易于识别的层级复用和部分—整体组织，这表明该定义捕捉到的是组合结构，而非仅仅复杂性、规律性或共享信息。最后，我们讨论其对机器学习的启示，包括对神经架构深度的新视角，以及构建能够支持开放式学习的组合数据课程的原则。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper directly studies how readout weights encode and express information during pretraining, using sparse dictionaries and interventions on readout learning rate to distinguish internal encoding from behavioral expression.     本文直接研究预训练期间读出权重如何编码和表达信息，利用稀疏字典并干预读出层学习率，以区分内部编码与行为表达。其发展研究和探测分析与推理或模型系统只有偶然关联，也没有研究组合性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    When does a language model acquire a capability? Developmental studies usually answer this by tracking when models start producing the correct token. But that prediction passes through the unembedding matrix, or readout, which is itself still being learned during pretraining. We show that a model's hidden states can encode task information before its own readout expresses it, so timelines read from outputs conflate what the model encodes with what its readout expresses. To track the readout directly, we introduce parameter-trajectory crosscoding, which fits one sparse dictionary to every token's readout row at every checkpoint. Unlike crosscoders on activations, it needs only checkpoint weights. We use it to locate a narrow early window, 0.4-1.1% of the way through Pythia's pretraining, in which the readout reorganizes and WordNet word categories become decodable from its rows. By then, linear probes on the hidden states already decode task information that the model's own outputs do not yet show. To test whether such gaps depend on how fast the readout learns, we pretrain small models from scratch that differ only in the readout's learning rate. We find that raising it makes the readout develop earlier and the gap close sooner, with little effect on final loss. Together, these results imply that early in training, where many developmental transitions are dated, a behavioral date can reflect when the readout learns to express task information and not when the model learns it.

    Lianfa Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper directly targets arithmetic reasoning and contributes a trajectory RL method that densifies rewards and improves learning and test-time scaling. Its use of standard RL components is incidental to model systems, and the abstract gives no interpretability or composition contribution.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    To address sparse terminal rewards in LLM arithmetic reasoning, we propose a Bellman-consistent trajectory RL method. Our framework introduces Trajectory Bellman Residual Minimization (TBRM) to transform sparse rewards into dense token-level signals. We integrate a Reinforce Leave-One-Out (RLOO) group strategy to reduce gradient variance of Bellman residuals and use hindsight goal relabeling to accelerate intermediate learning. Evaluated on the Countdown task, our method alleviates optimization bottlenecks and stabilizes gradient variance significantly better than GRPO. The TBRM-RLOO framework boosts Pass@1 to 0.55--0.64 and achieves a state-of-the-art Pass@16 accuracy of 76.0--84.0\%, outperforming the SFT, IPO/DPO, and RLOO baselines. Our approach demonstrates exceptional single-sample efficiency and successfully circumvents standard performance plateaus via test-time scaling.

    Agent memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to reuse past experiences without updating their parameters. However, semantic similarity alone does not guarantee memory usefulness: downstream performance depends on how memories are selected and presented to the agent. We propose MemComposer, a memory composer that jointly examines the current query and retrieved candidates to decide which experiences to include, how many to select, and how to order them. We train the composer using Experience Policy Optimization (ExPO), a GRPO-based framework that evaluates assembled memory contexts through complete agent interactions and uses task-success feedback to optimize the assembly policy. Across three $\tau^2$-bench domains with two frozen executors, MemComposer outperforms the strongest baseline for each executor while reducing average memory-token usage by 16.9% and 4.9%, respectively.     Language Models Share a Readout Bottleneck in Working Memory

    语言模型在工作记忆中存在共同的读出瓶颈

    Dongyu Gong

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies how LLMs read task-relevant items under interference, using attention analysis, probes, and interventions across model sizes and architectures. This directly advances mechanistic understanding of internal information retrieval; the N-back task is a memory benchmark, not a substantive contribution to reasoning, composition, or system design.

    本文通过跨模型规模和架构的注意力分析、探针和干预，识别了 LLM 在干扰下读出任务相关项目的方式。这直接推进了对内部信息检索机制的理解；N-back 任务是记忆基准，本文并未实质性推进推理、组合性或系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) reproduce a human working-memory signature on the N-back task: performance declines as memory load N increases, and errors concentrate on lures, items that repeat the current stimulus at a neighboring but incorrect serial position. We ask whether this shared behavioral signature reflects a shared mechanism. The literature offers two candidate accounts. On a precision account, softmax attention cannot concentrate its weight on the item N positions back, so adjacent items are retrieved instead. On an interference account, attention selects the correct item, but the content of competing items corrupts the decision. We dissociate these accounts in 15 pretrained LLMs from three families (70 million to 14 billion parameters) and in minimal transformers trained from scratch. In all three families, the attention heads that carry the task attend to the target on most missed matches. Linear probes decode near-perfectly whether a matching letter occurred at the target or at a lure position, even on trials where the model false-alarms to the lure, although its own decisions barely distinguish the two. Sharpening attention yields negligible gains, whereas suppressing the letter identity of non-target items improves sensitivity (d') in nearly all model-by-load conditions. In larger models the task is spread over more heads, and removing interference helps more. In minimal transformers, precision limits a single attention layer, but a second layer removes this constraint. The working-memory limit of LLMs therefore lies in reading items out under interference rather than in locating them, consistent with interference accounts of human working memory.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）在 N-back 任务中再现了人类工作记忆的特征：随着记忆负载 N 增大，表现会下降；错误集中出现在诱饵项上，即在相邻但错误的序列位置重复当前刺激的项目。我们探究这种共同的行为特征是否反映了共同机制。现有文献提出了两种候选解释。精度解释认为，softmax 注意力无法将权重集中到前 N 个位置的项目上，因此会检索相邻项目。干扰解释认为，注意力选中了正确项目，但竞争项目的内容干扰了决策。我们在来自三个系列的 15 个预训练 LLM（参数量从 7000 万到 140 亿）以及从头训练的极简 Transformer 中区分了这两种解释。在这三个系列中，承担该任务的注意力头在大多数漏判匹配的试次上都关注目标。线性探针几乎总能正确解码匹配字母是否出现在目标位置或诱饵位置，即使模型错误地对诱饵项报出警报的试次也是如此，尽管模型自身的决策几乎无法区分二者。提高注意力分布的尖锐程度只带来微不足道的收益；而抑制非目标项目的字母身份信息，则能在几乎所有模型与负载条件组合下提升敏感度（d'）。在较大的模型中，任务由更多注意力头共同承担，消除干扰带来的帮助也更大。在极简 Transformer 中，单个注意力层会受到精度限制，但第二层能够消除这一约束。因此，LLM 的工作记忆限制在于干扰下读出项目，而非定位项目；这与人类工作记忆的干扰解释相一致。

    Does Latent Chain-of-Thought Actually Reason? A Single, Unifying Taxonomy for Latent Reasoning

    潜在思维链真的会推理吗？潜在推理的单一统一分类体系

    Jingjie Qiu, Sheldon Yu, Xunyi Jiang, Jiajin Liu, Zihan Huang, Zhendong Chu, Tong Yu, Julian McAuley, Junda Wu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper tests what latent reasoning chains encode and whether their content causally affects answers, using interventions, probes, and trajectory analysis to build a taxonomy. This directly advances evaluation of reasoning mechanisms and offers substantial insight into internal representations, though it does not study compositional generalization or model systems.

    本文通过干预、探针和轨迹分析，检验潜在推理链编码了什么，以及其内容是否会因果性地影响答案，并据此构建分类体系。这项工作直接推进了对推理机制的评估，并深入揭示了内部表征；不过，它没有研究组合泛化或模型系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Latent chain-of-thought replaces written reasoning steps with continuous hidden states, giving models additional steps to compute before answering. It remains unclear what computation these steps actually perform. High task accuracy and decodable intermediate answers do not establish that a model uses its latent chain to reach an answer. We study this question across twenty-one model-task configurations covering three training recipes, three reasoning tasks, and two backbones. We combine chain deletion and content replacement with probes and trajectory analysis to test whether the chain affects the answer, what it encodes, and how its states change. On logical tasks, COCONUT often carries an answer that is already readable before the chain begins. Its states settle early, and deleting the chain leaves predictions almost unchanged. Per-step supervision produces an ordered layout of reasoning steps and can make the model depend on the chain. Yet even an ordered chain can act as a placeholder, with deletion hurting performance while content replacement leaves answers unchanged. On arithmetic tasks, all tested recipes show dependence on chain content. These results show why readable latent states alone are insufficient evidence of reasoning. We introduce a taxonomy that separates what a chain represents from how the model uses it. Seen this way, earlier reports no longer compete: placeholder tokens, collapsed superposition and step-dependent causal roles are each consistent with a different kind of chain, each obtained on a different task, training recipe or measurement. Once a study says which property it tested, whether the model uses the chain, what the chain holds, or how its state moves, claims about latent reasoning can be compared.

    中文

    潜在思维链用连续隐状态取代书面推理步骤，为模型在作答前提供额外的计算步骤。但这些步骤实际执行什么计算仍不清楚。任务准确率高、且中间答案可被解码，并不能证明模型会利用其潜在思维链得出答案。我们在二十一个模型—任务配置中研究这一问题，涵盖三种训练方案、三种推理任务和两种骨干模型。我们结合删除思维链、替换其内容、探针分析和轨迹分析，检验思维链是否影响答案、它编码了什么，以及其状态如何变化。在逻辑任务上，COCONUT 往往在思维链开始之前就已携带一个可读出的答案。其状态很早便趋于稳定，删除思维链几乎不会改变预测。逐步监督会产生有序的推理步骤布局，并可能使模型依赖思维链。然而，即使有序思维链也可能只是占位符：删除它会降低性能，而替换其内容却不会改变答案。在算术任务上，所有测试的训练方案都表现出对思维链内容的依赖。这些结果说明，仅凭隐状态可读并不足以证明发生了推理。我们提出一种分类体系，将思维链所表示的内容与模型对它的使用方式区分开来。由此来看，早期报告并非彼此冲突：占位符 token、坍缩的叠加表示和依赖步骤的因果作用，各自对应一种不同类型的思维链，而每一种都来自不同的任务、训练方案或测量方式。只要研究说明它检验的是哪种属性——模型是否使用思维链、思维链包含什么，或其状态如何变化——关于潜在推理的结论就可以相互比较。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper directly investigates how prompt transformations redistribute sparse autoencoder feature activity and develops a method to measure recurring representation changes and their effects on downstream readouts. This is core mechanistic interpretability and representation analysis; downstream safety readouts are the evaluation setting, not a separate reasoning or systems contribution.

    本文直接研究提示变换如何重新分配稀疏自编码器特征活动，并提出一种方法，用于衡量反复出现的表征变化及其对下游读出器的影响。这属于核心的机制可解释性和表征分析研究；下游安全读出器只是评估场景，并非另一个独立的推理或系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose language model activations into sparse features, but prompt transformations designed to preserve the underlying request can redistribute activity across them. A feature change observed on one transformed prompt need not recur, and even a recurring change need not affect a downstream computation. We introduce the redistribution sensitivity score (RSS), which identifies large feature responses that recur in a consistent direction, and evaluate the resulting supports on variants excluded from selection. Across 27 pretrained SAEs spanning eight language models, the tested prompt transformations produce a reproducible redistribution profile on these excluded variants. We then separate recurring representation change from signed readout contribution and decision failure. For a fixed linear readout, an exact decomposition shows how response magnitude, readout coefficients, directional alignment, and the clean margin determine downstream consequences. In two frozen safety readouts, combining RSS support erosion with the full clean margin yields recurrent failure AUROCs of 0.935 and 0.958 using median supports of 20 and 19 features, compared with 0.965 and 0.964 using full erosion. RSS therefore provides a way to identify recurring sparse representation changes and quantify their contribution to a downstream readout without equating representation change with failure. Code is available at https://github.com/OpenSAE/Redistribution-Sensitivity-Score
