    SecureClaw: Clawing Back Control of LLM Agents

    SecureClaw：夺回对 LLM 智能体的控制权

    Yuhan Ma and Stefan Schmid

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SecureClaw presents a dual-boundary architecture for tool-using LLM agents, separating sensitive data from runtime access and requiring trusted authorization for external actions. This is a substantial, transferable agent-systems contribution, while benchmark utility and security results do not establish advances in interpretability, composition, or reasoning.

    SecureClaw 为使用工具的 LLM 智能体提出双边界架构，将敏感数据与运行时访问隔离，并要求外部操作经过可信授权。这是一项重要且可迁移的智能体系统贡献；不过，基准测试中的效用和安全结果并未证明其在可解释性、组合能力或推理方面取得进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents face two distinct security failures: unauthorized external actions and exposure of sensitive plaintext inside the runtime before any final output check can intervene. Existing defenses usually protect one boundary, either the planner/runtime or the point where external actions are executed, and therefore do not by themselves secure both surfaces. We present SecureClaw, a dual-boundary architecture that enforces authorization in a trusted executor and keeps raw protected data outside the LLM runtime. Sensitive reads pass through a trusted gateway that replaces raw values with reference IDs. In the evaluated deployment, the gateway also provides short planning summaries that deliberately release selected information, a process called declassification. Writes that change external state follow a PREVIEW$\rightarrow$COMMIT protocol in which only a trusted executor may execute the exact request authorized by policy. The runtime can still plan over summaries and reference IDs, but cannot directly resolve the IDs into secrets or perform side effects. Across the AgentDojo, AgentLeak, and Agent Security Bench (ASB) benchmarks, SecureClaw is the only defense we evaluate in a common harness that simultaneously retains usable task utility and achieves 0% attack success rate (ASR) on ASB, 0.64% ASR on AgentDojo, and 3.23% overall leak on AgentLeak's attacked parity lane, which measures final-output and internal-relay leakage. Code is available at https://github.com/ponyyuhan/SecureClaw.

    中文

    使用工具的大语言模型（LLM）智能体面临两种不同的安全失效：未经授权的外部操作，以及在任何最终输出检查介入之前，敏感明文已暴露在运行时内部。现有防御通常只保护一个边界，即规划器/运行时，或执行外部操作的环节，因此单靠它们无法同时保护这两个方面。我们提出 SecureClaw，这是一种双边界架构，通过可信执行器强制执行授权，并将受保护的原始数据保留在 LLM 运行时之外。敏感读取会经过一个可信网关，由网关将原始值替换为引用 ID。在经过评估的部署中，网关还会提供简短的规划摘要，有意释放选定信息；这一过程称为降密。改变外部状态的写入操作遵循 PREVIEW$\rightarrow$COMMIT 协议，只有可信执行器可以执行经策略授权的确切请求。运行时仍可基于摘要和引用 ID 进行规划，但不能直接将 ID 解析为机密，也不能执行副作用。在 AgentDojo、AgentLeak 和 Agent Security Bench (ASB) 基准测试中，SecureClaw 是我们在统一测试框架下评估的唯一一种防御方法，既保留了可用的任务效用，又在 ASB 上实现 0% 的攻击成功率（ASR），在 AgentDojo 上实现 0.64% 的 ASR，并在 AgentLeak 受攻击的 parity 测试轨道上实现 3.23% 的总体泄漏率；该轨道衡量最终输出和内部中继泄漏。代码见 https://github.com/ponyyuhan/SecureClaw。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    EvoFlux uses execution feedback to evolve structured tool-call workflows, improving task success for compact agents under limited supervision. This substantially advances tool-using agent execution, with a partial connection to composition through reusable workflow steps; it does not study internal model mechanisms or reasoning capability itself.

    EvoFlux 利用执行反馈演化结构化工具调用工作流，在监督有限时提升紧凑型智能体的任务成功率。这显著推进了工具使用智能体的执行能力，并通过可复用的工作流步骤与组合能力有一定联系；但它没有研究模型内部机制本身或推理能力本身。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Small language models (1.5B-4B parameters) offer low-cost, low-latency tool use but often produce plausible plans that fail during execution due to unavailable tools, missing arguments, or broken dependencies. We introduce EvoFlux, an inference-time search method that repairs tool plans through an evolutionary loop over structured graphs of tool calls and dependencies. EvoFlux executes candidate plans against live tool servers and uses execution errors to guide targeted edits, including replacing tools, correcting parameters, inserting missing steps, and removing redundant ones. On held-out MCP-Bench tasks spanning 28 live servers and 250 tools, EvoFlux improves execution success from roughly 3% to 17-24% across four small planners. SFT and SFT+DPO trained on the same 177 demonstrations and 624 preference pairs match or underperform the zero-shot baseline, while ReAct reaches higher peaks on stronger planners at 4-20x greater planner-token cost per solved task. Execution-guided inference-time repair reliably improves small tool-using agents when supervision is limited.

    小型语言模型（参数量为 1.5B-4B）能够以低成本、低延迟使用工具，但常会生成看似合理、却因工具不可用、缺少参数或依赖关系断裂而无法执行的计划。我们提出 EvoFlux，这是一种推理时搜索方法，通过在工具调用及其依赖关系构成的结构化图上运行演化循环来修复工具计划。EvoFlux 会在实时工具服务器上执行候选计划，并利用执行错误指导有针对性的编辑，包括替换工具、修正参数、插入缺失步骤以及移除冗余步骤。在涵盖 28 个实时服务器和 250 种工具的留出 MCP-Bench 任务上，EvoFlux 将四种小型规划器的执行成功率从约 3% 提高到 17-24%。使用相同的 177 个示范和 624 个偏好对训练的 SFT 和 SFT+DPO，表现与零样本基线持平或更差；而 ReAct 在更强的规划器上达到更高峰值，但每解决一个任务所需的规划器 token 成本高出 4-20 倍。当监督有限时，由执行反馈引导的推理时修复能够可靠地提升小型工具使用智能体的表现。

    LLM-as-an-Investigator: Evidence-First Agentic Reasoning for Robust Interactive Problem Diagnosis

    LLM-as-an-Investigator：面向稳健交互式问题诊断的证据优先智能体推理

    Fabrizio Marozzo, Pietro Li\`o

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper contributes an evidence-first interactive diagnosis method that tracks competing hypotheses, challenges explanations, and tests its components for robustness. This strongly advances problem-solving and planning, while its agent orchestration is a secondary systems contribution; it does not study internal representations or compositional generalization.

    本文提出一种证据优先的交互式诊断方法，能够跟踪相互竞争的假设、质疑解释，并通过测试评估其组件的稳健性。这显著推进了问题求解和规划，而智能体编排是次要的系统贡献；本文没有研究内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) are used for technical troubleshooting, where problem descriptions are often incomplete and multiple causes can explain the same symptoms. Effective diagnosis requires acquiring discriminative evidence and selecting the explanation best supported by it. Yet reasoning or interaction alone may not prevent premature commitment to an incorrect hypothesis. We introduce LLM-as-an-Investigator, an evidence-first methodology for interactive problem diagnosis that reduces premature commitment while distinguishing competing causes. We implement it through the Solution Investigator Agent (SIA), which orchestrates three complementary reasoning behaviours through a shared investigation state: a Diagnostic Reasoner that conducts and reassesses the diagnostic interview, a Hypothesis Investigator that maintains and updates competing hypotheses, and a Counterfactual Investigator that challenges current explanations and guides discriminative follow-up questions. Final selection uses cited dialogue evidence and a separate verification step, while explicit hypothesis and evidence records make the diagnosis traceable and preserve unresolved alternatives. We construct a structured corpus from 303 technical forum threads across mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic domains. A source-grounded pipeline separates the initial problem, pre-solution clarifications, and reported outcome, while a user simulator answers diagnostic questions without access to the reference solution. We compare SIA with direct, reasoning-based, interactive, and search-based baselines, including adaptations of ReAct and Tree of Thoughts. Evaluation distinguishes final diagnostic quality from hypothesis coverage and oracle potential, while ablations and paired stress tests assess component contributions and robustness to plausible but misleading user hypotheses.

    中文

    大语言模型（LLM）被用于技术故障排查，但问题描述往往不完整，而且相同症状可能由多种原因造成。有效诊断需要获取有区分力的证据，并选出证据支持最充分的解释。然而，仅靠推理或交互可能无法避免过早认定某个错误假设。我们提出 LLM-as-an-Investigator，这是一种用于交互式问题诊断的证据优先方法，能够在区分相互竞争的原因时减少过早认定。我们通过 Solution Investigator Agent（SIA）实现该方法；SIA 通过共享的调查状态协调三种互补的推理行为：负责开展并重新评估诊断访谈的 Diagnostic Reasoner、负责维护并更新竞争假设的 Hypothesis Investigator，以及负责质疑当前解释并引导提出有区分力的后续问题的 Counterfactual Investigator。最终选择依据带引用的对话证据，并经过独立验证步骤；明确记录假设和证据，使诊断过程可追溯，并保留尚未解决的备选解释。我们从机械、电气和液压领域的 303 个技术论坛帖子构建结构化语料库。一个以来源为依据的流程将初始问题、解决方案提出前的澄清内容和报告的结果区分开来；用户模拟器在无法接触参考答案的情况下回答诊断问题。我们将 SIA 与直接式、基于推理、交互式和基于搜索的基线进行比较，其中包括 ReAct 和 Tree of Thoughts 的改编版本。评估将最终诊断质量与假设覆盖率和 oracle 潜力区分开来；消融实验和成对压力测试则用于评估各组件的贡献，以及对看似合理但具有误导性的用户假设的稳健性。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    VOiLA combines learned POMDP world models with vectorized online planning, showing efficient planning under uncertainty and generalization to unseen configurations. The planning and agent-system contributions are substantial, while learned diffusion models and configuration generalization alone do not establish internal interpretability or compositional insight.

    VOiLA 将学习得到的 POMDP 世界模型与向量化在线规划相结合，展示了其在不确定性下的高效规划能力，以及对未见配置的泛化能力。其规划和智能体系统方面的贡献显著；学习式扩散模型和配置泛化本身则不足以证明其在内部可解释性或组合能力方面有所突破。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Planning under uncertainty is an essential capability for autonomous robots. The Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) provides a powerful framework for such a capability. Although POMDP-based planning has advanced significantly, its application to real-world problems is often limited by the difficulty of obtaining faithful POMDP models. We present Vectorized Online planning wIth Learned diffusion model for POMDP Agents (VOiLA), a framework that learns task-agnostic POMDP world models for online planning under uncertainty. Specifically, VOiLA learns transition and observation samplers using conditional diffusion models and observation-likelihood models for particle-based belief updates. To enable efficient online planning, the diffusion samplers are distilled into compact feedforward generators and integrated with Vectorized Online POMDP Planner (VOPP), an online POMDP planner designed to leverage GPU parallelization. Experimental results indicate the distillation strategy reduces sampling cost by up to nearly three orders of magnitude, making learned generative POMDP models practical for online planning. Evaluation of VOiLA on three benchmark problems indicates that VOiLA achieves equal or better performance than current reinforcement learning (RL) methods for POMDPs, such as Recurrent Soft Actor Critic and DreamerV3, while using less than 10% of the training data, and generalizes much better to unseen environment configurations. In a physical robot experiment, VOiLA accomplishes the task in 10 of 10 runs while using models learned purely from simulated data for online planning.

    中文

    在不确定性下进行规划是自主机器人的一项核心能力。部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）为实现这一能力提供了强大的框架。尽管基于 POMDP 的规划已取得显著进展，但其在现实问题中的应用往往受限于难以获得可靠 POMDP 模型。我们提出 Vectorized Online planning wIth Learned diffusion model for POMDP Agents（VOiLA），这是一种学习与具体任务无关的 POMDP 世界模型、用于不确定性下在线规划的框架。具体而言，VOiLA 使用条件扩散模型学习状态转移和观测采样器，并学习用于基于粒子的信念更新的观测似然模型。为实现高效在线规划，扩散采样器经过蒸馏，转化为紧凑的前馈生成器，并集成到 Vectorized Online POMDP Planner（VOPP）中；VOPP 是一种旨在利用 GPU 并行化的在线 POMDP 规划器。实验结果表明，蒸馏策略最多可将采样成本降低近三个数量级，使学习得到的生成式 POMDP 模型能够实际用于在线规划。在三个基准问题上的评估显示，与当前用于 POMDP 的强化学习（RL）方法（如 Recurrent Soft Actor Critic 和 DreamerV3）相比，VOiLA 达到相当或更好的性能，同时使用的训练数据不到其 10%，并且对未见过的环境配置具有更强的泛化能力。在实体机器人实验中，VOiLA 使用完全基于模拟数据学习的模型进行在线规划，在 10 次运行中有 10 次完成了任务。

    To Eun Kim, Xuhong He, Dishank Jain, Ambuj Agrawal, Negar Arabzadeh, Fernando Diaz

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MATM shares reusable agent trajectories through population-level storage and retrieval, improving task execution without coordination or joint training. Its main contribution is agent memory and information sharing; reuse of procedures is only an incidental compositional connection, with no stated advance in reasoning mechanisms.

    MATM 通过群体层面的存储和检索来共享可复用的智能体轨迹，无需协调或联合训练即可改善任务执行。其主要贡献在于智能体记忆和信息共享；程序复用只是与组合能力的偶然关联，文中没有说明其在推理机制方面有所进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Decentralized deployment of LLM agents with diverse capabilities motivates infrastructure for knowledge sharing across heterogeneous agent populations. Just as search engines index human-generated artifacts for human problem solving, retrieval systems can organize agent-generated artifacts for reuse across agents, extending retrieval-augmented generation from human-authored documents to agent-generated ones. Agent trajectories in particular encode reusable procedural knowledge, yet are typically discarded after a single use or retained only by the producing agent, forcing newly instantiated agents to rediscover existing solutions. We propose Multi-Agent Transactive Memory (MATM), a framework for population-level storage and retrieval of agent trajectories, where producer agents contribute trajectories to a shared repository and consumer agents retrieve them to improve task execution.     ENGLISH

    Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, but their efficiency is limited by the large number of visual tokens, which introduces substantial computational overhead. Visual token pruning offers a natural solution, yet existing methods are imperfect: attention-based criteria tend to retain redundant tokens, while diversity-based criteria are often agnostic to user instructions. Even methods that combine multiple criteria still lack a principled formulation of the intrinsic objective of token pruning. In this paper, we revisit visual token pruning from a first-principles perspective and formulate it as constructing Token Optimal Preservation Sets. Through a top-down information-theoretic analysis, we identify three fundamental principles for effective token selection: Task Relevance, Information Coverage, and Semantic Diversity. Based on these principles, we propose TOPS, a training-free and model-agnostic pruning module that can be applied to various MLLMs. Extensive experiments on 7 MLLM backbones and 14 benchmarks demonstrate that TOPS outperforms prior methods under diverse pruning settings. Notably, on LLaVA-NeXT, TOPS removes 77.8% of visual tokens while preserving 100.0% and 100.6% performance on its 7B and 13B models, respectively, suggesting that pruning redundant visual tokens can sometimes mitigate hallucination and inspire future lightweight MLLM design.     ENGLISH

    Looped Transformers, which repeatedly apply a shared transformer block, are an architecturally natural fit for variable-length algorithmic tasks. Although they can exhibit strong length generalization beyond the length of training sequences, this behavior is brittle, yielding high out-of-distribution (OOD) variance, even across well-performing in-distribution solutions. We trace this variance to the spurious correlation in simple algorithmic tasks between sequence length and number of loops. Introducing stochasticity into the number of loops during training sharply reduces OOD variance and stabilizes predictions across inference-time loop counts. To improve upon heuristic randomization schemes, we further analyze RL-Halting as a learned stochastic schedule and find that it generally improves the accuracy-stability trade-off. Across binary addition, Dyck-1, Unique Set, and Copy, learned stochastic stopping often improves this trade-off but can also stabilize a suboptimal computation. Our work suggests that "when to stop" should be treated as a training-time design choice, not merely an inference-time computation-allocation rule.

MemSyco-Bench measures when memory should influence a decision and how valid memory should be used. Specifically, it covers five tasks that assess whether agents can reject memory as factual evidence, respect its applicable scope, resolve conflicts between memory and objective evidence, track memory updates, and use valid memory for personalization.     Predicate invention (PI), the creation of new predicates to extend the hypothesis space, remains a critical bottleneck in Inductive Logic Programming (ILP). Existing methods rely on domain expertise and produce semantically opaque predicates, hindering adaptation to unfamiliar domains and cross-task reuse. We present ADVENT, an LLM-driven PI mechanism for ILP. Invented predicates and learned rules accumulate in a knowledge pool for cross-task reuse. Experiments on nine poker-hand concepts across seven LLMs show that LLM-driven PI achieves 58% success rate where ILP alone fails entirely, formal verification raises this to 80%, and the knowledge pool yields gains up to +31 percentage points, while producing human-interpretable rules.     Software agents are becoming increasingly important in modern coding workflows, where they solve complex tasks through multi-step interaction with code repositories. A central component of these systems is the execution harness, which governs how the underlying LLM observes, acts on, and verifies its environment. We show that the harness can in turn shape the agent's evolving beliefs about the environment, even when the task, environment, and base LLM remain fixed. To reveal this effect, we introduce a belief-rollout diagnostic that traces how an agent's anticipated world state and future decisions evolve under alternative harnesses. We further separate immediate divergence introduced by the interface from divergence that develops over longer horizons. Across controlled coding tasks include HIBench-Code, SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench, we find substantial cross-harness belief divergence that is often invisible from terminal success alone and can propagate into different downstream actions. Building on this observation, we introduce Belief-Invariant World-Modeling (BIWM), which exposes evidence hidden or compressed by harness execution and aligns the resulting belief trajectories across different harnesses. Our findings reveal that harness design can systematically shape how software agents understand and act on their environments, providing practical guidance for building and evaluating more reliable coding agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/Hik289/Harness-induce-bias.git.

To address this problem, we propose Tail-Aware Credit calibratiOn (TACO), which calibrates the positive credit assigned to such tokens without token-level error labels. To this end, TACO lets the policy serve as its own reference, assessing each sampled token's rarity relative to the policy's local expectations to compute a tail-risk score. Using this score as a proxy for potential local errors, TACO softly reduces positive credit for high tail-risk tokens while retaining nonzero weights, limiting their reinforcement without eliminating opportunities to learn useful rare patterns. Experiments across four LLMs and eight reasoning benchmarks show that TACO consistently improves over GRPO-style baselines. Notably, TACO also improves training stability, supporting sustained performance gains in long-horizon RL. The source code is available at: https://github.com/xiuyilou/TACO.

    中文

    尽管强化学习（RL）能够提升大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，GRPO 类方法仍可能遭遇正向信用污染这一失效模式。具体而言，均匀分配信用会使成功轨迹中的局部错误尾部词元与有用词元一同得到强化。为解决这一问题，我们提出尾部感知信用校准（TACO），无需词元级错误标签即可校准分配给这些词元的正向信用。为此，TACO 让策略充当自身的参考，通过评估每个采样词元相对于策略局部预期的罕见程度来计算尾部风险分数。TACO 将该分数用作潜在局部错误的代理，对尾部风险较高的词元温和地降低正向信用，同时保留非零权重，从而限制对它们的强化，又不剥夺学习有用罕见模式的机会。在四种 LLM 和八个推理基准上的实验表明，TACO 始终优于 GRPO 类基线。值得注意的是，TACO 还提高了训练稳定性，有助于在长时程 RL 中持续提升性能。源代码见：https://github.com/xiuyilou/TACO。

    Idit Keidar and Ehud Shapiro

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The main contribution is a formally verified compilation cascade that implements volition-guarded transactions across agents, smartphone interfaces, and GLP programs. Its distributed agents and transaction coordination provide substantial systems insight, while the application to social platforms and currencies does not establish model reasoning, internal mechanisms, or compositional generalization.

    主要贡献是一种经过形式化验证的编译级联，可在智能体、智能手机界面和 GLP 程序之间实现意愿守护事务。其分布式智能体和事务协调带来了重要的系统洞见；而在社交平台和货币上的应用并未证明模型推理、内部机制或组合泛化能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The most prevalent distributed systems today include people and their personal machines (smartphones), and computations in them are driven by people's volitions. Volition-guarded multiagent atomic transactions were proposed as an abstract specification language for such systems, in which a transaction has a precondition on the machine states of its participants and is guarded by the volitions of some of them. Here we develop an abstraction cascade that derives smartphone apps from such specifications and prove it correct down to the base programming language, GLP. The cascade consists of: (1) communicating volitional agents (CVA), which implement every local volition-guarded specification with simple guards, correctly, and completely for its strongly fair runs, by two-phase commit coordinated by the initiating agent; (2) volition-guarded GLP (vGLP), an extension of GLP with volitional procedures, whose goals put an interactively-typed question to the person, into which that implementation compiles; and (3) GLP, which implements vGLP by eliciting the person's answers through the widgets of their interactive types, correctly, and completely for complete widgets. We demonstrate the approach on three grassroots platforms --- a social graph, a social network, and currencies: a compiler carries the social graph and the currencies down the cascade to GLP programs that run with scripted persons, and earlier programs of the three run as mini-apps of one smartphone app.

    当今最普遍的分布式系统包括人及其个人机器（智能手机），其中的计算由人的意愿驱动。此前提出的意愿守护多智能体原子事务，是这类系统的一种抽象规范语言；在该语言中，事务对参与者的机器状态设有前置条件，并由其中一些参与者的意愿作为守护条件。 本文构建了一种抽象级联，从这类规范推导出智能手机应用，并证明该级联一直到基础编程语言 GLP 都是正确的。级联包括：(1) 通信意愿智能体（CVA），它们通过由发起智能体协调的两阶段提交，正确且完整地实现每个具有简单守护条件的局部意愿守护规范，并适用于其强公平运行；(2) 意愿守护 GLP（vGLP），它是带有意愿过程的 GLP 扩展，其目标会向人提出一个带交互类型的问题，而前述实现会编译为该扩展；以及 (3) GLP，它通过交互类型对应的小部件引出人的回答，从而正确且完整地实现 vGLP，其中完整小部件满足这一性质。我们在三个基层平台上演示这种方法——社交图、社交网络和货币：一个编译器沿级联将社交图和货币转换为由脚本化人员运行的 GLP 程序；此前的三个程序则作为迷你应用运行在同一个智能手机应用中。

    Mind the Delay: Latency-aware Query Routing for Heterogeneous LLM pools

    注意延迟：面向异构 LLM 池的延迟感知查询路由

    Shivam Patel, Akaash R. Parthasarathy, Akash Dhasade, Ankur Mallick, Gauri Joshi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a fast, workload-aware TTFT estimator and uses it to route queries across heterogeneous LLM instances, with analytical latency modeling and measured routing gains. Its contribution is model-serving and routing design, so links to reasoning or internal mechanisms are incidental.

    本文开发了一种快速、感知工作负载的 TTFT 估算器，并将其用于异构 LLM 实例间的查询路由，同时提供了分析延迟建模和实测路由收益。其贡献在于模型服务和路由设计，与推理或内部机制的联系较为间接。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) query routers typically assign each query to a suitable model that balances response accuracy and monetary cost. Subsequently, separate system-level load balancers based on policies such as join-the-shortest-queue or round-robin distribute the queries across replicas of each model to reduce latency. However, decoupling accuracy-cost and latency considerations can lead to suboptimal routing decisions. We introduce the Batch Evolution Aware (BEA) estimator to provide a fine-grained estimate of the latency, that is, the time-to-first-token (TTFT) experienced by an arriving query. Unlike existing load balancers that rely on coarse signals such as queue lengths, per-model processing rates, or historical average latencies, BEA replays the serving framework's token-batch formation using a snapshot of an instance's current workload, stopping when the incoming query's first token is generated. Taking into account the compute and memory requirements of the prefill and decode phases of language queries as well as the contention between multiple queries that are served in the same batch, BEA predicts TTFT within an error of approximately 5%. Each prediction takes about 0.1 ms, which is fast enough to run on the critical routing path. We also design an analytical framework for a model instance under a limited processor-sharing scheme that calculates expected TTFT in closed form and captures the qualitative trend of latencies as the load increases. The TTFT estimates produced by BEA are then used in our latency-aware router, BEAR, which simultaneously balances accuracy, cost, and latency to select the best model instance from a heterogeneous pool of LLMs. Against seven baselines, BEAR improves the utility of responses delivered within their targets by 63% on average over existing latency-aware routers, and by 30.5% over the best baseline at each arrival rate.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）查询路由器通常会将每个查询分配给合适的模型，以平衡响应准确度和货币成本。随后，独立的系统级负载均衡器会依据最短队列优先或轮询等策略，将查询分配到每个模型的多个副本上以降低延迟。然而，将准确度和成本考量与延迟考量分开，可能导致次优的路由决策。我们提出批次演化感知（BEA）估算器，用于细粒度估计到达查询所经历的延迟，即首词元时间（TTFT）。现有负载均衡器依赖队列长度、各模型处理速率或历史平均延迟等粗略信号；与之不同，BEA 根据实例当前工作负载的快照，重放服务框架形成词元批次的过程，并在传入查询生成首个词元时停止。BEA 同时考虑语言查询的预填充和解码阶段对计算与内存的需求，以及同一批次中多个查询之间的竞争，因此可将 TTFT 预测误差控制在约 5% 以内。每次预测耗时约 0.1 ms，足以在路由关键路径上运行。我们还针对采用有限处理器共享方案的模型实例设计了分析框架，以闭式形式计算预期 TTFT，并捕捉负载增加时延迟变化的定性趋势。随后，我们将 BEA 生成的 TTFT 估算用于延迟感知路由器 BEAR，由它同时平衡准确度、成本和延迟，从异构 LLM 池中选出最佳模型实例。与七种基线相比，BEAR 在按目标时限交付的响应效用方面，平均比现有延迟感知路由器提高 63%，比各到达速率下的最佳基线提高 30.5%。

    本文分析了多步推理中的情境敏感事实错误，并提出用于策略优化的逐步自一致性奖励，在推理和幻觉评测中取得提升。它研究了推理训练，但没有解释内部机制或组合结构。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    With the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), modern systems not only possess strong foundational capabilities and extensive knowledge, but can also solve complex problems via long, multi-step reasoning. However, as reasoning traces become longer, LLMs may produce a substantial amount of hallucinated content during the reasoning process, which is often difficult to detect. In this work, we conduct a fine-grained analysis of hallucinations arising in LLM reasoning and find that the reasoning traces are particularly prone to Context-Sensitive Factual Hallucinations: cases where the model actually has the relevant knowledge, yet makes factual errors due to contextual interference during reasoning. To address this issue, we propose Step-level Self-Consistency Group Relative Policy Optimization (SSC-GRPO), which assigns step-level rewards to reasoning traces by computing self-consistency scores of individual steps across multiple rollouts. Compared with prior methods, SSC-GRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance on both mathematical reasoning benchmarks and hallucination leaderboards. Our results offer a new perspective for detecting and mitigating hallucinations in the reasoning process of large language models.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ContinualSkillBench evaluates whether agents consolidate experience into reusable skills, finding selective benefits from explicit skills and inconsistent transfer across models and domains.     ContinualSkillBench 评估智能体能否将经验整合为可复用技能，并发现显式技能带来选择性收益，且不同模型和领域之间的迁移并不稳定。这为可复用流程和技能泛化提供了有力证据，也直接评估了智能体记忆和技能库组织；更广泛的推理机制并非其核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Modern agent frameworks equip large language models with external skill libraries to solve complex tasks. However, it remains unclear whether these systems can effectively evolve their skills and whether the resulting skills improve task-solving capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce ContinualSkillBench, a dynamic evaluation framework for in-context continual skill learning. It covers five domains, each with 100 tasks ordered by difficulty and opportunities for skill transfer. Our experiments show that sequential execution generally improves performance, but the gains vary substantially across models and domains. Moreover, across two models and three domains, retaining context and feedback without skill maintenance yields nearly the same mean performance as maintaining an explicit skill library. Explicit skills nevertheless provide selective benefits for tasks requiring reusable procedures or precise outputs. We further find that the weaker model (GPT-4o) accumulates more skills but reuses them less often, suggesting difficulty consolidating task-specific experience into reusable procedures. These findings show that current in-context skill evolution mechanisms can support continual adaptation, but still struggle to consistently consolidate experience into robust and transferable skills.

    现代智能体框架为大型语言模型配备外部技能库，以解决复杂任务。然而，这些系统能否有效发展其技能，以及由此形成的技能能否提升任务解决能力，仍不明确。为弥补这一不足，我们推出 ContinualSkillBench，这是一个用于上下文内持续技能学习的动态评测框架。它涵盖五个领域，每个领域包含 100 项按难度排序、并提供技能迁移机会的任务。我们的实验表明，顺序执行通常能提升性能，但提升幅度因模型和领域而异。更重要的是，在两个模型和三个领域中，不维护技能、仅保留上下文和反馈，与维护显式技能库相比，平均性能几乎相同。不过，对于需要可复用流程或精确输出的任务，显式技能仍能带来选择性收益。我们还发现，较弱的模型（GPT-4o）积累的技能更多，却较少复用这些技能，这表明它难以将特定任务经验整合为可复用流程。这些发现表明，当前的上下文内技能发展机制能够支持持续适应，但仍难以稳定地将经验整合为可靠且可迁移的技能。

We introduce Adaptive Reuse of Cached Hidden States for Efficient Rollback (Archer), a training-free caching method for rollback-capable DLMs. Archer recomputes the mutable response at every update while reusing prompt K/V within a bounded response-state neighborhood. This asymmetric boundary amortizes prompt computation without restricting rollback. Bounded reuse also delays feedback from tentative tokens while keeping response revision active. Our analysis characterizes the cache boundary, bounds state-dependent approximation error, and gives a decoder-margin condition for preserving full-refresh decisions. On code-generation benchmarks, Archer achieves the best mean performance of 33.63% with a 2.57x mean speedup, reaching 2.95x speedup on a single benchmark. On non-code benchmarks, Archer achieves up to 4.33x speedup over LLaDA-Confidence while improving average accuracy. Controlled analyses support the delayed prompt feedback mechanism. Our code is available at https://github.com/Hxnng/Archer

    Large Language Model (LLM) agents deployed in production environments face a fundamental tension: the agent's behavior is frozen at deployment time, while the business rules and edge cases it must handle continue to evolve. Existing approaches address agent construction and one-time evaluation but provide no structured mechanism for continuous post-deployment behavioral correction without modifying the agent's source code. The framework provides six composable capabilities --- Act, Evaluate, Investigate, Correct, Learn, and Observe --- organized across three architectural zones: a constitution layer that codifies domain knowledge in configuration artifacts, a runtime inference pipeline that chains acting, investigation, and adaptive correction, and a learning loop that enables subject matter experts to discover and validate new correction rules through natural language interaction. An open-source reference implementation for invoice processing demonstrates that the framework is fully operational and ready for adoption.

    Modern language models and agents increasingly require persistent memory for complete codebases, long interaction histories, and heterogeneous enterprise records. The key challenge is to keep hundreds of millions of tokens searchable while passing only bounded source evidence to the answer model. We introduce MegaMem, a source-resolved dual-view retrieval system that separates semantic access from generation evidence. Distilled records and detailed evidence are searched with original and transformed queries; every distilled hit resolves to an immutable source ID before reciprocal-rank fusion, deduplication, and cross-encoder reranking; and only the highest-ranked detailed evidence within a fixed budget supports generation. These results show that MegaMem supports ultra-large persistent memory while preserving strong answer accuracy under a bounded generation context. By separating searchable memory scale from answer-context size, MegaMem provides a practical path toward accurate retrieval over memories ranging from hundreds of millions to one billion tokens.     Yirui Liu, Ruoling Qi, Xuaner Wu, Penghang Liu, Jian Chen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Tail-Replay exploits the decay of earlier inputs in linear-attention recurrent states to reconstruct those states from a short suffix, enabling flexible prefix reuse with strong serving speedups.     Tail-Replay 利用线性注意力循环状态中较早输入贡献的衰减，通过重放短后缀重建这些状态，从而在实现灵活前缀复用的同时获得显著服务加速。这是对推理和缓存机制的重要贡献；其基准表现并未体现可解释性、组合泛化或推理能力方面的进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Hybrid large language models interleave full-attention layers with linear-attention layers to reduce the cost of long-context inference. This structure complicates prefix caching: full-attention key-value caches are token-addressable, whereas linear-attention layers maintain recurrent states that cannot be rolled back to arbitrary prefix boundaries. Existing hybrid prefix caching methods address this mismatch by storing recurrent-state checkpoints. As a result, token-level matches are directly usable only at positions aligned with stored checkpoints, constraining prefix reuse to a discrete set of boundaries. We present Tail-Replay, a prefix caching mechanism that enables unconstrained token-level prefix reuse in hybrid large language models. The key insight is that linear-attention mechanisms such as Gated DeltaNet can be viewed as a structured, lossy compression of the input prefix: gated recurrent updates progressively attenuate the contributions of earlier inputs. Consequently, the recurrent state of a matched prefix can be well approximated by replaying only a short, recent suffix of that prefix. Tail-Replay exploits this property by caching the exact full-attention key-value cache while omitting recurrent-state checkpoints. On a cache hit, it reconstructs the linear-attention states by replaying a short, recent suffix of the matched prefix. As a result, the reuse boundary is determined by the shared tokens rather than by recurrent-state checkpoints. We evaluate Tail-Replay on three Gated DeltaNet-based hybrid models using the LongBench and RULER benchmarks. With only a 5--10\% replay budget, it retains 92.8--99.9\% of full-prefill quality on LongBench and RULER. For serving efficiency, we evaluate time-to-first-token speedups across multiple matched-prefix lengths---8K, 16K, and 32K. The speedup grows with prefix length, reaching $9.1$--$14.3\times$ over full prefill at 32K.

    中文

    混合大型语言模型交替使用全注意力层和线性注意力层，以降低长上下文推理的成本。这种结构使前缀缓存变得复杂：全注意力的键值缓存可按 token 定位，而线性注意力层维护的循环状态无法回滚到任意前缀边界。现有混合模型前缀缓存方法通过存储循环状态检查点来应对这一不匹配。因此，只有与已存储检查点对齐位置上的 token 级匹配才能直接使用，从而将前缀复用限制在离散的边界集合中。我们提出 Tail-Replay，这种前缀缓存机制能够在混合大型语言模型中实现不受此限制的 token 级前缀复用。其关键洞见是，Gated DeltaNet 等线性注意力机制可以被视为对输入前缀进行结构化、有损压缩：门控循环更新会逐步衰减较早输入的贡献。因此，只需重放该匹配前缀近期的一小段后缀，就能很好地近似其循环状态。Tail-Replay 利用这一性质缓存精确的全注意力键值缓存，同时省去循环状态检查点。命中缓存时，它通过重放匹配前缀近期的一小段后缀来重建线性注意力状态。因此，复用边界由共享 token 决定，而非由循环状态检查点决定。我们使用 LongBench 和 RULER 基准，在三种基于 Gated DeltaNet 的混合模型上评估 Tail-Replay。仅使用 5--10\% 的重放预算，它在 LongBench 和 RULER 上保留了完整预填充质量的 92.8--99.9%。为评估服务效率，我们测量了多个匹配前缀长度——8K、16K 和 32K——下的首 token 延迟加速比。前缀越长，加速比越高；在 32K 时达到 $9.1$--$14.3\times$ 倍于完整预填充。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Evaluation of medical artificial intelligence agents remains predominantly answer-centric, assessing only the correctness of final outputs while overlooking the quality of intermediate reasoning. In clinical settings, however, a correct answer reached through fabricated evidence or incoherent logic is as dangerous as an incorrect one. We propose MedTraj, a framework that treats reasoning trajectories as critical objects for construction, evaluation, and optimization. The pipeline generates structured multi-step clinical reasoning chains from medical diagnosis sources. Each trajectory is then parsed into clinical observations, evidence, numbered reasoning steps, and a final conclusion, and scored across five quality dimensions: coherence, evidence support, hallucination, completeness, and traceability. Controlled error injection introduces targeted faults into otherwise correct trajectories to establish causal links between specific reasoning failures and measurable quality degradation. Building on this, step-level filtering based on marginal contribution identifies which individual reasoning steps drive or undermine trajectory quality. Finally, quality-weighted context learning feeds trajectory evaluations back into the model at inference time, allowing it to learn from both strong and weak reasoning demonstrations. Experiments across CareQA, PubMedQA, and CECMed demonstrate that trajectory context consistently improves reasoning coherence, with gains of +0.029 to +0.041 over a zero-shot baseline. On the CECMed severity assessment task, quality-weighted context nearly doubles the correctness over the zero-shot baseline while cutting the hallucination ratio by 87%. Marginal-contribution analysis further shows that a small minority (15.3%) of reasoning steps carry most of the quality signal, and that extending chains beyond four steps yields diminishing returns.

    对医学人工智能智能体的评估仍主要以答案为中心，只评估最终输出是否正确，却忽略了中间推理的质量。然而，在临床场景中，通过伪造证据或不连贯逻辑得出正确答案，与得出错误答案同样危险。我们提出 MedTraj，这是一个将推理轨迹视为需要构建、评估和优化的关键对象的框架。该流程从医学诊断资料中生成结构化的多步临床推理链。随后，每条轨迹都会被解析为临床观察、证据、编号推理步骤和最终结论，并依据五个质量维度进行评分：连贯性、证据支持、幻觉、完整性和可追溯性。通过受控错误注入，在原本正确的轨迹中引入有针对性的错误，以建立特定推理失误与可测量的质量下降之间的因果联系。在此基础上，基于边际贡献的步骤级筛选可识别哪些单独推理步骤会提升或削弱轨迹质量。最后，质量加权的上下文学习会在推理时将轨迹评估反馈给模型，使模型能够从高质量和低质量的推理示例中学习。在 CareQA、PubMedQA 和 CECMed 上进行的实验表明，与零样本基线相比，轨迹上下文持续改善推理连贯性，提升幅度为 +0.029 至 +0.041。在 CECMed 严重程度评估任务中，质量加权上下文使正确率几乎达到零样本基线的两倍，同时将幻觉率降低了 87%。边际贡献分析还表明，少数推理步骤（15.3%）承载了大部分质量信号，并且将推理链延长到四步以上会带来递减收益。

    本文的主要贡献是一个反馈驱动的智能体后训练流程，它对请求进行路由、构建训练数据，并利用评估结果指导后续训练数据混合。其与推理和组合的关联次于系统贡献，且没有直接说明内部表征或组合泛化。

    ENGLISH

    Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires a concrete mechanism through which an AI system observes its capabilities and converts that evidence into the next round of learning. We present NeoHorse-1, a family of agent-native models developed to explore this path through agentic post-training. Our system combines a heterogeneous model pool with intelligent routing, recording the predicted capability demand, selected service tier, and subsequent interaction for each user turn. These records are converted into training examples that preserve interleaved reasoning, tool calls, and harness context, and are admitted through structural validation, six-dimensional semantic evaluation, and subscene-level labeling. Routing signals organize supervised fine-tuning into a three-stage curriculum and extend to routing-guided on-policy distillation, where a teacher supervises student-generated responses under the same progression. Capability-guided allocation then converts evaluation feedback into the next training mixture, closing an evaluation-selection-update loop in which what the system learns to do shapes what it learns from next. Across eleven benchmarks covering harness-based agents, tool use, coding, and instruction following, post-training raises the macro-average from 58.94 to 64.87 at 4B and from 65.60 to 69.04 at 9B, substantially narrowing the aggregate gap between the post-trained 4B model and the 9B base model. We further adapt NeoHorse-1-4B into NeoHorse-Jev-4B, a prefill-only model that returns structured decisions and probabilities for agent workflows. NeoHorse-1 provides an initial prototype of this feedback-driven process and a path toward harness-mediated RSI across successive iterations.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TFTVs map activation steering directions into weight-space edits, offering a transferable method for behavioral control and composing edits through addition and subtraction.     TFTVs 将激活引导方向映射为权重空间编辑，提供了一种可迁移的行为控制方法，并通过加法和减法组合编辑。这项工作实质上涉及表征方向和编辑组合；而保留问题解决能力只是结果，并非对推理机制或模型系统的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Task vectors enable post-training model editing by identifying semantically meaningful directions in weight space, typically computed as the difference between a fine-tuned model and its pretrained initialization. However, this reliance on fine-tuning makes discovering such directions costly and limits the practicality of post-training model editing. To address this limitation, we introduce Training-Free Task Vectors (TFTVs), a novel method to compute task-vector-like directions without requiring fine-tuning. Our method maps activation steering vectors to rank-one weight-space edits using only forward-pass statistics, while satisfying arithmetic properties that directly support learning via addition, forgetting via subtraction, and the composition of multiple edits. Empirically, we evaluate TFTVs on large language model behavioral control tasks and show that they consistently amplify, suppress, and compose target behaviors while preserving general knowledge and problem-solving skills. We also validate our method against other editing and steering baselines, experimentally demonstrating that TFTVs achieve stronger trait control with better or competitive utility preservation. We hope our work opens new directions for the community in post-training model editing and broader training-free model control. Code is available on the project website: tftv-llm.github.io.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) now show strong reasoning and coding abilities, raising the prospect that they could assist in developing and optimizing the very infrastructure that powers them. Existing benchmarks, however, mainly focus on isolated kernels, predefined operators, or pre-specified optimization targets, and cannot evaluate open-ended, long-horizon LLM infrastructure engineering. To address this gap, we present $\Phi$-Bench, a benchmark of 85 tasks grounded in real LLM training and inference codebases. The tasks cover nine categories of LLM infrastructure and come in three formats, ranging from kernel function completion to long-horizon implementation and repository-wide end-to-end optimization. They are built by a construction pipeline that turns real pull requests, issues, and repository code into executable tasks with validated tests, and every reward is gated by correctness and anti-hacking checks. Across eight frontier models, the strongest model, Claude Opus 5, scores only 36.53%, and every model performs worse on long-horizon, repository-level implementation than on kernel-level tasks. Trajectory analysis further suggests that stronger models treat optimization as controlled experimentation, validating ideas with cheap local runs and ruling out confounders before drawing conclusions. We will open-source $\Phi$-Bench to facilitate future research on LLM agents' ability to develop and optimize the LLM infrastructure that powers themselves.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes a framework for cross-model retrieval and automated reasoning, with a formal benefit-yield function and an ensemble-size threshold for performance decline.     本文提出了一个用于跨模型检索和自动推理的框架，其中包含形式化的收益产出函数以及导致性能下降的集成规模阈值。这为多模型系统组织提供了实质性见解；组合和推理虽有涉及，但相较于系统方向仍属次要。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We introduce the Universe of Universes (UoU) framework, which treats the full ecosystem of major large language models (LLMs) as a structured retrieval corpus and proposes a compositional Automated Reasoning (AR) and Machine Learning (ML) architecture for cross-model retrieval-augmented generation. The central contribution is the formal characterization of the Benefit Yield Function (BYF), the marginal performance gain per additional model added to an ensemble, and the identification of the implosion threshold {\theta}*: the ensemble size at which BYF crosses zero and aggregate performance begins to degrade. Existing LLM ensemble and mixture-of-agents systems treat models as responders and aggregate outputs, but do not study performance as a function of ensemble size N across the full model universe. Benchmark research confirms performance plateaus at the individual model level; model collapse literature establishes that iterative training on AI-generated outputs degrades individual model distributions. Neither body of work formalizes the ensemble-level implosion threshold, models Epistemic Hereditary Drift (EHD) at the ecosystem level, or treats AI manufacturing velocity as a co-variable of {\theta}*. The framework has direct implications for DoD multi-model AI acquisition policy and the emerging science of testing AI-enabled systems.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper’s main contribution is a governor that mediates planner actions through explicit safety and resource invariants before kernel enforcement.     本文的主要贡献是一个治理器，它在内核执行之前依据明确的安全和资源不变量对规划器动作进行中介检查。规划器背景与推理有偶然关联（2）；实质性贡献是智能体系统安全和控制架构（系统 4），没有关于内部机制或组合泛化的见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Adaptive security at the network edge increasingly relies on automated planners, including rule-based controllers, learned policies, and LLM-assisted agents, that translate observations into enforcement actions. Once such a planner can influence live policy state, syntactic validity is not enough. A semantically wrong action, produced from incomplete or manipulated observations, can be faithfully executed by an enforcement substrate that cannot judge mission context. We address this problem by treating the boundary between planner output and kernel enforcement input as the primary security object. We propose a split-control architecture in which an untrusted planner emits typed security intents, a deterministic governor checks each intent against safety, resource, temporal-stability, and proportionality invariants, and only admitted actions are bound to signed receipts and compiled into pre-installed eBPF map updates. The paper formalizes this trust-boundary problem, defines three threat classes, develops the governor admission predicate, and reports an end-to-end prototype. Across rule-based and LLM-assisted planners on a Raspberry Pi 5 testbed connected to the university 5G Test Network, the governor admits, rejects, and bounds intents at microsecond cost without disrupting protected-flow regularity. The contribution is conceptual as much as empirical: adaptive security does not need to trust the author of an action. It needs a mediation boundary that decides whether the action is admissible.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents already trade with real capital, yet agent-security research has mostly treated them as generic agents. Trading changes the threat: a compromised agent's orders move prices that other participants act on, and an attacker who profits from a crash can trigger the shock that a non-robust agent mishandles. We present FARSIGHT (Financial Agent Robustness and Security Investigation and Global Holistic Taxonomy), a systematization that rates trading agents on robustness to market stress and on security against source manipulation, agent compromise, and agents acting as attackers. It also checks paper-level ratings against released code. Across 15 academic schemes, none earns full credit on any robustness metric, no paper describes a way to halt trading without waiting for LLM inference, and none combines source provenance with cross-source corroboration. In the code of the 7 open-source schemes, no release enforces a stop-loss or position limit outside the LLM, 4 lack a component that their paper or documentation describes, and 2 run model-written code on the host. The same gaps appear beyond finance. Restating FARSIGHT as a domain-independent threat model, we map them onto agents in healthcare, law, software, and crypto. We then trace how compromised agents spread harm, as worms and as cascades that need no further compromise. At published injection rates per hop, a channel read by ten agents lets one compromised agent start an outbreak. We derive 14 open problems and urge deployers to corroborate sources, keep interrupts that bypass the model, and enforce loss limits outside it.

We argue that effective modeling requires information accessibility and computational depth, but not repeated historical retrieval across layers. Guided by this principle, we introduce the Global State Model (GSM), a causal encoder--decoder architecture that separates historical information acquisition from deep computation. The encoder progressively aggregates long-range information through multi-stage sparse retrieval into a fixed-size shared state, while decoder layers perform successive transformations over this state without repeated historical access. This design makes decoder attention and cache costs independent of history length, while dependency-aware pruning further reduces prefill computation. Experiments across multiple model scales show that GSM achieves downstream performance comparable to matched DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-based baselines, with improvements at some scales, while preserving long-context retrieval capabilities. GSM also improves training and inference throughput and reduces cache overhead. These results demonstrate that eliminating architectural redundancy offers an effective path toward efficient language modeling without sacrificing information accessibility or computational depth.

    提升语言模型效率不仅需要降低运算成本，还需要消除冗余计算。我们认为，有效建模需要信息可访问性和计算深度，但不需要在各层反复检索历史信息。受这一原则启发，我们提出全局状态模型（GSM），这是一种因果编码器—解码器架构，将历史信息获取与深度计算分离。编码器通过多阶段稀疏检索逐步汇聚长程信息，形成固定大小的共享状态；解码器各层则在该状态上执行连续变换，无需反复访问历史信息。该设计使解码器的注意力和缓存开销不再依赖历史长度，而依赖感知剪枝进一步减少预填充计算。跨多个模型规模的实验表明，GSM 在下游任务上的表现与匹配的、基于 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的基线相当，并在某些规模上有所提升，同时保留长上下文检索能力。GSM 还提升了训练和推理吞吐量，并降低了缓存开销。这些结果表明，消除架构冗余是在不牺牲信息可访问性或计算深度的情况下实现高效语言建模的有效途径。

Mavor-Parker, Massimo Caccia, Lucas Caccia, Glen Berseth, Esmeralda S. Whitammer, Alessandro Sordoni, Minseon Kim, Marc-Alexandre C\^ot\'e, Laurent Charlin, Guillaume Lajoie

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    KV-streams improves agentic RL training throughput by carrying the KV cache across compaction, and the paper shows RL can make that cache function as recurrent state. This is a substantial contribution to agent computation and memory; the recurrent-state finding alone does not explain internal representations or directly advance reasoning capabilities.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Scaling the horizon of agentic LLMs is bottlenecked by the need to fit ever longer context traces in GPU memory. Context compaction has been the most popular mechanism to alleviate this issue, keeping GPU memory constant for a given trace. Unfortunately, most compaction strategies rely on prefilling the LLM context many times over, hindering training throughput. To alleviate this bottleneck and enable efficient trainable compaction, we propose KV-streams, a plug-and-play strategy compatible with any compaction strategy that substantially increases throughput while showing no evidence of hindering performance. KV-streams enable scalable compaction by streaming the KV cache forward rather than flushing it after each compaction. We show that KV-streams enable three different compaction strategies, achieving a 2.6 to 5x wall-clock speedup in training. Beyond efficiency, we find that the streamed KV cache can act as a recurrent state, carrying forward information that has long since disappeared from the context. Specifically, in a controlled setting we show that, contrary to prior work, RL alone is all that is needed for this behavior to emerge. Overall, we show KV-streams to be an efficient and lightweight plug-and-play addition to any post-training pipeline.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LEAP uses block-wise localization, evidence retrieval, and a bounded answer pass to improve long audio-video question answering and support streaming. Its retrieval and context-management design substantially advances model systems, while reasoning is part of the application pipeline without a central study of reasoning mechanisms; interpretability and compositional generalization are not addressed.

    LEAP 采用分块定位、证据检索和有界回答处理，以提升长音视频问答能力并支持流式处理。其检索和上下文管理设计实质性地推进了模型系统；推理虽是应用流程的一部分，但并非对推理机制的核心研究；该工作没有探讨可解释性或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Hour-scale audio-visual question answering is constrained by a context dilemma: dense whole-recording encoding rapidly exhausts context limits, whereas uniform temporal compression severely dilutes fine-grained acoustic and visual evidence. We introduce LEAP, a framework where the model retrieves its own evidence without placing the whole recording in one context. LEAP divides a recording into fixed-duration blocks, applying a lightweight localization pass to each block to score short candidate windows. The highest-ranked windows are pooled and re-encoded in a single bounded answer pass. Consequently, the answer input and peak context remain independent of the recording duration. By decoupling evidence localization from reasoning, our framework can localize candidate temporal windows over pre-computed transcripts without decoding media frames, while preserving fine-grained visual and non-speech evidence by routing the final answering pass over raw audio-visual streams. LEAP trains both stages: a localization LoRA improves the selected windows, and an answer LoRA improves the answers read from the same windows. The block grid natively supports causal queries, enabling LEAP to support streaming inference without streaming-specific training. Across several AVQA benchmarks, LEAP improves over the Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B baseline by 4.5-16.8%, and transfers to a second omni-modal backbone, MiniCPM-o 4.5, surpassing its published results by 3.1-13.0%.

    Weihan Li, Tianshi Zheng, Yangqiu Song, Ginny Y. Wong, Simon See

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a benchmark that isolates how open representations and distributed evidence affect agents’ abductive discovery and transfer to unseen interventions. Its focus on composing evidence into transferable representations strongly advances compositional generalization and reasoning; agent evaluation is relevant to Systems, while it offers no direct analysis of internal model mechanisms.

    本文提出一项基准，用于隔离开放表征和分散证据如何影响智能体的溯因式发现，以及其向未见干预的迁移。其重点在于将证据整合成可迁移的表征，对组合泛化和推理有重要推动作用；对智能体的评估与 Systems 相关，但本文没有直接分析模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Scientific discovery often begins when scattered clues call for a new way of describing the world. Such abductive exploration can require constructing the representation in which an explanation is stated, when the world is epistemically open, and composing evidence scattered across contexts, when it is structurally interconnected. Existing benchmarks rarely separate these two demands or control them independently. We introduce ULTRADISCOVERY, an interactive world of five domains in which an agent revises an initially successful theory and predicts the outcome of an unseen cross-domain intervention. A $2 \times 2$ design leaves the representation open or discloses it, and leaves the evidence distributed or aligns it, with the latent dynamics fixed. With the representation open, agents across eleven models often retract the axiom they were taught, and none introduces the unobserved entity or rewrites the variables that a replacement requires. Disclosure triples intervention requests and adds about one of the eighteen findings the world affords, and alignment adds less. Two vendor-harness systems carry discovery into more domains, and one of them rewrites the variables in Open episodes. No system makes the exact prediction within 200 paid actions. At larger budgets one exact prediction appears with both aids, while every Open episode remains inexact. The results locate the difficulty in the step from accumulating evidence to composing it into a representation that transfers.

    科学发现往往始于零散线索促使人们以新的方式描述世界。当世界在认识论上是开放的，这种溯因式探索可能需要构建用于陈述解释的表征；当世界在结构上相互关联时，则可能需要整合散布在不同情境中的证据。现有基准很少将这两项要求区分开来，或对它们分别进行控制。我们推出 ULTRADISCOVERY，这是一个包含五个领域的交互式世界，智能体需要修订一个最初成功的理论，并预测一次未见过的跨领域干预结果。一个 $2 \times 2$设计可以让表征保持开放或将其披露，也可以让证据保持分散或将其对齐，同时固定潜在动态。当表征开放时，来自 11 个模型的智能体往往会撤回被教给它们的公理，但没有一个会引入未观察到的实体，也没有一个会重写替代理论所需的变量。披露会使干预请求数量增加三倍，并补充世界所提供的 18 项发现中的约一项；对齐带来的增益更小。两个采用供应商 harness 的系统能将发现拓展到更多领域，其中一个还会在开放情节中重写变量。在 200 次付费操作内，没有系统做出精确预测。在更大的预算下，同时使用两种辅助方式时出现了一次精确预测，但所有开放情节仍然无法精确预测。结果表明，困难在于从积累证据跨越到将其整合成可迁移的表征。

    ENGLISH

    Synchronous policy updates can limit the efficiency of post-training for long-horizon LLM agents. When trajectories span multiple interaction turns, completion times can vary substantially, and synchronous update barriers leave faster workers idling, wasting compute resources. Asynchronous reinforcement learning addresses this inefficiency but introduces policy lag and off-policy optimization. Evolution strategies (ES) are a backpropagation-free alternative to gradient-based training, yet require many perturbed-policy evaluations and have remained largely synchronous in current LLM post-training. We introduce bounded-staleness asynchronous ES and investigate its training behavior under stale fitness measurements. On WebShop, we systematically vary the lag and fraction of stale fitness measurements and additionally introduce two stress tests to probe extreme staleness cases. Natural asynchrony closely tracks synchronous ES, and degradation in evaluation accuracy remains small even under extreme staleness, including when all fitness measurements are stale. These findings suggest that ES can tolerate substantial policy staleness without explicit off-policy correction, supporting its use in asynchronous post-training for long-horizon LLM agents.

    E$^2$-OPSD: Taming Entropy Overshoot in On-Policy Self-Distillation

    E$^2$-OPSD：抑制在线策略自蒸馏中的熵超调

    Yifei Liu, Minghao Fang, Xinyu Gu, Chengkai Yao, Mengdi Liu, Tengfei Ma, Jiangbin Zheng, Chang Yu, Zhangyang Gao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper diagnoses entropy overshoot in on-policy self-distillation and proposes exemplar-guided teaching and entropy-aware correction, improving math reasoning. Reusable reasoning patterns provide a limited compositional connection, but the abstract does not study model internals or system organization.

    本文诊断了在线策略自蒸馏中的熵超调，并提出示例引导教学和熵感知校正，从而提升数学推理能力。可复用推理模式与组合性存在有限关联，但摘要并未研究模型内部机制或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides dense token-level supervision without a second model: one network acts as teacher with the reference solution and as student with only the problem. We identify a specific failure mode of this recipe. During training, student token entropy rises past the teacher's and remains elevated, a pattern we call entropy overshoot. We trace it to both sides of distillation. The reference-conditioned teacher is confident along its answer-directed reasoning path, but this confidence transfers poorly to student-generated prefixes, making its supervision overly tied to answer-specific cues rather than reusable reasoning patterns; meanwhile, the forward KL used by OPSD continually diffuses the student's predictive distribution without pulling it back. We introduce E$^2$-OPSD to address both causes. Exemplar-guided teaching replaces the current answer with a retrieved solved neighboring problem, providing transferable reasoning guidance without revealing the destination and better matching student-reachable states. Entropy-aware distillation uses the student-teacher entropy gap to determine the direction and strength of each token's correction. E$^2$-OPSD improves math reasoning by up to 4.3 points in mean@16 over OPSD, while out-of-domain evaluations show gains over the corresponding base models of up to 4.9 points in mean@16 and 5.5 points in pass@8. Despite these gains, E$^2$-OPSD remains simple, requiring no additional forward passes or networks. Code repo: https://github.com/orionfei/E2-OPSD.

    Towards Unbiased On-Policy Distillation for Block Diffusion Language Models

    迈向面向块扩散语言模型的无偏在线策略蒸馏

    Zaiquan Yang, Fei Wei, Yong Wang, Yudong Han, Yiyu Li, Zhuofan Zong, Gerhard Petrus Hancke, Xiangxiang Chu, Rynson WH Lau

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies optimization biases in block diffusion distillation and proposes filtering, confidence calibration, and rollout reuse to stabilize training, with gains on math and code tasks. Its main contribution is a reasoning-related training method; block structure and rollout efficiency alone provide only incidental composition and systems connections.

    本文识别了块扩散蒸馏中的优化偏差，并提出筛选、置信度校准和 rollout 复用方法来稳定训练，在数学和代码任务上取得了提升。其主要贡献是一种与推理相关的训练方法；块结构和 rollout 效率与组合性和系统的联系都只是附带的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an effective post-training paradigm for language models, with recent efforts extending it to block diffusion language models (BDLMs). However, existing studies focus almost exclusively on small block sizes, leaving distillation into student models with larger blocks underexplored. In this work, we investigate this regime and reveal two critical optimization biases that induce severe training instability. First, mismatched block boundaries between teacher and student cause \textbf{\textit{context misalignment}}, providing distorted supervisory signals that misguide student decoding. Second, even under aligned contexts, an \textbf{\textit{intrinsic optimization bias}} in OPD, where the student tends to rapidly absorb high-support signals while lagging on low-support updates, drives a premature confidence surge that traps weaker students in catastrophic overconfidence collapse. To resolve these, we propose \mbox{\textbf{Un-OPD}}, an unbiased on-policy distillation framework with two novelties for stabilizing BDLM training. First, Un-OPD introduces a boundary-aware step filtering strategy that eliminates context-misaligned decoding steps. Second, Un-OPD proposes moderating optimization intensity at high-support positions via a support-rebalanced confidence calibration, thereby bypassing overconfidence collapse. Beyond stability, we also introduce a rollout reuse mechanism to reduce rollout generation overhead. Extensive experiments on math reasoning and code generation benchmarks show that Un-OPD consistently stabilizes training and delivers superior performance while reducing wall-clock training time by approximately half.

    在线策略蒸馏（OPD）已成为一种有效的语言模型后训练范式，近期研究也将其扩展到块扩散语言模型（BDLM）。然而，现有研究几乎只关注较小的块大小，对于将知识蒸馏到更大块的学生模型这一问题仍缺乏探索。在本文中，我们研究了这一范围，并揭示了两种会导致严重训练不稳定的关键优化偏差。首先，教师与学生之间的块边界不匹配会造成\textbf{\textit{上下文错位}}，提供失真的监督信号，误导学生解码。其次，即使上下文对齐，OPD 中仍存在一种\textbf{\textit{内在优化偏差}}：学生倾向于快速吸收高支持度信号，却滞后于低支持度更新。这会引发过早的置信度激增，使较弱的学生陷入灾难性的过度自信崩溃。为解决这些问题，我们提出 \mbox{\textbf{Un-OPD}}，一种无偏在线策略蒸馏框架，包含两项用于稳定 BDLM 训练的新设计。首先，Un-OPD 引入一种边界感知的步骤筛选策略，消除上下文错位的解码步骤。其次，Un-OPD 提出通过支持度再平衡的置信度校准，降低高支持度位置的优化强度，从而避免过度自信崩溃。除稳定性之外，我们还引入 rollout 复用机制以减少 rollout 生成开销。在数学推理和代码生成基准测试上的大量实验表明，Un-OPD 能够持续稳定训练并取得更优性能，同时将墙钟训练时间缩短约一半。

    Minimal Witness Reinforcement Learning

    最小见证强化学习

    T. Y. Tsui, Zihao Ye, Pengxiang Cai, Yanchao Li, Yuqiang Li, Zhehong Ai

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MWRL formalizes minimal-witness identification and derives credit assignment, planning, and policy-gradient methods to recover alternative minimal solutions from verifier feedback. This advances reasoning and problem-solving; witness composition is relevant but secondary, while explanations and mechanisms are problem framing rather than internal model analysis.

    MWRL 将最小见证识别形式化，并推导出信用分配、规划和策略梯度方法，以从验证器反馈中恢复多个备选最小解。这推进了推理和问题求解；见证的组合性虽相关但居于次要位置，而解释与机制只是问题背景，并非对模型内部的分析。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    ``What are the irreducible conditions that are sufficient to produce an outcome?'' is one of the most common questions that recur across computation and science. Its answers, the minimal sufficient witnesses, are what we mean by explanations, mechanisms and reasons. These problems usually ask for multiple minimal witnesses, yet standard RL methods may reveal only one solution or redundant ones. We formalize this problem as minimal-witness identification and introduce Minimal-Witness Reinforcement Learning (MWRL). MWRL takes the union of the sets certified by successful proposals sampled from the policy and credits each proposal for the coverage the group union would lose without that proposal. This credit assignment, derived directly from the problem definition, unifies the demands for minimality and recovery of alternatives from a single black-box verifier bit. Under this principle, we derive a value iteration planner that recovers the entire family of witnesses and a policy gradient method that can scale to large language models. Across different experimental settings, MWRL recovers most minimal witnesses, while other methods return redundant supersets or a single witness. By making witness families learnable from verifier feedback, MWRL expands the scope of reinforcement learning beyond single-solution optimization. Our code is available at https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/MWRL.

    中文

    “产生某种结果所需的不可约充分条件是什么？”这是计算与科学领域反复出现的常见问题之一。对此问题的答案——最小充分见证——正是我们所说的解释、机制和理由。这类问题通常要求找到多个最小见证，但标准 RL 方法可能只找到一个解，或找到冗余解。我们将这一问题形式化为最小见证识别，并提出最小见证强化学习（MWRL）。MWRL 将策略采样得到的成功提案所认证的集合取并集，并根据移除某个提案后该集合并集会失去多少覆盖范围来为该提案分配信用。这种直接从问题定义推导出的信用分配方式，统一了最小性要求和仅凭一个黑箱验证器比特恢复备选解的要求。基于这一原则，我们推导出一种能够恢复完整见证族的值迭代规划器，以及一种可扩展到大型语言模型的策略梯度方法。在不同实验设置中，MWRL 能够恢复大多数最小见证，而其他方法则返回冗余超集或单个见证。通过使见证族能够从验证器反馈中学习，MWRL 将强化学习的适用范围扩展到了单解优化之外。我们的代码见 https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/MWRL。

    Hanchao Zhou and Jialei Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SCOPE contributes a policy-planning and symbolic-execution method for certified multi-step theorem proving, with evidence that current-state decision frames improve proof success. The task is reasoning-focused; operator use gives only a limited compositional connection, and the planner–engine setup is a systems contribution but not its main advance.

    SCOPE 提出一种用于可认证多步定理证明的策略规划与符号执行方法，并提供证据表明当前状态决策帧能够提升证明成功率。该任务以推理为核心；算子使用与组合性的联系有限，规划器与引擎的设置虽涉及系统，但并非其主要进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In proof assistants such as Lean, a generated proof must pass machine compilation checks, so evaluation needs no human scoring. Direct generation fails on multi-step numeric propositions: a proof is valid only if every content integer is correct, so the pass rate is bounded by the k-th power of the per-integer accuracy. Controlled corruption across 2,617 reference proofs confirms this power law. SCOPE (State-Conditioned Operator Planning and Execution) enforces the natural division of labor: the model plans over an operator vocabulary, a symbolic engine executes the numerics, and a compiler renders the proof. On a 218-problem suite it certifies 191/218 (87.6%) with a 135M backbone; the 7B DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL certifies 18/218 at 27.5 times the tokens and 37.5 times the wall-clock, and DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B certifies zero on a bidirectional dual suite. Multi-step thinking costs 6.12 discrete decision actions per problem and produces no natural-language thinking text. Replacing the lagged engine state in the decision frame with the current one lifts the pass rate from 117/218 to 191/218, while up-weighting the chain-end loss hurts. On the public Lean-Workbook library, 2,132 of 3,536 gradeable admissible problems certify (60.29%) with zero regression on the main suite. All readings come from a version-frozen review with independent rechecks and reverse verification. Restricting free generation and keeping decision-time information visible is a more direct route than enlarging the model.

    中文

    在 Lean 等证明助手中，生成的证明必须通过机器编译检查，因此评估无需人工评分。直接生成在多步数值命题上会失败：只有每个内容整数都正确，证明才有效，因此通过率受单个整数准确率的 k 次幂所限制。对 2,617 个参考证明进行的受控扰动验证了这一幂律。SCOPE（状态条件化的算子规划与执行）落实了自然的分工：模型在算子词汇表上进行规划，符号引擎执行数值运算，编译器则生成证明。在包含 218 个问题的测试集上，一个 135M 骨干模型认证了 191/218（87.6%）；7B 的 DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL 使用 27.5 倍的 token 数和 37.5 倍的墙钟时间，却只认证了 18/218；DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B 在双向双套件上一个问题也未认证。多步思考平均每个问题消耗 6.12 个离散决策动作，且不会生成自然语言思考文本。在决策帧中用当前引擎状态替换滞后的引擎状态后，通过数从 117/218 提升至 191/218，而提高链尾损失的权重则会损害表现。在公开的 Lean-Workbook 库中，3,536 个可评分且符合条件的问题里有 2,132 个通过认证（60.29%），且主测试集上的表现没有任何退化。所有读数均来自版本冻结的评审，并经过独立复查和反向验证。限制自由生成并让决策时的信息保持可见，是比扩大模型更直接的途径。

    ParanoiaEval：基准测试智能体编程中的不必要防御性工作

    Hanjun Luo, Xiucheng Zhang, Zhuoning Xu, Zhimu Huang, Yingbin Jin, Xinfeng Li, Hanan Salam

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper contributes a benchmark and metrics for evaluating whether coding agents apply risk treatments appropriately, with evidence-controlled tasks and experiments on agent behavior. It offers transferable insight into agent evaluation and behavior, supporting Systems 4; the benchmark's task pairing is only incidental to compositional generalization, and it does not study internal mechanisms.

    论文提出了一个基准和一组指标，用于评估编程智能体是否恰当地采取风险处置，并通过受证据控制的任务和智能体行为实验进行研究。它为智能体评估与行为提供了可迁移的见解，对 Systems 4 有支持作用；基准中的任务配对与组合泛化仅有附带关联，论文也没有研究内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As coding agents increasingly undertake real-world work autonomously, judging whether their risk treatments are warranted has become important. Existing work evaluates related agent behaviors from separate perspectives, but lacks a systematic framework for unifying these behaviors. To bridge this gap, we introduce ParanoiaEval, the first benchmark for unified evaluation of risk-treatment capabilities in coding agents. Grounded in the well-established Avoidance-Transfer-Mitigation-Acceptance framework in software engineering risk management, ParanoiaEval operationalizes its 4 fundamental treatments for coding-agent settings and contains 200 evidence-controlled repository-level task pairs, each differing only in treatment-defining evidence. We further introduce dedicated metrics for risk-treatment violations and evidence responsiveness, using a human-calibrated agentic judge for reliable evaluation. Large-scale experiments on 8 representative models and a post-hoc human study reveal that (I) unnecessary risk treatment occurs in 11.2%-58.7% of runs despite explicit evidence, with substantial variation across agent configurations; (II) stronger task capability does not ensure more appropriate risk treatment, while treatment violations substantially harm developers' experience, establishing risk treatment as an independent capability dimension; and (III) agents exhibit systematic patterns consistent with established risk-management findings, suggesting that knowledge from human practice can guide the diagnosis and improvement of this capability.

    中文

    随着编程智能体越来越多地自主承担现实世界中的工作，判断其风险处置是否合理变得十分重要。现有研究从不同角度评估相关的智能体行为，但缺少统一这些行为的系统框架。为弥补这一空白，我们推出 ParanoiaEval，这是首个用于统一评估编程智能体风险处置能力的基准。ParanoiaEval 以软件工程风险管理中成熟的 Avoidance-Transfer-Mitigation-Acceptance 框架为基础，将其 4 种基本处置方式落实到编程智能体场景中，并包含 200 对受证据控制的仓库级任务，每对任务仅在决定处置方式的证据上有所不同。我们还提出了专门衡量风险处置违规和证据响应性的指标，并使用经人类校准的智能体评审器进行可靠评估。对 8 个有代表性的模型开展的大规模实验，以及一项事后人类研究表明：(I) 尽管有明确证据，仍有 11.2%–58.7% 的运行出现了不必要的风险处置，而且不同智能体配置之间差异显著；(II) 更强的任务能力并不保证风险处置更恰当，而处置违规会严重损害开发者体验，这表明风险处置是一个独立的能力维度；(III) 智能体表现出与既有风险管理研究发现相符的系统性模式，说明人类实践中的知识可以指导对这项能力的诊断与改进。

    AllSpark Team

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    AdaptEvo’s main contribution is confidence-adaptive policy optimization and evolving rubrics for decisions trained from imperfect supervision, with gains under changed rules. Synthesizing reusable knowledge from recurring failures offers limited compositional insight (CompGen 3); the training method directly targets decision quality (Reasoning 4), while multimodal moderation is an application and no model-system design is established (Systems 2).

    AdaptEvo 的主要贡献是面向不完美监督下训练的决策，采用置信度自适应策略优化和不断演化的准则，并在规则变更时取得收益。从反复出现的失败中综合可复用知识，带来了有限的组合性洞见（CompGen 3）；该训练方法直接针对决策质量（Reasoning 4），而多模态审核只是一个应用，且没有确立模型系统设计方面的贡献（Systems 2）。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Rule-governed contextual decision tasks require models to apply specified rules to case-specific context and evidence. Written rules can leave gaps in decision guidance and process evaluation, while reference judgments vary in their support from the rules and evidence. To address these challenges, we introduce AdaptEvo, a framework for learning under imperfect supervision that couples confidence-adaptive policy optimization with evolving decision knowledge and evaluation rubrics. Its Training module uses Confidence-Adaptive GRPO (CA-GRPO) to balance outcome and process rewards according to reference confidence. Its Evolution module synthesizes reusable decision knowledge from recurring failures across training cases and refines process rubrics to detect overlooked errors. To support empirical evaluation, we construct an industrial multimodal content moderation dataset comprising a training set and In-Period and Out-of-Period test sets, with the latter collected under changed rules. Using Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, AdaptEvo achieves 61.9% exact-label accuracy and 72.2% binary decision accuracy on In-Period, exceeding GRPO by 7.5 and 3.7 percentage points, respectively. On Out-of-Period, the policy trained with CA-GRPO retains exact-label accuracy gains over the base model across evaluated checkpoints without injected decision knowledge, while GRPO declines with continued training. CA-GRPO also outperforms the tested fixed reward mixtures on both Out-of-Period metrics.

    中文

    规则约束的情境决策任务要求模型将指定规则应用于特定案例的情境和证据。书面规则可能在决策指导和过程评估方面留下空白，而参考判断对规则和证据的支持程度也各不相同。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 AdaptEvo，这是一种在不完美监督下进行学习的框架，它将置信度自适应策略优化与不断演化的决策知识和评估准则相结合。其训练模块使用置信度自适应 GRPO（CA-GRPO），根据参考置信度平衡结果奖励与过程奖励。其演化模块从训练案例中反复出现的失败中综合出可复用的决策知识，并改进过程准则以检测被忽略的错误。为支持实证评估，我们构建了一个工业级多模态内容审核数据集，其中包含训练集，以及 In-Period 和 Out-of-Period 测试集；后者是在规则变更后收集的。使用 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 时，AdaptEvo 在 In-Period 上的精确标签准确率和二元决策准确率分别达到 61.9% 和 72.2%，分别比 GRPO 高出 7.5 和 3.7 个百分点。在 Out-of-Period 上，使用 CA-GRPO 训练的策略在各个评估检查点上，即使未注入决策知识，精确标签准确率仍高于基础模型；而 GRPO 的表现则随着训练持续而下降。CA-GRPO 在 Out-of-Period 的两项指标上也优于所测试的固定奖励组合。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper adds an editable model that predicts modification outcomes before evaluation, learns from observed results, and transfers predictive knowledge across tasks and domains. This substantially advances agent self-evolution and its organization, with a partial connection to reasoning through improved task solving; it does not analyze internal model mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    本文加入了一个可编辑模型，可在评估前预测修改结果、从观测结果中学习，并将预测知识迁移到不同任务和领域。这显著推进了智能体自我演化及其组织方式，并通过提升任务解决能力与推理有一定联系；但本文没有分析模型内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Self-evolving agents improve through repeated cycles of modification and evaluation. However, existing methods receive feedback on modifications only after costly evaluations, and aggregate scores may obscure distinctions between failures that require different repairs. We introduce predictive self-evolution through an editable Improvement Dynamics Model (IDM). Before evaluation, the IDM predicts task-level outcomes of a proposed modification and guides an optional revision. After evaluation, past modifications and their observed outcomes are used to improve the IDM, allowing predictive knowledge to accumulate across generations. The system can thus improve how it solves tasks, proposes modifications, and predicts their effects. Building on HyperAgents, we evaluate this approach across multilingual coding, paper review, robotics reward design, and Olympiad-level mathematical grading. Our approach outperforms HyperAgents across all four domains, with up to 46% higher average performance over generations. Gains also persist under matched token budgets that include both agent evolution and task evaluation, and extend to held-out tasks. Forecast accuracy improves as the IDM evolves, and the learned predictive knowledge transfers to improve evolution in a new domain.

    自我演化智能体通过反复进行修改和评估来提升表现。然而，现有方法只有在代价高昂的评估完成后才能收到修改反馈，而汇总分数可能掩盖需要不同修复方式的失败之间的差异。我们通过一个可编辑的改进动力学模型（IDM）引入预测式自我演化。评估前，IDM 预测拟议修改在任务层面的结果，并指导可选的修订。评估后，过去的修改及其观测结果会用于改进 IDM，使预测知识能够跨代积累。这样，系统就能改善其解决任务、提出修改以及预测修改效果的方式。我们基于 HyperAgents，在多语言编程、论文评审、机器人奖励设计和奥林匹克级数学评分这四个领域评估了该方法。在所有四个领域中，我们的方法都优于 HyperAgents，跨代平均表现最高提升 46%。在匹配 token 预算的条件下，若将智能体演化和任务评估都计入预算，性能提升仍然存在；而且这种提升也能推广到留出任务。随着 IDM 演化，其预测准确率不断提高；学到的预测知识还可迁移到新领域，改善该领域中的演化过程。

    EV-JEPA: Elastic V-JEPA for Any Device and Cross-Device Inference

    EV-JEPA：适用于任意设备及跨设备推理的弹性 V-JEPA

    Anxhelo Diko, Jieyu Lin, Stefano Ambrogio, Ziyun Li, Mahmoud Assran, Th\'eo Moutakanni, Barbara De Salvo, Chiao Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    EV-JEPA’s main contribution is a training method that enables reconfigurable model width and cross-device execution, with controllable compute, latency, and accuracy trade-offs. This advances model systems; the hybrid paths involve combining widths, but the abstract does not establish a substantive contribution to compositional generalization or reasoning, and it offers no interpretability insight.

    EV-JEPA 的主要贡献是一种训练方法，使模型宽度能够重新配置，并支持跨设备执行，同时可控地权衡计算量、延迟和准确率。这推动了模型系统的发展；混合路径涉及宽度组合，但摘要没有证明其对组合泛化或推理能力有实质贡献，也没有提供可解释性方面的见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Foundation models like V-JEPA are increasingly deployed across a heterogeneous edge-cloud continuum spanning smart glasses, phones, robots, and servers. Yet, they are typically trained as rigid, fixed-capacity networks bound to one device, supporting neither reconfigurable compute budgets nor collaborative execution. Existing approaches address only one axis at a time: slimmable and NAS-based methods provide width elasticity but assume single-device inference, whereas split-computing methods enable cross-device collaboration only for fixed partitions and static capacities. We introduce Elastic V-JEPA (EV-JEPA), a single model trained once and deployable everywhere along the continuum. Its width is reconfigurable, and it is natively partitionable across heterogeneous devices. At its core is Transition-Aware Triplet Training (T3). At each step we pick a narrow and a wide width, and train three paths: each width alone, plus a hybrid path that runs the early layers narrow and the rest wide. The hybrid switch point is where one device hands off to another, so the same weights learn both single-device and cross-device execution. Across various benchmarks, EV-JEPA falls within 1 accuracy point of independently trained baselines while improving over previous elastic training approaches by up to 11 accuracy points. Narrow-to-wide cross-device hybrid execution recovers to within 1.1 points of the highest-capacity standalone model and supports many-to-one, any-to-any, and variable-split configurations. Finally, we show that the elastic principle extends beyond the backbone to an elastic token compression mechanism that exposes controllable trade-offs among on-device computation, latency, and accuracy.

    中文

    像 V-JEPA 这样的基础模型正越来越多地部署在异构的边缘—云端连续体系中，涵盖智能眼镜、手机、机器人和服务器。然而，它们通常被训练成绑定于单一设备、容量固定且不可变的网络，既不支持可重新配置的计算预算，也不支持协同执行。现有方法一次只处理一个维度：可伸缩网络和基于 NAS 的方法提供宽度弹性，但假设在单台设备上推理；而拆分计算方法只支持固定分区和静态容量下的跨设备协作。我们提出 Elastic V-JEPA（EV-JEPA），这是一个只需训练一次、可部署于整个连续体系中任意位置的单一模型。它的宽度可重新配置，并且原生支持在异构设备间进行划分。其核心是 Transition-Aware Triplet Training（T3）。每一步中，我们选取一个窄宽度和一个宽宽度，并训练三条路径：分别以每种宽度单独运行，以及一条混合路径——前几层以窄宽度运行，其余层以宽宽度运行。混合路径的切换点就是一台设备向另一台设备交接的位置，因此相同的权重能够同时学习单设备和跨设备执行。在多个基准测试中，EV-JEPA 的准确率与独立训练的基线相差不超过 1 个百分点，同时比以往的弹性训练方法最多提升 11 个准确率百分点。窄到宽的跨设备混合执行，其表现与容量最高的独立模型相差不超过 1.1 个百分点，并支持多对一、任意对任意以及可变切分配置。最后，我们表明，弹性原则不仅适用于骨干网络，也可扩展到弹性 token 压缩机制，从而在设备端计算、延迟和准确率之间提供可控的权衡。
