    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Decision models answer typed questions about an input with one probability per option, computed in a single forward pass without generating text. Like the fast System 1 of dual-process theory, they answer at once, but their depth is fixed at training time, so they spend the same computation on easy and hard questions. Models that reason in generated text can think longer, but they pay for every extra step in decoded tokens. We present LEV, a decision model that thinks deeper by rerunning its layers in a loop instead of generating tokens. LEV builds on a language model pretrained as a loop, reads the options after every loop step and trains all steps jointly, so one checkpoint can answer at any depth. On three looped backbones, accuracy rises with depth on the same weights, mostly on hard questions, and a 2.6B LEV goes from 63.2% at depth one to 76.2% at depth four on JevBench. On-demand depth, set per question by a small stopper with a threshold fitted on unlabelled requests, saves 15% to 24% of the computation at a cost of under one accuracy point, level with or slightly above a fixed mix of depths. On a locked test set, the 1.4B and 3B models are 5.4 to 8.8 points more accurate than dense (non-looped) models and cascades of the same latency below 50 ms.

    Same Context, Different Agents: A Behavioral Study of Semantic Layers, Orchestration and Compaction in Data Agents

    相同上下文，不同智能体：对数据智能体中语义层、编排与压缩的行为研究

    Zhivar Sourati, Marianne Menglin Liu, Zheng Wang, Rongguang Wang, Sai Ashish Somayajula, Tao Sheng, Kyu J. Han, Sujith Ravi, Dan Roth

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study shows how agent behavior interacts with semantic layers, orchestration, and compaction to affect accuracy and cost, and derives guidance for choosing these techniques. It offers substantial insight into agent organization, while composition and reasoning are secondary behavioral outcomes rather than its main focus.

    这项研究展示了智能体行为如何与语义层、编排和压缩相互作用并影响准确率和成本，并据此提出了选择这些技术的指导建议。它为智能体组织方式提供了重要见解，而组合与推理只是次要的行为结果，并非研究重点。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Answering questions over heterogeneous data means combining evidence from files, databases, documents and the web. Data agents automate this, but their success depends on context. Three context-engineering techniques (CETs) help by shaping it: semantic layers describe the data, orchestration splits work among agents, and compaction condenses interaction history. Existing studies validate each CET alone, leaving open how agent behavior shapes its effect. We present a comprehensive analysis of the three CETs, alone and combined, with seven large language models (LLMs) on 1,514 long-horizon tasks from five benchmarks, covering behavior, accuracy and cost. We find that data agents without CETs form three behavior groups: investigators, premature answerers that answer without inspecting data, and early stoppers that give up. Each CET delivers its known benefit, from more investigation to smaller prompts, but only the behavior group it matches turns that benefit into accuracy, such as premature answerers under orchestration. For investigators, the same CETs can hurt: the semantic layer stops them from looking, orchestration makes them overconfident, costing 5 percentage points, and compaction makes them repeat steps. Combining CETs yields smaller gains and losses than their sum. We derive guidance for choosing CETs by agent behavior, task demands and accuracy-cost trade-offs.

    回答异构数据相关的问题，需要整合来自文件、数据库、文档和网络的证据。数据智能体可以自动完成这项工作，但其成效取决于上下文。三种上下文工程技术（CET）通过塑造上下文发挥作用：语义层描述数据，编排将工作拆分给多个智能体，压缩则浓缩交互历史。现有研究分别验证了每种 CET 的效果，但智能体行为如何影响其效果仍未得到解答。我们对这三种 CET 单独及组合使用的情况进行了全面分析，使用七个大型语言模型（LLM）处理来自五个基准的 1,514 项长时程任务，考察其行为、准确率和成本。我们发现，不使用 CET 的数据智能体可分为三种行为群体：调查者、不检查数据便作答的仓促作答者，以及中途放弃的早停者。每种 CET 都能带来已知益处，从促使更多调查到缩短提示词不等，但只有与之匹配的行为群体才能将这种益处转化为准确率提升，例如，编排有利于仓促作答者。对于调查者，同样的 CET 可能造成负面影响：语义层会阻止他们继续查看数据，编排会让他们变得过度自信，导致准确率下降 5 个百分点，而压缩会使他们重复步骤。组合使用 CET 所带来的收益和损失都小于各项单独效果之和。我们据此提出指导建议，说明如何根据智能体行为、任务需求以及准确率与成本之间的权衡来选择 CET。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    StepSafe trains a guardrail to accumulate step evidence and time interventions in sequential agent tasks, using stage-aligned rewards, self-distillation, and multi-agent red-teaming. This substantially advances reasoning training and agent safety behavior, while multi-agent composition is mainly a data-generation method and no internal model mechanism is analyzed.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Safety in agentic systems is inherently sequential: whether an action is safe depends on prior actions, tool outputs, information disclosures, and interactions among agents. Recent work has shifted agent safety guardrails from post-hoc trajectory-level assessment toward step-level action diagnosis and proactive risk prediction, yet existing training objectives provide limited supervision for how step evidence accumulates over time and when it becomes sufficient to justify intervention. We propose \methodlong~(ASPO): a training framework for step-level timely intervention. Pre-fix level stage alignment allows crediting each decision at its own step: it compares each response with the other responses sampled at the same prefix and rewards the action that fits the stage, continuing before the risk is visible, asking while clarification can still avert harm, and stopping before harm is irreversible. Adaptive feedback self-distillation further credits the reasoning behind each decision, with the model itself as a teacher that sees the step annotations on intervention steps and rules mined from its own false alarms on safe steps. Its training data carry a violation taxonomy and an intervention window at every step and are extended through self-evolving multi-agent red-teaming. Finally we present \textsc{StepSafe}, a step-level reasoning guardrail with timely intervention, that achieves the state-of-the-art peformance among open-source guardrails across five agent-safety benchmarks on safety-utility pareto curve with Youden's $J$ of 53.0 (4B) against 46.2.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large multimodal models have achieved remarkable progress by scaling model capacity and training on massive paired multimodal data. However, this paradigm introduces a fundamental bottleneck: aligned multimodal datasets are expensive to curate, difficult to scale across diverse modality combinations, and increasingly constrain further progress. We introduce Modality Self-Play (MSP), a training framework for multimodal foundation models based on proxy-mediated modality composition. Instead of relying on paired cross-modal data, MSP uses anchor-supporting proxy textual descriptions of unseen modalities as semantic bridges during training. Given an observed modality (e.g., image or audio), the model generates proxy descriptions for complementary unseen modalities, which are then encoded and aligned with the observed modality through learned bridges, enabling cross-modal interaction without real paired non-text supervision. Our central hypothesis is that proxy text, combined with contrastively trained pretrained encoders, provides sufficient semantic structure for multimodal composition to emerge. We show that MSP enables zero-shot modality composition: models trained only with a real anchor modality and accompanying proxy descriptions can integrate and reason over multiple modalities at inference time despite never observing real paired non-text data during training. Empirically, MSP achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance on multiple multimodal benchmarks. Ablation studies further demonstrate that learned bridges improve alignment, while anchor-supporting proxy descriptions enable effective cross-modal composition. MSP removes the need for real paired non-text (e.g., audio-vision) supervision, while continuing to rely on modality-text pairs, pretrained contrastive encoders, and modality-distribution bridge calibration.

    The paper trains a language model to construct and refine compiler optimization scripts, using lossless transformation traces and correctness-aware reinforcement learning, and reports improved correctness and kernel performance.     本文训练语言模型来构建和改进编译器优化脚本，使用无损变换轨迹和考虑正确性的强化学习，并报告了正确性和内核性能的提升。重新组合具有依赖关系的变换并进行迭代改进，与组合泛化和算法问题求解密切相关；GPU 优化则是模型训练的应用，而非对模型—系统架构的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Compiler transformations interact, making GPU kernel optimization a search for combinations that preserve the computation while improving performance. We introduce HOW TO TRAIN YOUR LITTLE DRAGON, a training method that teaches a small language model both to construct complete optimization scripts and to improve existing ones. Instead of ranking candidates or generating kernel code, our model generates optimization scripts. We devise a compact, lossless representation whose deterministic decoding reconstructs the exact compiler trace, preserving its transformation parameters and dependencies. We use a compiler framework TVM MetaSchedule to build training data on 54,116 distinct workloads, and construct 108,594 examples in two training sets: 60,236 teach the model to generate an optimized script from an unoptimized kernel, while 48,358 teach it to produce a better script given the kernel and a somewhat optimized script. Supervised fine-tuning teaches the model to construct and improve optimization scripts from these search-derived examples. We then add reinforcement learning with a shaped reward that combines correctness with measured performance, awarding a latency-based bonus only to numerically correct kernels. We apply this training method to a model with 8 billion parameters. After supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, the model achieves per-attempt correctness of 91.27% for construction and 92.01% for refinement, while reinforcement learning produces faster kernels than supervised training on 88 of 102 construction tasks and 145 of 170 refinement prompts. With only 8B parameters, our LITTLE DRAGON achieves higher per-attempt correctness and better kernel performance than six frontier LLMs: GPT-6 Astra, Opus 5, Kimi-K3, and GLM-5.3 among them, each with hundreds of billions to trillions of parameters, for which task-specific training is unavailable or expensive.

    中文

    编译器变换会相互作用，因此 GPU 内核优化需要搜索既能保持计算不变又能提升性能的变换组合。我们提出 HOW TO TRAIN YOUR LITTLE DRAGON，这是一种训练方法，教会小型语言模型构建完整的优化脚本并改进已有脚本。我们的模型生成的是优化脚本，而非对候选方案排序或生成内核代码。我们设计了一种紧凑且无损的表示，其确定性解码能够重建精确的编译器轨迹，并保留其中的变换参数及其依赖关系。我们使用编译器框架 TVM MetaSchedule，在 54,116 个不同工作负载上构建训练数据，并创建 108,594 个样例，分为两个训练集：其中 60,236 个样例教模型从未优化的内核生成优化脚本，另外 48,358 个样例教模型根据内核和一份已有一定优化程度的脚本生成更好的脚本。监督微调利用这些来自搜索的样例，教会模型构建和改进优化脚本。随后，我们加入强化学习，采用结合正确性与实测性能的塑形奖励，且只有数值正确的内核才能获得基于延迟的奖励加成。我们将这种训练方法用于一个拥有 80 亿参数的模型。经过监督微调和强化学习后，该模型在构建任务上的单次尝试正确率达到 91.27%，在改进任务上达到 92.01%；在 102 个构建任务和 170 个改进提示中的 88 个和 145 个上，强化学习生成的内核比监督训练生成的内核更快。我们的 LITTLE DRAGON 只有 8B 个参数，却在单次尝试正确率和内核性能方面超过了六个前沿 LLM，其中包括 GPT-6 Astra、Opus 5、Kimi-K3 和 GLM-5.3；这些模型各自拥有数千亿至数万亿参数，但针对具体任务进行训练并不可行或成本高昂。

    Do As I Do, Not As I Say: On-Policy Distillation Inherits the Teacher in Vision-Language Models

    照我做，别听我说：视觉语言模型中的在线策略蒸馏会继承教师模型的行为

    Frank F. Yang, Kefei Yan, Yiren Wang, Yiyang Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies how on-policy distillation transfers teacher reliability and completion failures, finding that incomplete teacher trajectories can erase student completion behavior and that filtering helps. This is a substantial empirical contribution to training reasoning capabilities; trajectory use and supervision are incidental to agent systems, while the abstract does not address compositional generalization or internal mechanisms.

    本文研究在线策略蒸馏如何传递教师模型的可靠性和完成失败，发现教师轨迹不完整会抹去学生的完成行为，而筛选示范则有帮助。这是对推理能力训练的重要实证贡献；轨迹使用和监督对智能体系统而言只是附带因素，摘要也未涉及组合泛化或内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Improving the reasoning capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) often relies on post-training with supervision from stronger models. Two common strategies are supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which trains on teacher-generated demonstrations, and on-policy distillation (OPD), which provides teacher feedback on trajectories generated by the student itself. While OPD can be more data-efficient by supervising student-generated trajectories, it is unclear how the teacher's supervision at each state affects the student's learned behavior. To study this question, we conduct a controlled comparison of OPD and filtered SFT across data budgets and tasks where the teacher exhibits different levels of reliability, and analyze how these differences shape student accuracy and completion behavior. Across the two tasks, we find that OPD is effective only when the teacher remains reliable on student-generated trajectories. On ChartQA, where the teacher completes 99% of its solutions, OPD trained on only 10% of the data comes within 1.4 accuracy points of full-data SFT. In contrast, on Geometry3K, where the teacher fails to complete 22% of its solutions, OPD underperforms SFT by 7.9 points, with most of the gap explained by incomplete responses. More strikingly, starting OPD from an SFT student reduces its completion rate from 76% to 62%, effectively erasing the completion behavior learned through SFT. Filtering teacher demonstrations for completeness alone recovers much of SFT's advantage. These results show that on-policy supervision can transfer not only teacher knowledge but also persistent failure modes on student-visited states. Code is available at https://github.com/ffy208/opd-inherits-teacher-vlm.

    中文

    提升视觉语言模型（VLM）的推理能力，通常依赖于使用更强模型提供的监督进行后训练。两种常见策略是监督微调（SFT），即使用教师模型生成的示范进行训练；以及在线策略蒸馏（OPD），即针对学生模型自身生成的轨迹提供教师反馈。OPD 通过监督学生生成的轨迹，可能更节省数据，但教师在每个状态提供的监督会如何影响学生学到的行为，仍不清楚。为研究这一问题，我们在不同数据预算下，对 OPD 和经过筛选的 SFT 进行受控比较，并选取教师可靠程度不同的任务，分析这些差异如何影响学生的准确率和完成率。在两个任务中，我们发现，只有教师在学生生成的轨迹上仍保持可靠时，OPD 才有效。在 ChartQA 上，教师能完成 99% 的解答；只使用 10% 的数据训练的 OPD，准确率与使用全部数据的 SFT 相差不到 1.4 个百分点。相比之下，在 Geometry3K 上，教师有 22% 的解答无法完成；OPD 的表现比 SFT 低 7.9 个百分点，且差距主要由未完成的回答造成。更值得注意的是，从一个 SFT 学生模型开始进行 OPD，会使其完成率从 76% 降至 62%，实际上抹去了 SFT 学到的完成行为。仅按完整性筛选教师示范，就能恢复 SFT 的大部分优势。这些结果表明，在线策略监督不仅会传递教师知识，还可能传递学生所访问状态上的持续性失败模式。代码见 https://github.com/ffy208/opd-inherits-teacher-vlm。

    Failure Is the Mother of Success: Recovering Supervision with Grounding Hindsight

    失败乃成功之母：通过基于落地验证的回溯恢复监督信号

    Sheldon Yu, Tong Yu, Nikki Lijing Kuang, Zhendong Chu, Zhenwei Tang, Sungchul Kim, Lina Yao, Julian McAuley, Junda Wu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    RSHD converts failed reasoning attempts into screened supervision by testing corrective notes through fresh replays, improving GRPO across domains and model sizes. It advances training for problem-solving, but the abstract does not establish a composition or agent-systems contribution; deployment needs no additional system components.

    RSHD 通过对纠正说明进行新的回放测试，把失败的推理尝试转化为经过筛选的监督信号，并在不同领域和模型规模上提升了 GRPO 的表现。它推进了问题求解训练，但摘要未证明其对组合能力或智能体系统作出了贡献；部署时无需额外系统组件。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    When every rollout for a problem fails, GRPO receives neither a successful exemplar nor a nonzero group-relative advantage, so it learns nothing from exactly the problems it most needs to learn. The failed reasoning can nevertheless suggest what to try next. We present Replay-Selected Hindsight Distillation (RSHD), which turns failed attempts into an additional, tested source of supervision during GRPO training. The policy writes a corrective note about each failed attempt without seeing a reference answer or solution, then re-solves the problem with the note in context. A note is admitted only if its replays succeed more often than the original group did, after screening for notes that state the answer, and an admitted replay is distilled into the plain-prompt policy. Because admission is decided by fresh successes rather than by the failed rollout itself, the procedure can recover supervision from groups in which every attempt failed, and it applies equally to failures in mixed groups. Only the policy is trained, the only judge is the outcome verifier, and deployment requires no notes or extra inference. Across model families and sizes and two training domains, RSHD consistently improves over GRPO on in-domain benchmarks, and the gains carry over to out-of-domain evaluation sets.

    中文

    当一个问题的所有 rollout 都失败时，GRPO 既没有成功示例，也得不到非零的组相对优势，因此恰恰无法从最需要学习的问题中学到任何东西。然而，失败的推理仍可能提示下一步该尝试什么。我们提出回放筛选式事后蒸馏（RSHD），在 GRPO 训练期间将失败尝试转化为一种额外且经过检验的监督来源。策略模型在看不到参考答案或解法的情况下，为每次失败尝试写下一条纠正说明，然后在提示中加入该说明，再次解答问题。只有当加入说明后的回放成功率高于原始组时，才会接纳该说明；同时还要筛除直接给出答案的说明。接纳的回放随后被蒸馏到使用普通提示词的策略中。由于是否接纳取决于新尝试的成功结果，而非失败 rollout 本身，这一过程可以从所有尝试均失败的组中恢复监督信号，也同样适用于混合组中的失败案例。训练对象只有策略模型，唯一的评判者是结果验证器，部署时无需说明或额外推理。在不同模型系列和规模以及两个训练领域中，RSHD 在领域内基准上的表现始终优于 GRPO，且收益也延续到了领域外评估集。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    AURA directly supervises intermediate reasoning and adaptively selects reasoning depth to improve retrieval efficiency, a substantial reasoning contribution.     AURA 直接监督中间推理，并自适应选择推理深度以提高检索效率，是一项重要的推理贡献。前缀条件化细化与组合泛化只有偶然关联，而效用估计器属于有限的系统层面贡献，并非新的模型或智能体组织方式。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reasoning-conditioned embeddings can improve retrieval by progressively refining semantic constraints. However, additional reasoning may introduce over-generalized or semantically noisy abstractions that weaken retrieval specificity. Existing methods largely supervise reasoning through final retrieval outcomes, providing limited guidance over the refinement process itself. We propose AURA, a framework that directly supervises intermediate reasoning states according to how well they separate relevant documents from hard distractors. AURA further trains a lightweight utility estimator over prefix-conditioned embeddings to adapt reasoning depth at inference time. On the reasoning-intensive BRIGHT benchmark, AURA-4B achieves 34.7 average nDCG@10 while using 2.8 reasoning steps and 96 generated tokens per query. Under matched deployment conditions, adaptive stopping reduces latency from 4.6 to 0.76 seconds relative to full-trajectory reasoning. Results on MS MARCO further suggest that this specialization need not substantially degrade conventional in-domain retrieval.

    中文

    推理条件化嵌入可以通过逐步细化语义约束来提升检索效果。然而，额外推理可能引入过度泛化或语义噪声较大的抽象，削弱检索的精确性。现有方法主要依据最终检索结果来监督推理，对细化过程本身提供的指导有限。我们提出 AURA，这一框架根据中间推理状态区分相关文档与困难干扰项的效果，直接对这些状态进行监督。AURA 还会在前缀条件化嵌入上训练一个轻量级效用估计器，以便在推理时自适应调整推理深度。在侧重推理的 BRIGHT 基准上，AURA-4B 的平均 nDCG@10 达到 34.7，每个查询使用 2.8 个推理步骤和 96 个生成 token。在部署条件相同的情况下，与完整轨迹推理相比，自适应停止将延迟从 4.6 秒降至 0.76 秒。MS MARCO 上的结果进一步表明，这种专门化并不一定会显著损害常规领域内检索表现。

    Recursive Reward Improvement via Adversarial Meta-Prompt Evolution

    通过对抗式元提示演化实现递归奖励改进

    Wei Dai, Qianchu Liu, Guanghui Qin, Xing Han, Tristan Naumann, Paul Pu Liang, Sheng Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    RRI improves reinforcement-learning training for open-ended expert tasks by adversarially finding and repairing flaws in generated rubrics, with gains on held-out benchmarks. This is a substantial contribution to training and evaluating task-solving capability, but the abstract does not study internal reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization; the proposer-solver loop is incidental to model-system design.

    RRI 通过对生成的评分细则进行对抗性漏洞发现与修复，改进了开放式专家任务的强化学习训练，并在留出基准上取得提升。这是对任务求解能力训练与评估的一项重要贡献，但摘要没有研究内部推理机制或组合泛化；提议者—求解者循环只是模型系统设计的一部分。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) has gained wide attention for its ability to work with limited data. In a proposer-solver loop, a proposer model writes training tasks and a solver model learns to solve them through reinforcement learning. Such loops have succeeded in mathematics and coding, where every answer can be checked automatically. Open-ended expert tasks, like clinical report generations, have no answer key, which makes simple question-answer generation not viable. Here the proposer must also write a rubric that lists the content an answer should include and the errors it should avoid. However, the unique challenge behind model-written rubric is the comprehensiveness of it. For naively generated rubric, solvers tend to exploit it, naming the expected topics without the substance behind them, which corrupts the learning process. To solve this problem, we introduce RRI, Recursive Reward Improvement, which uses a reward hacking adversary to supervise the reward. Before the solver trains on a generated task, an adversary writes an answer that games its rubric while being as useless as possible, the same model writes an honest answer without seeing the rubric, and up to two repair steps revise the rubric to make the honest answer win. The exploits found also rewrite how future tasks and rubrics are generated. On HealthBench Professional, RRI improves the adjusted score over the Generation Only self-improvement baseline by 10.9 points at 9B and 12.4 at 27B, and by 10.3 points without any external model. In particular, the gains are largest on difficult and writing tasks. We show that the 27B model trained on the HealthBench Professional description improves by 6.6 points on PRBench Hard and 8.0 on ProfBench without seeing a task from either. We further analyze the exploitable points of model-generated question-rubric pairs to facilitate future research on open-ended self-play.

    中文

    递归自我改进（RSI）因其能够在数据有限的情况下发挥作用而广受关注。在提议者—求解者循环中，提议者模型编写训练任务，求解者模型则通过强化学习学习解决这些任务。这类循环已在数学和编程领域取得成功，因为每个答案都可以自动核验。临床报告生成等开放式专家任务没有标准答案，因此简单的问答生成并不可行。在这种情况下，提议者还必须编写评分细则，列出答案应包含的内容以及应避免的错误。然而，模型编写的评分细则面临的独特挑战在于其全面性。对于草率生成的评分细则，求解者往往会钻空子，只提及预期主题，却不提供实质内容，从而破坏学习过程。为解决这一问题，我们提出 RRI（递归奖励改进），通过奖励投机对抗者来监督奖励。在求解者针对生成的任务进行训练之前，对抗者会编写一个尽可能无用、却能钻评分细则空子的答案；同一模型还会在看不到评分细则的情况下编写一个诚实答案；随后最多进行两轮修订，修改评分细则以使诚实答案胜出。发现的漏洞还会用于改写后续任务和评分细则的生成方式。在 HealthBench Professional 上，与仅生成式自我改进基线相比，RRI 在 9B 模型上将调整后得分提高了 10.9 分，在 27B 模型上提高了 12.4 分；即使不使用任何外部模型，也提高了 10.3 分。尤其是在高难度任务和写作任务上，提升最大。我们还表明，在 HealthBench Professional 描述上训练的 27B 模型，在未见过 PRBench Hard 或 ProfBench 中任何任务的情况下，分别提升了 6.6 分和 8.0 分。我们进一步分析模型生成的问答—评分细则对中可被利用的弱点，以推动开放式自我博弈的后续研究。

    Mohamed Abouzahra

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper evaluates how curriculum coverage relates to rule-specific withdrawal failures in tool-using agents, including transfer to held-out dependency families and structural combinations, and proposes diagnostics that reveal regressions hidden by aggregate accuracy. This strongly advances compositional generalization evaluation and agent behavior, while its focus on learned rule performance gives a partial connection to reasoning rather than a direct account of reasoning mechanisms.

    本文评估课程覆盖与使用工具的智能体中规则特定撤回失误之间的关系，包括向留出的依赖族和结构组合迁移，并提出了能揭示整体准确率所掩盖退化的诊断方法。这有力推进了组合泛化评估和智能体行为研究；其重点是已学规则的表现，因此与推理有部分关联，但并未直接阐释推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Tool-using language agents must revise prepared actions when evidence changes or authority is revoked. Selective withdrawal means suspending affected actions, preserving supported work, and resuming only after sufficient repair. We study supervised fine-tuning in NAQD-Env, a synthetic environment with explicit dependencies and a deterministic reference policy. Four LoRA checkpoints of Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct compare an original curriculum with an enriched one, the latter under three system-prompt framings with identical views and targets. Three instruction-tuned baselines and all four checkpoints are evaluated under three inference prompts on fresh validation cases, held-out dependency families, and held-out structural combinations. Under the naqd prompt, SFT checkpoints reach decision agreement of 0.77-0.92 and withdrawal recall of 0.46-0.86, versus 0.45-0.63 and at most 0.06 for the baselines. Rule-level diagnostics qualify these gains. The original-curriculum checkpoint wrongly withdraws 26 of 34 actions with surviving alternative support; enriched checkpoints withdraw 0-1. Conversely, all SFT checkpoints narrow prohibited combinations less often than the 7B and 8B baselines, a case absent from both curricula. Delegation results show more withdrawal but poorer preservation of independently authorized actions, and all four checkpoints omit valid event reports. Framing contrasts vary across metrics and splits and do not establish a reproducible advantage or equivalence. One training run per arm, jointly changed curriculum properties, prior evaluation exposure, and baseline-SFT quantization differences limit causal attribution. The contribution is a method for detecting rule-specific regressions that aggregate accuracy can conceal, not evidence that fine-tuning alone ensures agent safety.

    中文

    使用工具的语言智能体必须在证据变化或权限撤销时修订已准备好的行动。选择性撤回意味着暂停受影响的行动、保留有依据的工作，并且只有在充分修正后才恢复行动。我们在 NAQD-Env 中研究监督微调；这是一个依赖关系明确且具有确定性参考策略的合成环境。我们使用 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 的四个 LoRA 检查点，对比原始课程与扩充课程；扩充课程采用三种系统提示措辞，但观察内容和目标相同。我们在三个推理提示下，使用新鲜验证案例、留出的依赖族以及留出的结构组合，对三个指令微调基线和全部四个检查点进行评估。在 naqd 提示下，SFT 检查点的决策一致率达到 0.77–0.92，撤回召回率达到 0.46–0.86；相比之下，基线分别为 0.45–0.63 和最高 0.06。规则层面的诊断对这些提升作出了限定。原始课程检查点错误撤回了 34 项行动中的 26 项，而这些行动仍有其他有效依据；扩充课程检查点则撤回 0–1 项。相反，对于两种课程中都未出现的情形，所有 SFT 检查点缩减被禁止组合的频率都低于 7B 和 8B 基线。委派实验显示，撤回次数更多，但对独立授权行动的保留情况更差；此外，四个检查点都遗漏了有效事件报告。不同提示措辞的对比结果因指标和数据划分而异，无法证明存在可复现的优势或等效性。每个实验组只有一次训练运行、课程属性同时发生变化、先前接触过评估数据，以及基线与 SFT 的量化方式不同，这些因素限制了因果归因。这项工作的贡献是一种检测规则特定退化的方法，这类退化可能被整体准确率掩盖；它并未证明仅靠微调就能确保智能体安全。

    Athanor 展示了自主智能体如何开展后训练研究，其持久化记录、托管作业和智能体间协作构成了重要的系统贡献。训练方法是对已知技术的重新组合，但摘要没有深入揭示组合泛化或推理机制本身。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recursive self-improvement, in which AI systems build stronger AI systems, is one promising route to superintelligence. We study a weaker form that can be measured today: frontier agents post-training a small raw base model with public data, as a test of their research potential. We build Athanor, an open agent-native system for autonomous post-training research (AutoPostTrain) on real GPUs. We give the agents full research autonomy, low-friction engineering tools, and efficient starter code. The agents carry out the research themselves: they read datasets and evaluation results, build their training data, write and modify training algorithms, tune hyperparameters, and analyze the results to decide what to try next. They work in a sandbox and cannot use external teacher models. Athanor's services supply frozen evaluation, managed jobs, decontaminated data, a persistent research record, and a held-out suite the agents are unaware of. In a 104-hour campaign, a team of four Claude Opus 5.5 agents, each on an eight-GPU node and given no research advice, improves Qwen3-4B-Base from 15.9 to 67.3 on a six-task development suite and from 9.2 to 48.2 on a held-out suite, against 66.5 and 47.9 for the official Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration that a team of frontier agents can autonomously post-train a raw base model into a cross-domain generalist model that matches or surpasses the official instruct version on average. The campaign's full record shows that the agents reach this level by recombining known methods and each other's models: SFT on public reasoning data, RL with a rollout change one agent introduced, weight merges across agents, and rounds of self-distillation. With execution handled, today's agents already have the engineering and research ability to conquer this task. We hope Athanor provides a foundation for scaling autonomous AI research.

    Probe-and-Resume: When and How to Evaluate Agent Execution

    Probe-and-Resume：何时以及如何评估智能体执行情况

    Jiakai Xu, Tiancheng Ge, Tujie Guan, Yusheng Li, Rohan Timmaraju, Eugene Wu, Kostis Kaffes

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies critic reliability during agent search and proposes probing a forked computer state at claimed completion, allowing the agent to resume after rejection; this improves task success and reduces cost versus conventional MCTS critics. It advances agent execution and tool organization, while reasoning is a secondary focus on when to evaluate trajectories; the abstract provides no evidence about internal model mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    本文研究智能体搜索过程中评论器的可靠性，并提出在智能体声称完成任务时探查计算机状态副本；若结果被拒绝，智能体可以继续执行。与传统 MCTS 评论器相比，该方法提升了任务成功率并降低了成本。本文推进了智能体执行与工具组织研究，而推理只是次要关注点，主要涉及何时评估轨迹；摘要没有提供有关模型内部机制或组合泛化的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Test-time search can improve agent performance by exploring alternative actions and using a critic to select promising branches. We study this approach in terminal-based computer-use environments, which expose only a partial view of a large underlying state, and find that the Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS) configuration we evaluate does not significantly improve task success. We identify two sources of poor critic performance: the agent's observations omit environment state needed for evaluation, and intermediate states offer limited evidence of whether a trajectory will succeed. At intermediate states, critics rank continuations only modestly better than chance, and environment access improves this little. We study when to invoke a critic and what access to give it to evaluate a node. Our findings motivate a policy that invokes the critic only at nodes the agent believes are final, rather than during partial progress. Further, the policy gives the critic read, write, and execute access to a fork of the computer's current and initial state, allowing it to probe and perform potentially destructive actions to surface any hidden state the trajectory omits. We call the resulting design Probe-and-Resume: when the agent claims to be done, the critic probes a fork of its state, and a rejected agent resumes where it stopped. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, this raises success by 8.4 percentage points over MCTS with conventional critics, and approaches the success rate of the Codex CLI agent with the same underlying model at less than half its cost.

    中文

    测试时搜索可以通过探索替代行动并使用评论器选择有希望的分支来提升智能体性能。我们在基于终端的计算机使用环境中研究这种方法；这类环境只展示大型底层状态的部分视图。我们发现，所评估的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）配置并未显著提升任务成功率。我们找出评论器表现不佳的两个原因：智能体的观察中缺少评估所需的环境状态信息，而中间状态提供的轨迹能否成功的证据有限。在中间状态下，评论器对后续行动的排序仅略好于随机水平，而提供环境访问权限也只带来微小改善。我们研究了何时调用评论器，以及应赋予评论器何种访问权限来评估节点。研究结果促使我们采用一种策略：只在智能体认为已经完成任务的节点调用评论器，而不在部分进展期间调用。此外，该策略赋予评论器对计算机当前状态和初始状态副本的读取、写入和执行权限，使其能够进行探查并执行可能具有破坏性的操作，以揭示轨迹遗漏的任何隐藏状态。我们将这一设计称为 Probe-and-Resume：当智能体声称任务已完成时，评论器会探查其状态副本；如果拒绝该结果，智能体便从停止处继续执行。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，与使用传统评论器的 MCTS 相比，该方法将成功率提高了 8.4 个百分点；其成功率接近使用相同底层模型的 Codex CLI 智能体，而成本不到后者的一半。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a controlled benchmark showing how tool menus and harness budgets affect tool-agent performance, with truncation explaining much of the menu penalty.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The success score of a tool agent reflects both its model and the budgets of the harness that runs it. We present ToolBottleneckBench, a benchmark that measures tool-agent performance under controlled pressures and fixed harness budgets. Synthetic enterprise tasks stay fixed while one pressure varies: the registered tool catalog, the visible tool menu, the certified workflow, or the encoding of returned records. An exact grader records the first unmet obligation of each failed episode and the harness limit, if any, that ended it. Across 21 model and harness configurations, the visible menu is the only one of the three pressures that act on the model with a large penalty, and this penalty tracks truncation at the completion cap. Raising the cap sixteenfold removes most of the penalty in the truncation-heavy configurations. Most failures end at a harness limit, and the failure record identifies the assigned pressure no more reliably than a count of tool calls. The repairs that help change which tools reach the model or who issues the calls, and only two repairs, neither improving model behavior, beat every configuration switch. We recommend reporting pressure effects with the harness budgets under which they were measured. We release the benchmark at https://github.com/zichuanxu/tool-bottleneck-bench.

    Kolab: Benchmarking Human-Agent Collaboration in Long-Horizon Workflows

    Kolab：长期工作流中的人机协作基准

    Shirley Anugrah Hayati, Patricia Anugrah Setiani, Ruizi Wang, Zhouyi Li, Khanh Chi Le, Young-Jun Lee, Dongyeop Kang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Kolab contributes a dataset and benchmark for forecasting how professionals use agent contributions and assessing collaboration quality in long-horizon workflows. This is a substantial study of human-agent systems, while its evaluation of agent judgments does not directly advance reasoning mechanisms, composition, or model internals.

    Kolab 提供了一个数据集和基准，用于预测专业人士如何使用智能体的贡献，以及评估长期工作流中的协作质量。这是对人机系统的一项重要研究；但其对智能体判断的评估并未直接推进推理机制、组合能力或模型内部研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    When humans collaborate with AI agents on long-horizon tasks, what happens to the agents' contributions? For solving long-horizon tasks, humans place greater importance on ongoing interaction with AI agents (e.g., revising plans) than on an agent's ability to complete the task in a single attempt. However, most agentic benchmarks have focused more on automation. Strong performance on such benchmarks does not imply effective real-world collaboration. Professional workflows offer a useful setting, as they often involve interdependent steps. To address this gap, we introduce Kolab, a new dataset of 115+ hours of screen recordings of 50 professionals from 40 occupations collaborating with agents on realistic, long-horizon problems. Kolab also contains participants' collaboration and output quality judgments. Our analysis reveals diverse collaboration patterns, highlighting the importance of when and how professionals coordinate with agents. A collaborative agent must do two things that automation benchmarks never test: anticipate whether experts will adopt, modify, or reject its contribution once it leaves the chat window to guide its next steps, and assess collaboration quality from the unfolding workflow without constant expert feedback. Our benchmark operationalizes both: (1) forecasting how professionals use agent contributions at diverse workflows, and (2) verifying their judgments of collaboration satisfaction and output quality. Findings show that frontier models, both agentic and non-agentic, overestimate collaboration with experts and struggle to distinguish between high- and low-quality collaboration. Longer workflow context does not consistently improve these predictions. As frontier agents cannot yet understand long-horizon collaboration with experts, we position Kolab as a valuable dataset for studying human-agent collaboration grounded in real professional workflows.

    中文

    在人类与 AI 智能体协作完成长期任务时，智能体的贡献会产生什么影响？为解决长期任务，人们认为与 AI 智能体持续互动（例如修订计划）比智能体一次性完成任务的能力更重要。然而，大多数智能体基准更侧重自动化。在这些基准上表现出色，并不意味着能够有效开展现实世界协作。专业工作流提供了一个有用的研究场景，因为其中通常包含相互依赖的步骤。为弥补这一空缺，我们推出 Kolab，这是一个新数据集，包含 50 名来自 40 个职业的专业人士与智能体协作解决真实长期问题的 115 小时以上屏幕录制内容。Kolab 还包含参与者对协作质量和产出质量的判断。我们的分析揭示了多种协作模式，凸显了专业人士与智能体在何时以及如何协调的重要性。协作型智能体必须做到两点，而自动化基准从未测试过：预测专家离开聊天窗口后会采纳、修改还是拒绝其贡献，并据此指导后续步骤；以及在没有专家持续反馈的情况下，根据不断展开的工作流评估协作质量。我们的基准将这两项能力具体化：(1) 预测专业人士在不同工作流中如何使用智能体的贡献；(2) 检验其对协作满意度和产出质量的判断。研究发现，前沿模型无论是否具有智能体能力，都会高估与专家的协作效果，并且难以区分高质量与低质量协作。更长的工作流上下文并不能持续改善这些预测。由于前沿智能体尚不能理解与专家的长期协作，我们将 Kolab 定位为研究人机协作的宝贵数据集，其基础是真实的专业工作流。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SSR introduces a deterministic retrieval method that uses structural signals and an inverted index to reduce candidate context, latency, and orchestration failures in multi-agent systems. Its contribution is a transferable systems algorithm; the reported efficiency and retrieval gains do not address model internals, compositional generalization, or reasoning.

    SSR 提出一种确定性检索方法，利用结构信号和倒排索引来减少多智能体系统中的候选上下文、延迟和编排故障。其贡献是一种可迁移的系统算法；报告的效率和检索效果提升并未涉及模型内部机制、组合泛化或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large-scale multi-agent ecosystems require mechanisms for discovering suitable agents without exposing entire registries to a large language model (LLM) orchestrator. The challenge is not only to retrieve relevant Agent Cards from a growing registry, but also to maintain a compact candidate context, since each additional candidate increases prompt size, inference cost, latency, and the risk of exceeding the model context window. We formulate this problem as candidate-context scalability and propose the Structural Signal Retriever (SSR), our deterministic and training-free retrieval method designed for Agent Card discovery. SSR derives structural lexical signals from capability-bearing Agent Card fields, weights them using inverse document frequency (IDF), and uses an Inverted Signal Index (ISI) for selective candidate scoring. We evaluate SSR using a synthetic agent benchmark, a public MS MARCO adaptation, and end-to-end LLM orchestration. At 1,000 agents, SSR reduces LLM input by 98.8% and orchestration latency by 70.9% relative to full-catalog orchestration. On MS MARCO, IDF improves retrieval effectiveness within the structural representation, while the ISI preserves retrieval effectiveness and reduces explicitly scored passages by 96.8%. End-to-end experiments show that candidate pre-selection maintains a compact candidate context as registry size grows and avoids the operational failures observed with full-catalog orchestration. These results support SSR as an Agent-Card-native, traceable retrieval mechanism for candidate-context scalability.

    中文

    Sparse KV compression reduces long-context inference costs by retaining selected historical states, yet these states typically keep their coordinates from the full history. Under Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE), gaps left by evicted tokens continue to affect query-key matching, potentially limiting the use of retained evidence. We study post-selection positional geometry on a fixed selector-produced cache, examining how positional organization affects the use of retained information and which coordinate and continuation rules improve answer quality. To reorganize this geometry, we propose RoPERelay, which assigns compact, order-preserving RoPE coordinates, relocates cached key phases through inverse rotation and re-rotation, and synchronizes the current query and subsequent generation. It reuses existing K/V without renewed selection, historical re-prefill, or additional cache budget. Across 36 comparisons spanning two models, six sparse selectors, and three long-term memory tasks, RoPERelay improves answer quality in 32 cases. For Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with BM25 on LongMemEval-S, accuracy increases from 23.6% to 35.4%. Measured complete-request time overhead is approximately 1%-3% in the evaluated configurations.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ECI2D tests generated rationales by turning them into executable programs and intervening on logically similar samples, improving reasoning-task performance under distribution shift.     ECI2D 将生成的理由转化为可执行程序，并通过在逻辑上相似的样本上进行干预来检验这些理由，从而提升分布偏移下的推理任务表现。这为验证推理示例提供了一种实质性方法，但它没有研究模型内部，也未在组合表征或系统方面确立更广泛的进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Self-generated In-Context Learning (ICL) enables LLMs to synthesize their own few-shot demonstrations, often outperforming manual prompts. However, existing methods filter demonstrations by observation, assuming a rationale is high-quality if it leads to the correct output. We show such filtering suffers from \textit{observational equivalence}, whereby both faithful causal rationales and spurious post-hoc rationales can yield same outputs and are statistically indistinguishable from observation alone. Inspired by independent causal mechanisms, we argue that faithful rationales imply \textit{transfer invariance}, in which causal rationales should remain effective across logically similar samples. We instantiate this criterion as \textbf{E}xecutable \textbf{C}ausal \textbf{I}ntervention for \textbf{D}emonstrations \textbf{D}istillation (ECI2D), which abstracts language rationales into executable programs and applies the causal interventions ($do$-operator) on logically similar samples, retaining only those demonstrations that imply transfer invariance. Experiments on math, logical and commonsense reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that ECI2D consistently outperforms observation-based ICL while retaining far fewer demonstrations, with gains exceeding 7 points as the test distribution shifts.

    自生成上下文学习（ICL）使 LLM 能够合成自己的少样本示例，效果往往优于人工提示。然而，现有方法依据观察筛选示例，假设只要某个理由能导出正确输出，它就是高质量的。我们表明，这种筛选受到\textit{观察等价性}的影响：忠实的因果理由和虚假的事后理由都可能产生相同输出，因此仅凭观察在统计上无法区分。受独立因果机制的启发，我们认为，忠实的理由意味着\textit{迁移不变性}，即因果理由在逻辑上相似的样本上应仍然有效。我们将这一准则具体化为面向示例蒸馏的\textbf{可执行因果干预}（ECI2D）：该方法将语言理由抽象为可执行程序，并在逻辑上相似的样本上施加因果干预（$do$算子），只保留能够体现迁移不变性的示例。在数学、逻辑和常识推理基准上的实验表明，ECI2D 始终优于基于观察的 ICL，同时保留的示例少得多；当测试分布发生偏移时，性能提升超过 7 分。

MASP represents the user's evolving mental state with a BDI based latent state, separates reward side teacher mentalization from policy side student mentalization, and alternates self play updates for the system and user policies. This turns robustness to rational resistance into a training objective rather than only an evaluation condition.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    BCL balances estimated batch costs within rank-local data-loader windows, reducing idle time in distributed training without cross-rank coordination.     BCL 在 rank 本地数据加载器窗口内均衡估算批次成本，在不进行跨 rank 协调的情况下减少分布式训练中的空闲时间。这是对训练效率的实质性系统贡献，但摘要未报告模型机制、组合能力或推理方面的进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Synchronous data-parallel training usually assigns every rank the same number of records, even when record costs vary by orders of magnitude. For variable-length models, this converts input variation into idle time because each step waits for its most expensive rank-local batch. We present Batch Cost Lookahead (BCL), a coordination-free data-loading policy that buffers a bounded rank-local window and repartitions it into fixed-cardinality packs with balanced estimated cost. BCL preserves the trainer's record-count contract and requires neither cross-rank metadata exchange nor runtime modification. In simulation over public workload distributions, enabling BCL reduces per-rank estimated batch-cost variability by up to 82.8%. Across 13 NeMo-RL SFT corpora on eight H200 GPUs, rank-local BCL runs 1.050 to 1.167 times faster than pooled MFFD. Compiled H200 measurements on an internal sequence workload show speedups of 1.197 to 1.343 times over packed execution from one to four nodes. We also identify a memory-feasibility boundary: a p99 cap for high-variance or OOM-prone data bounds outliers before BCL balances the rest. These results show that substantial variable-cost imbalance can be removed at the data-loader boundary, while clarifying when data preparation or broader coordination is still necessary.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The survey frames context compression as inference-time memory management and contributes a lifecycle framework and budgeted cost model for memory operations. Its connection to interpretability is incidental; its main focus is memory allocation and management in model systems.

    本综述将上下文压缩框定为推理时记忆管理问题，并提出记忆操作的生命周期框架和预算化成本模型。它与可解释性的联系只是附带的；其重点是模型系统中的记忆分配与管理。

    ENGLISH

    Long-context capability has become essential for large language models (LLMs) to handle complex tasks, yet continuously expanding the context window does not remove the computational, storage, and information-selection pressures incurred at inference time. Existing work on prompt compression, KV-cache management, efficient serving, retrieval augmentation, and agent memory is usually discussed in isolation, leaving the flow of information between storage and computation insufficiently understood. This survey reframes long-context compression as a memory-management problem for allocating inference-time resources. We distinguish compute-active memory, which directly participates in model computation, from compute-inactive memory, which lies outside the computation path but can be stored, retrieved, updated, or forgotten, and we characterize offloaded KV caches, persistent prefix caches, and precomputed KV states as intermediate states on the activation path. On this basis, we formulate writing, offloading, recall, retrieval-and-injection, materialization, eviction, consolidation, and forgetting as state transitions within an information lifecycle, and introduce a budgeted cost model that places these operations in a single cost account. The resulting framework unifies short-term context compression, long-term memory management, and the transitions between them, and shows that the central challenge is not merely reducing information volume but deciding which information should participate in costly inference, when, and in what form. We further summarize evaluation dimensions, benchmark gaps, and open challenges, and argue that future research should move from static, pointwise compression toward dynamic, governable, lifecycle-aware memory management.

    长上下文能力已成为大型语言模型（LLM）处理复杂任务的关键，但持续扩大上下文窗口并不能消除推理时产生的计算、存储和信息筛选压力。现有关于提示压缩、KV 缓存管理、高效服务、检索增强和智能体记忆的工作通常彼此孤立地讨论，导致人们对存储与计算之间的信息流动理解不足。本综述将长上下文压缩重新界定为推理时资源分配中的记忆管理问题。我们区分直接参与模型计算的计算活跃记忆，以及处于计算路径之外、但可被存储、检索、更新或遗忘的计算非活跃记忆；并将卸载的 KV 缓存、持久化前缀缓存和预计算 KV 状态刻画为激活路径上的中间状态。在此基础上，我们将写入、卸载、回忆、检索并注入、物化、淘汰、整合和遗忘表述为信息生命周期中的状态转移，并引入一个预算化成本模型，将这些操作纳入统一的成本核算。由此形成的框架统一了短期上下文压缩、长期记忆管理及二者之间的转变，并指出核心挑战不只是减少信息量，而是决定哪些信息应在何时以何种形式参与成本高昂的推理。我们还总结了评估维度、基准缺口和开放挑战，并指出未来研究应从静态的逐点压缩转向动态、可治理且感知生命周期的记忆管理。

    ENGLISH

    Deep research agents are increasingly deployed to retrieve precise information from large corpora, yet multi-hop, long-horizon tasks remain challenging. Synthetic data generation has emerged as a scalable solution, with existing pipelines typically expanding seed tasks to increase their apparent depth and breadth. However, this expansion does not reliably translate into necessary reasoning: newly introduced evidence may be only weakly coupled to the answer, creating a mismatch between intended and empirical difficulty. To address this problem, we introduce GRADS, a graph-guided agentic data synthesis framework with explicit difficulty control. GRADS runs a closed loop of seed selection, evidence expansion, question--answer construction, and verification while maintaining a graph of the evidence and inference dependencies required to derive each answer. At each step, it conditions generation on a relevant subgraph, preserving indispensable inference without accumulating irrelevant context. Experiments across security, software-engineering, and scientific-document domains show that GRADS consistently generates verified tasks with empirically separated difficulty distributions, as measured by independent solvers. Moreover, under matched training budgets, post-training on this data delivers consistent gains at every level: SFT raises the solution-termination rate to over 95% while cutting tool calls and turns by up to 75%, RL trims tool use by up to a further 19.5%, and on our held-out, domain-specific benchmarks, the resulting 4B model matches Sonnet~4 on software engineering and surpasses it on the scientific and security domains.

Recent self-evolving approaches instead adapt these memory architectures using execution feedback, typically represented as evaluation scores or compressed summaries. However, such coarse-grained feedback is insufficient for precise failure localization in current agent systems, where long-horizon task execution involves multiple interacting components. Without a precise failure location, existing approaches lack a clear code-level target for modification, leaving the update scope weakly constrained and often leading to large-scale rewrites of an otherwise capable memory architecture. We propose MemScope, a framework for evidence-grounded, localized evolution of an existing memory architecture. Its tool-using Patch Agent jointly inspects raw execution traces, runtime memory state, and current architecture code to identify repair targets and apply bounded, in-place edits under provider-identity and memory-compatibility constraints. On GAIA, the trace-and-memory inspection variant achieves 86.67% accuracy, compared with 70.00% for trace-only and 63.33% for summary-only feedback. Under xBench tasks, the evolved memory architecture improves over its original version from 49 to 55 correct answers with DeepSeek V3.2 and from 50 to 53 with Kimi K2.7 Code. On disjoint ALFWorld unseen tasks, success rises from 50.75% to 71.64%. Across archived architecture-snapshot transitions, the median code-change ratio is 4.4%. These results support fine-grained execution evidence as a basis for localized, in-place memory-architecture evolution.

    中文

    智能体记忆架构决定 LLM 智能体如何跨任务存储和复用经验，但它们通常在部署后就固定下来，限制了其对不同任务类型的适应能力。近期的自演进方法则利用执行反馈来调整这些记忆架构，反馈通常以评估分数或压缩摘要的形式表示。然而，对于当前的智能体系统而言，这种粗粒度反馈不足以精确定位故障，因为长时间跨度的任务执行涉及多个相互作用的组件。若不能精确定位故障，现有方法就缺少明确的代码级修改目标，导致更新范围约束不足，并且常常对原本能力尚可的记忆架构进行大规模重写。我们提出 MemScope，这是一种基于证据、对现有记忆架构进行局部演进的框架。其使用工具的 Patch Agent 会联合检查原始执行轨迹、运行时记忆状态和当前架构代码，以确定修复目标，并在提供方身份和记忆兼容性约束下应用范围受限的就地编辑。在 GAIA 上，轨迹与记忆检查版本的准确率为 86.67%，相比之下，仅检查轨迹的反馈为 70.00%，仅使用摘要的反馈为 63.33%。在 xBench 任务上，演进后的记忆架构相较原版本，在 DeepSeek V3.2 上将正确答案数从 49 提升至 55，在 Kimi K2.7 Code 上从 50 提升至 53。在不重叠的 ALFWorld 未见任务上，成功率从 50.75% 升至 71.64%。在归档的架构快照变更中，代码改动比例的中位数为 4.4%。这些结果表明，细粒度执行证据可作为局部、就地演进记忆架构的基础。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces condition-contrastive teacher targets for on-policy distillation to reduce invalid reasoning continuations and improve mathematical benchmark performance. It substantially advances reasoning training, while the distillation setup alone offers no clear mechanism or composition contribution.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    On-policy distillation (OPD) improves a student language model by training on its own generated trajectories with supervision from a stronger teacher. However, when conditioned on student-generated prefixes, the teacher can favor invalid continuations that violate the question's premises, causing OPD to encourage erroneous reasoning steps. As a remedy, we introduce Condition-Contrastive Extrapolated On-Policy Distillation (CCE-OPD), which makes teacher supervision sensitive to question conditions. CCE-OPD incorporates (1) a fixed-prefix comparison in which the same frozen teacher evaluates the complete question and a counterpart with a selected condition masked, and (2) a bounded log-probability contrast that reweights the teacher distribution into an auxiliary distillation target. On 200 diagnostic reasoning states, condition contrast reduces the rate of preferring invalid continuations from 27.0% to 16.0%. Extensive experiments across six mathematical benchmarks show that CCE-OPD improves avg@8 over OPD by an average of 1.60 and 1.95 percentage points when distilling Qwen3-8B into 0.6B and 1.7B students, respectively. It also achieves the strongest results on four transfer benchmarks.

    中文

    On-policy 蒸馏（OPD）通过使用更强教师模型提供的监督，在学生语言模型自身生成的轨迹上进行训练，从而改进学生模型。然而，当教师模型以学生生成的前缀为条件时，可能会偏好违反问题前提的无效续写，导致 OPD 鼓励错误的推理步骤。为此，我们提出条件对比外推 on-policy 蒸馏（CCE-OPD），使教师监督能够对问题条件保持敏感。CCE-OPD 包含：（1）固定前缀比较，即同一个冻结教师模型分别评估完整问题，以及将选定条件屏蔽后的对应问题；（2）有界对数概率对比，用于重新加权教师分布，形成辅助蒸馏目标。在 200 个诊断性推理状态上，条件对比将偏好无效续写的比例从 27.0% 降至 16.0%。在六个数学基准上的大量实验表明，将 Qwen3-8B 蒸馏到 0.6B 和 1.7B 学生模型时，CCE-OPD 相较于 OPD 的 avg@8 平均分别提升 1.60 和 1.95 个百分点。在四个迁移基准上，它也取得了最强结果。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper measures commitment-release errors and shows that a persistent ledger plus release policy improves multi-party assistant behavior, a substantial contribution to agent memory and policy design.     本文测量了承诺解除错误，并表明持久化账本加上解除政策能够改善多方助手的行为，为智能体记忆和政策设计作出了重要贡献。其预言机探针能够诊断行为，但不能确立内部机制；这项任务也没有实质性涉及组合能力或一般推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    When an assistant serving a team makes a promise to Alice, who may cancel it? We call this standing: only the creditor (the person owed) or someone the creditor or operator policy authorizes may release a commitment, regardless of rank. In a controlled chat environment we vary who cancels and separate two errors: unauthorized release (obeying someone without standing) and override (executing a released promise). Across six models, smaller open ones override the creditor (Qwen3.5-9B: 69%); larger ones drop promises on a peer's direct word (Qwen3.8-27B: 89%; gpt-6.1-sol: 83%); nearly all act on a bystander's "go ahead after all". Oracles dissociate the errors: stating the rule or the creditor curbs unauthorized release but not override, which the latter even raises in three of four models; among them, only knowing whether the promise is still owed cuts override. Enabling thinking moves smaller models the way scale does. A self-kept commitment ledger stops override in four of five models; with a one-paragraph release policy it matches or beats the best oracle store, raising gpt-6-luna's strict accuracy from 49% (policy alone) to 83%. Code, prompts, outputs and labels are released.

    中文

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    When a speaker says ``some students passed'', listeners infer that not all of them did. Reasoning models now let users decide how long a model thinks before it answers, but we do not know what extra thinking does to such everyday inferences. We study this directly: we keep a model's weights fixed, change only how much it thinks, and record which reading it chooses. A second tool cuts the model's own reasoning at successive points and asks for an answer, showing where the reading changes. Thinking makes models read logical words as logic: it cancels the implicatures of \emph{some} (\emph{not all}) and \emph{or} (\emph{not both}) in most tested open reasoning models and in GPT-5, while context-driven inferences such as indirect answers improve. The trace shows why: models first entertain the enriched reading and cancel it later. Answering from that early reading, an exploratory inference-time remedy, recovers these implicatures without losing literal accuracy. Evaluations of reasoning models should measure how they interpret, not only how accurate they are.

    Tanay Arora and Cong Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    AutoOnboarder iteratively adapts an agent’s model, prompt, and harness using a coding agent and a small set of examples. This is a substantial agent-system contribution; its connection to reasoning is limited to reported capability changes, without a direct study of reasoning mechanisms.

    AutoOnboarder 使用编码智能体和少量示例，迭代调整智能体的模型、提示词和 harness。这是一项重要的智能体系统贡献；它与推理的关联仅限于报告的能力变化，并未直接研究推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agentic large language models have been documented to lose reasoning capability when placed inside a harness, the software that mediates their observations and actions. To reconcile these losses, we introduce AutoOnboarder, an autonomous system that adapts an agent to a task the way a trainer onboards a new employee. It places the agent under the supervision of an intelligent ``Onboarder'' coding agent, which iteratively tailors its foundation model, prompt, and harness source code to simultaneously improve performance and decrease cost. Like a real onboarding process, the Onboarder is only given tens of examples, and all evaluation data is isolated on a separate virtual machine to prevent leakage. We report the lessons learned from building and testing AutoOnboarder on genomic-sequencing prior authorization form submission. Autonomously onboarded agents are able to match or exceed the performance of a Gemini 3.5 Flash baseline at up to 29$\times$ lower costs. However, these agents remain imperfect, and the Onboarding process varies greatly in terms of final performance. We conclude that future Onboarding systems require a robust environment for the Onboarder, including a structured thought interface, (controlled) internet access, and a wide model search space.

    ENGLISH

    Accurate medium- to long-range epidemic forecasting requires extrapolating high-dimensional, heterogeneous and nonstationary dynamics from partial observations. Yet hybrid models often leave implicit which observations inform which epidemic processes and how learned graph interactions modify system state. We introduce LE-EpiGNODE, which replaces generic message passing with process-specific, mechanism-guided neural operators: age-contact information drives Lagrangian infection generation, whereas mobility drives conservative Eulerian population transport within a structure-preserving universal differential equation. We evaluated LE-EpiGNODE across 14 controlled synthetic mechanisms spanning time-modulated, state-dependent, nonlinear and coupled dynamics, three complementary COVID-19 settings, 21 comparator models and five targeted ablations. Forecasting gains tended to become more pronounced at longer horizons; at the longest horizon, LE-EpiGNODE achieved the lowest WMAPE in all three real-world datasets, reducing error by 17.7-40.0% relative to the best baseline. Controlled ablations linked these gains to the Lagrangian-Eulerian decomposition and process-aligned priors, while synthetic ground truth showed that learned operators and induced state fluxes track known generating dynamics. These results support mechanism-organized graph neural dynamics as a route to reliable long-horizon extrapolation with directly testable, process-level mechanistic interpretation beyond trajectory accuracy.

    On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently been introduced as a promising paradigm for continual learning, where a student policy can be supervised at the token-level. Typically, OPD is performed using a single teacher per prompt rollout (or even per training run). However, this ignores a whole other axis of flexibility that is available due to the on-policy nature - token-level teacher selection during rollouts. Building on this insight, we theoretically explore what makes a teacher and a student compatible for OPD, and leverage our findings to derive several empirical heuristics for teacher selection. In particular, our framework captures several desiderata for OPD: compatible teacher-student reasoning patterns, teacher competence, and induced student diversity. Theoretically, we categorize several types of teacher routing schemes, and we prove that under different scenarios, different routing schemes are likely to be beneficial for optimization and student diversity. We back up our findings with extensive experimental results in domains such as math, coding, kernel generation, and visual reasoning, where we find upwards of 10 percentage points of improvement on pass@$k$ when compared to vanilla OPD and the teacher experts on certain tasks, indicating both capability improvement and diversity over high-quality responses.

    System1-Arena: Which Decisions Can Be Left to System 1?

    System1-Arena：哪些决策可以交给 System 1？

    Tianyu Chen, Xinyang Liu, Ruyi An, Zhendong Wang, Mingyuan Zhou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a broad benchmark comparing single-pass decision models with generative reasoning across tasks and closed-loop environments, and finds reasoning models most accurate at higher cost. Agent control is part of the evaluation, but the contribution is primarily about reasoning capability assessment rather than agent-system design.

    本文推出一个广泛的基准，在多类任务和闭环环境中比较单次前向决策模型与生成式推理，并发现推理模型的准确率最高，但成本也更高。智能体控制属于评估内容，而本文的主要贡献是评估推理能力，而非设计智能体系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) often make discrete decisions, such as flagging phishing or escalating to a human. System-1 models, such as Jev and the OpenAI Decisions API, return probabilities over options in a single forward pass, while System-2 approaches generate reasoning steps. Which decisions can System-1 models handle, and which require generative reasoning? We introduce System1-Arena, a benchmark that gives all models the same decision requests and scores their probabilities. It contains 92k questions across 105 tasks from 268 public sources, in four groups: text classification and knowledge, applied decisions, evaluation and control, and agent and action. It also includes 138 closed-loop environments, from web shopping and SWE-bench coding control to robotics, games, and driving; in real-time mode, the world evolves while a model decides. We evaluate 30 models: 7 closed LLMs, 13 open LLMs read at the answer token, and 10 System-1 models. The largest System-1 models match or exceed fast closed LLMs in non-agentic accuracy, with better-calibrated probabilities at one-quarter of the latency. A reasoning LLM is the most accurate, at about 70x the cost of a fast LLM. In closed loops, large open LLMs succeed most often (up to 32.9%); small System-1 models rarely succeed.

    中文

    大语言模型（LLM）经常需要作出离散决策，例如标记钓鱼信息或升级给人工处理。Jev 和 OpenAI Decisions API 等 System-1 模型在单次前向传播中返回各选项的概率，而 System-2 方法则会生成推理步骤。System-1 模型能处理哪些决策，又有哪些决策需要生成式推理？我们推出 System1-Arena，这是一个基准，它向所有模型提供相同的决策请求，并对模型给出的概率评分。它包含来自 268 个公开来源、涵盖 105 项任务的 9.2 万个问题，分为四组：文本分类与知识、应用决策、评估与控制、智能体与行动。它还包含 138 个闭环环境，涵盖网络购物、SWE-bench 编程控制、机器人、游戏和驾驶；在实时模式下，模型作出决策时，环境也会持续变化。我们评估了 30 个模型：7 个闭源 LLM、13 个在答案 token 处读取的开放 LLM，以及 10 个 System-1 模型。在非智能体任务的准确率上，最大规模的 System-1 模型能够达到或超过快速闭源 LLM，概率校准也更好，延迟仅为后者的四分之一。推理型 LLM 的准确率最高，其成本约为快速 LLM 的 70 倍。在闭环环境中，大型开放 LLM 的成功率最高（可达 32.9%）；小型 System-1 模型则很少成功。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces trajectory-aware retrieval that uses observed tool-call sequences and contextual priors to reduce registry exposure while maintaining tool-selection performance across models and environments. This is a substantial agent-system contribution, while sequence use and improved task execution provide only incidental evidence about compositional or reasoning capabilities.

    本文提出了轨迹感知检索方法，利用观察到的工具调用序列和上下文先验，在减少注册表暴露的同时，使不同模型和环境中的工具选择表现得以维持。这对智能体系统作出了实质性贡献；对序列的利用和任务执行的改善，只能间接说明其组合或推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Modern agents select tools from registries, but exposing entire registries incurs high token costs and can impair selection as they grow. We present TRACER, a retrieval front-end that indexes observed tool-call sequences in a trie and ranks continuations using a learned blend of empirical and contextual priors. On a mixed retail-and-telecom $\tau^2$ environment, TRACER improves GPT-5.4's tool-selection accuracy by 4.7 points while reducing input tokens per step by 80%, exposing just 5 of 128 tools. In autonomous full-turn execution, it matches GPT-5.4's full-registry task success with 61% fewer input tokens per step. Across six environments and four models, TRACER improves tool-selection accuracy over full-registry selection in 21 of 24 model-environment pairs, with average gains of 6 to 10 points; the three exceptions trail by at most 2.2. We analyze failures in both regimes to identify directions for future work.

    Zihao Zheng (Washington University in St. Louis), Junyi Yao (Washington University in St. Louis), Baichuan Li (Southern Methodist University), Jiayu Long (Washington University in St. Louis)

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The benchmark exposes failures in healthcare agents’ escalation decisions under uncertainty and evaluates a workflow-aware controller that improves utility, while also revealing poor paraphrase generalization. This substantially advances evaluation and control of decision-making, with a limited systems contribution; workflow rules do not establish compositional generalization or internal model mechanisms.

    该基准揭示了医疗保健智能体在不确定情况下进行升级处置时的失败，并评估了一个能提升效用、同时也暴露出释义泛化能力较差的工作流感知控制器。这项工作实质性地推动了决策评估与控制，并作出了有限的系统贡献；工作流规则并不能证明存在组合泛化或内部模型机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Trustworthy biomedical AI requires reliable action selection when evidence is missing, stale, conflicting, or late, not only accurate answers on static inputs. We instantiate an episode-level evaluation protocol as 400 synthetic healthcare workflow episodes: 40 hand-authored semantic seeds across four task classes, two surface parameterizations, and five controlled variants, scored on ANSWER/ASK CLARIFICATION/ABSTAIN/ESCALATE under a pre-declared 5:1 missed-versus-unnecessary escalation cost. Reference actions are single-author study-policy labels, not clinician-adjudicated ground truth. Across five open-weight configurations (1.7B--9.7B), clean decision accuracy reaches 0.97, yet uncertainty-prompted models miss 32--97% of required escalations. The stronger 9.7B configuration narrows but does not remove the gap, falling from 0.97 clean accuracy to 0.78 under conflict. Verbalized confidence is inconsistent (ECE 0.10--0.54; failure AUROC 0.48--0.77), and a development-tuned confidence-only policy yields no utility gain. A transparent workflow-aware controller improves 5:1 utility for every model and reduces missed escalations to 0.12--0.24, at specificity 0.83--0.93. However, a 30-concept lexical stress test reduces each rule detector's recall from 1.00 on trigger phrases to 0.00 on unseen paraphrases, limiting the controller claim to this benchmark. Seed-clustered statistics, ablations, cross-task transfer, raw outputs, and manifests are packaged for audit. The results motivate explicit workflow-state evaluation while showing that apparently effective routing controls need their own generalization tests.

    中文

    可信赖的生物医学 AI 不仅要能在静态输入上给出准确答案，还必须在证据缺失、过时、冲突或延迟时可靠地选择行动。我们将一种逐轮次评估协议落实为 400 个合成医疗保健工作流轮次：40 个由人工编写的语义种子，涵盖四类任务、两种表层参数化方式和五种受控变体；依据预先声明的 5:1 漏报升级与不必要升级成本，对回答／请求澄清／弃答／升级进行评分。参考行动来自单一作者标注的研究策略标签，并非经临床医生裁定的真实标准。在五种开放权重配置（1.7B--9.7B）中，干净条件下的决策准确率达到 0.97，但经不确定性提示的模型会漏掉 32--97% 的必要升级。较强的 9.7B 配置缩小了差距，但未能消除差距：准确率从干净条件下的 0.97 降至冲突条件下的 0.78。模型用语言表达的置信度并不一致（ECE 0.10--0.54；失败 AUROC 0.48--0.77），而在开发集上调优的纯置信度策略并未带来效用提升。一个透明且感知工作流的控制器提升了所有模型在 5:1 成本设定下的效用，并将漏报升级率降至 0.12--0.24，特异度为 0.83--0.93。然而，一项涵盖 30 个概念的词汇压力测试显示，对于每个规则检测器，召回率从触发短语上的 1.00 降至未见释义上的 0.00，因此控制器的结论仅适用于该基准。论文提供了按种子聚类的统计、消融实验、跨任务迁移结果、原始输出和清单，供审计使用。这些结果表明，应显式评估工作流状态；同时也显示，看似有效的路由控制机制本身也需要接受泛化测试。

    Diviner：面向大规模基础设施、由人工治理适应过程的智能体根因分析

    Pradipta Ghosh, Gaurav Mitra, Shripad Nadgowda, Akshil Shah, Junyu Liu, Canturk Isci, Syamla Bandla, Xinyao Hu, Onkar Deshpande, and Anik Dasgupta

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Diviner contributes an agent system for infrastructure root-cause analysis, combining scoped skills, evidence-linked hypotheses, adaptive workers, and reviewed updates. This substantially advances agent organization and tool use; causal investigation connects partially to reasoning, but the abstract does not focus on general reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    Diviner 为基础设施根因分析提供了一种智能体系统，将范围明确的技能、与证据关联的假设、自适应工作器和经审查的更新结合起来。这实质性地推动了智能体组织方式和工具使用；因果调查与推理有一定关联，但摘要并未聚焦于一般推理机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Root-cause analysis (RCA) in large-scale distributed systems is challenging because a single symptom can cross service, data, configuration, compute, and organizational boundaries. Responders must assemble incomplete evidence and coordinate experts who hold different parts of the causal path. Generic language-model agents do not solve this problem through tool access alone: they can use stale or mistimed context, interpret failed queries as absent symptoms, report unsupported system state, and overload observability services designed for human-paced use. We present Diviner (Domain-Informed Verifiable Incident Navigation through Evidence and Review), an agentic RCA system operating at Meta and organized around a four-stage reliability lifecycle. Encode combines a large corpus of reviewed incidents with service-owner expertise to produce scoped, versioned skills, workflows, typed tools, and an incident knowledge graph. Execute uses an adaptive Lead and context-isolated workers to apply relevant knowledge to point-in-time evidence and maintain evidence-linked hypotheses. Evaluate compares saved investigation trajectories with responder-reviewed outcomes to measure exact cause, useful direction, and Groundedness. Adapt uses recurring gaps and on-call feedback to derive focused operational- knowledge updates, admitting them only after replay, quality checks, and owner approval.

    中文

    大规模分布式系统中的根因分析（RCA）颇具挑战，因为单一症状可能跨越服务、数据、配置、计算和组织边界。响应人员必须汇集不完整的证据，并协调掌握因果链不同部分的专家。通用语言模型智能体仅凭工具访问并不能解决这一问题：它们可能使用过时或时机不当的上下文，将查询失败误判为症状不存在，报告缺乏依据的系统状态，并使原本为人工节奏设计的可观测性服务负荷过重。 我们提出 Diviner（Domain-Informed Verifiable Incident Navigation through Evidence and Review，基于领域知识、通过证据与审查实现的可验证事件导航），这是一种在 Meta 运行、围绕四阶段可靠性生命周期构建的智能体 RCA 系统。Encode 阶段将大量经过审查的事件与服务负责人的专业知识相结合，生成范围明确且有版本控制的技能、工作流、类型化工具和事件知识图谱。Execute 阶段使用自适应 Lead 和上下文隔离的工作器，将相关知识应用于特定时间点的证据，并维护与证据关联的假设。Evaluate 阶段将保存的调查轨迹与响应人员审查的结果进行比较，以衡量根因是否准确、有用的调查方向以及证据支撑度（Groundedness）。Adapt 阶段利用反复出现的缺口和当值人员的反馈，形成有针对性的运维知识更新；只有经过回放、质量检查和负责人批准后，才会纳入更新。

    ENGLISH

    Code world models represent world dynamics through explicit state and executable rules. We investigate how to coordinate object representations, behavioral revisions, and visual memory within this formulation. We present Mallea, a system for building, steering, and memorizing worlds from text. A coding agent infers object interaction requirements from the prompt and jointly plans object structure, properties, and rules, favoring compact representations that support those requirements. The world evolves under the planned rules; optional user actions steer it, while text requests can edit properties or extend capabilities with unaffected state preserved. Object texture memory retains reusable appearance only for whitebox-defined objects and adapts it as those objects change. The program advances world state, while a generative renderer combines current structure with remembered appearance. By organizing construction, intervention, and memory around the same objects, Mallea conditions subsequent observations on the latest state and compatible appearance. Project page: https://lxycopper.github.io/Mallea.

    Bias Control and Injection for Multi-Agent Aggregation

    多智能体聚合中的偏差控制与注入

    Sungjae Lee, Soheil Abbasloo, Jabin Koo, Jungseul Ok

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The main contribution is a test-time method for controlling bias in multi-agent answer aggregation, using decision instability as a reliability signal and improving mathematical reasoning accuracy. Agent coordination makes this relevant to Systems, but the abstract offers limited architectural or memory insight; the reasoning contribution is stronger.

    主要贡献是一种用于测试时多智能体答案聚合的偏差控制方法；该方法将决策不稳定性用作可靠性信号，并提高了数学推理准确率。由于涉及智能体协调，这项工作与系统领域相关，但摘要对架构或记忆方面的见解有限；其推理方面的贡献更突出。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-agent reasoning with large language models (LLMs) raises a central question for collective decision-making: when agents disagree, whose decision should be trusted? Resolving such disagreements is difficult because agents' decisions are susceptible to non-semantic biases such as majority pressure and response-style preferences, which can obscure the quality of the underlying reasoning. Our analysis shows how bias can be both mitigated and exploited: bias control improves initial answer selection, while bias injection elicits decision instability that serves as a reliability signal. Building on these findings, we introduce a test-time aggregation framework that requires neither validation data nor prior knowledge of relative model strength. The framework implements bias control by presenting one style-normalized reasoning trace per distinct answer, and bias injection by placing each aggregating agent's initially selected answer in the minority. Overall, our framework achieves higher average accuracy and better token efficiency than competing non-oracle aggregation methods across three mathematical reasoning benchmarks and four heterogeneous LLM combinations. It also improves final-answer accuracy when applied to multi-agent debate and Mixture-of-Agents, without modifying their interaction or synthesis processes.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）的多智能体推理引出了集体决策中的一个核心问题：智能体意见不一时，应当相信谁的决策？解决这类分歧并不容易，因为智能体的决策容易受到非语义偏差的影响，例如多数压力和回复风格偏好，这些偏差可能掩盖底层推理的质量。我们的分析展示了偏差既可以被缓解，也可以被利用：偏差控制能改善初始答案的选择，而注入偏差则会引发决策不稳定，可将其用作可靠性信号。基于这些发现，我们提出一种测试时聚合框架，无需验证数据，也不需要预先了解模型的相对能力。该框架通过为每个不同答案提供一条风格归一化的推理轨迹来实施偏差控制，并通过让每个聚合智能体最初选定的答案处于少数方来注入偏差。总体而言，在三个数学推理基准和四种异质 LLM 组合上，我们的框架比其他非预言机聚合方法具有更高的平均准确率和更高的 token 效率。将该框架用于多智能体辩论和 Mixture-of-Agents 时，也能提高最终答案准确率，且无需改动它们的交互或合成过程。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multimodal long-document question answering requires models to seek sparse evidence across pages and modalities, understand heterogeneous document content, and reason over the collected evidence. Even advanced vision-language models (VLMs) can overlook sparse evidence and struggle with cross-modal reasoning in a single pass. Existing document agents further introduce multi-step interaction, but some still rely on predefined workflows or coarse-grained actions, limiting the flexibility and granularity of document reasoning. We introduce DocPilot, an agentic document framework that supports expressive orchestration and makes complex document solving learnable by small language models (SLMs). DocPilot orchestrates evidence seeking through page-level navigation and fine-grained evidence localization, and integrates local visual inspection, code-based numerical reasoning, and cross-modal reasoning for multimodal understanding. To transfer these capabilities to small models, we propose curriculum-based agentic training that progresses from single-ability learning to adaptive orchestration through supervision from data-grounded reasoning traces and executable interaction trajectories. Across MMLongBench-Doc, DocBench, FinRAGBench-V, and MADQA, DocPilot achieves strong gains with frontier VLM backbones, while DocPilot-4B delivers competitive performance against substantially larger models, demonstrating strong effectiveness and generalization across diverse long-document reasoning settings. The code is available at https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DocPilot.

    High-fidelity user simulators are essential for evaluating and training agents in interactive environments. However, current LLM-based simulators struggle with reliability issues, such as goal omission and policy non-compliance. We propose ARGUS (Agenda-dRiven Goal-oriented User Simulator), a neuro-symbolic framework that maintains the user's goal state using a dynamic agenda stack manipulated via symbolic operations. By rigorously decoupling state tracking from natural language generation, ARGUS facilitates strict goal progression and constraint-aligned interactions. For cost-efficient deployment, we distill ARGUS into compact models using a unified pipeline: evaluator-guided SFT followed by online RL with dense step-level rewards.     FedSkillGit：通过版本控制实现联邦技能演进

    Boxun Lan and Jiamei Li and Weijian Li and Chengyu Yang and Zhuang Qi and Chengcheng Wan and Xiaohong Chen and Ming Hu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    FedSkillGit contributes a federated method for evolving reusable agent skills through attributed patches, privacy filters, and validation-based merging. This substantially advances skill composition and agent-system organization; execution experience and improved capabilities connect to reasoning, but the abstract does not focus on reasoning mechanisms.

    FedSkillGit 提出一种联邦方法，通过可归因的补丁、隐私过滤和基于验证的合并来演进可复用的智能体技能。这显著推进了技能组合和智能体系统组织；执行经验和能力提升与推理有关，但摘要并未聚焦于推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model agents can improve their capabilities by evolving reusable natural-language skills from execution experience. In real-world deployments, this experience is distributed across data owners who cannot pool their raw data, which motivates federated skill evolution. The natural first design lets each client evolve the whole skill document and upload the result for server-side aggregation. That design is poorly matched to skill evolution for three reasons. An evolved document can still carry client-specific content distilled from private traces, repeated transmission of a nearly unchanged document spends communication on knowledge that the population already holds and the contribution of a single client is buried in a document that the server cannot meaningfully attribute. We propose FedSkillGit, a federated skill evolution framework that replaces full-document updates with commits. Each participating client submits a bounded set of patches over named rules together with its local experience, which summarizes what the round taught it, and the pair passes a two-stage privacy filter before it leaves the client. The server deduplicates the submitted patches and the local experience of all participants, updates a global experience document that only the optimizers read, and merges the surviving patches into a candidate skill. The candidate is distributed to the clients, which score it on their own validation sets and report the results, and it is published only when the reported scores improve on the current version. Experiments on three datasets and three language model families show that FedSkillGit outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by up to 22% and approaches centralized evolution without sharing raw client data.

    中文

    大型语言模型智能体可以根据执行经验演进可复用的自然语言技能，从而提升自身能力。在现实部署中，这些经验分散在无法汇集原始数据的数据所有者之间，因此需要联邦式技能演进。最直接的设计是让每个客户端演进整个技能文档，再上传结果供服务器聚合。但这种设计不适合技能演进，原因有三：演进后的文档仍可能包含从私有轨迹中提炼出的客户端特有内容；反复传输几乎未改变的文档，会将通信资源耗费在群体已掌握的知识上；单个客户端的贡献埋在文档中，服务器无法有效归因。我们提出 FedSkillGit，这是一种联邦技能演进框架，以提交记录取代整份文档更新。每个参与客户端提交一组数量受限、针对具名规则的补丁，以及对本地经验的总结，概括该轮学到的内容；这两项内容在离开客户端之前要经过两阶段隐私过滤。服务器对提交的补丁和所有参与者的本地经验进行去重，更新仅供优化器读取的全局经验文档，并将保留下来的补丁合并为候选技能。候选技能分发给客户端，由客户端在各自的验证集上评分并报告结果；只有当报告的分数优于当前版本时，才会发布该技能。在三个数据集和三类语言模型上的实验表明，FedSkillGit 的表现最多比最先进的基线高 22%，并且在不共享客户端原始数据的情况下接近集中式演进的效果。

    ENGLISH

    Robotic manipulation often requires remembering interactions that are no longer visible. We introduce Latent Transition Memory (LTM), which stores history as compact latent transitions between consecutive observations. Instantiated on $\pi_{0.5}$ as LTM-$\pi$, our method uses a frozen latent action encoder, a lightweight adapter, and causal KV caching for incremental inference without memory-specific semantic annotations or external reasoning-model calls. With DreamDojo transitions, LTM-$\pi$ achieves 58.54% success on RoboMME and 80.5% on LIBERO-Mem, performing best among baselines without external reasoning models or memory-specific annotations. Ablations support the contribution of transition content beyond temporal cues and the efficiency of delayed memory admission. Scaling RoboMME demonstrations tenfold improves success from 57.67% to 87.50%, while a Cup Swap diagnostic highlights the role of process supervision in temporal composition. Under a 200-token memory budget, success remains 84.00%, versus 87.50% without compression. Finally, real-robot counting success improves from 11.25% to 82.50%. Together, these results demonstrate the effectiveness, scalability, and efficiency of latent transition memory, highlighting its capacity for complex temporal information, bounded-context operation, and real-world robotic control.

    ENGLISH

    Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models reduce computation by routing each token to a small set of experts, but each selected expert is still used at a fixed precision. We present DPA-MoE, a runtime precision control framework that makes routed experts any-precision. DPA-MoE encodes expert feed-forward weights as prefix-decodable chunks using SharedScale AnyBCQ, profiles per-expert reconstruction residuals offline, and allocates chunks at inference time using live router gate scores. This post-routing allocation lets a single encoded MoE checkpoint operate at multiple effective weight budgets without retraining or re-encoding. Experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B and DeepSeekMoE-16B show that DPA-MoE improves KL divergence and downstream accuracy over uniform chunk allocation at matched budgets, with modest steady-state throughput overhead in our prototype.
