    选择并非学习：为模型选择未来

    Haoyi Yang, Kshitij Mishra, Nils Lukas, Salem Lahlou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops model inheritance and experience repair for self-evolving language models, with an analysis of selection and update errors and gains on mathematics and general reasoning. Its reasoning-training contribution is substantial, while composition is only incidental and it does not study internal representations.

    本文为自演化语言模型开发了模型继承与经验修复方法，分析了选择和更新错误，并在数学与通用推理任务上取得提升。其对推理训练的贡献很实质；组合只是附带因素，且本文没有研究内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Self-evolving language models train on tasks they generate, so every round must decide which updated model the next round inherits. Current loops such as R-Zero, Agent0, and Skill Self-Play make this decision through the task, admitting tasks that look learnable and inheriting every resulting update. We identify a selection-to-update gap in these loops, where a task that looks learnable need not produce a useful update. Most updates on verified tasks fail to make correct answers more likely, yet these loops inherit them all. HeirCommit freezes the updated model and uses fresh evaluation questions to decide whether to inherit it or retain the current model. EvoHeir separates parameter inheritance from experience inheritance, using current and archived experience to repair failures and preserve successes before final confirmation. Our analysis characterizes selection-induced optimism and decomposes regret into selection, absorption, and confirmation errors. HeirCommit cuts the harmful share of accepted updates by 68-83% relative to random inheritance at the same acceptance rate. Across four backbones, EvoHeir achieves the best mathematics and general-reasoning averages, raising the math average by 5.3% relative to the strongest baseline, Agent0. The framework lets useful experience persist even when the model that produced it is not inherited.

    中文

    自演化语言模型在自己生成的任务上训练，因此每一轮都必须决定下一轮继承哪个更新后的模型。R-Zero、Agent0 和 Skill Self-Play 等现有循环通过任务来做出这一决定：接纳看起来可学习的任务，并继承由此产生的所有更新。我们发现这些循环中存在从选择到更新的差距：看起来可学习的任务未必会产生有用的更新。在经过验证的任务上，大多数更新都没有提高正确答案出现的可能性，但这些循环仍将它们全部继承。HeirCommit 会冻结更新后的模型，并用新的评估问题来决定是继承该模型，还是保留当前模型。EvoHeir 将参数继承与经验继承分开，利用当前和存档的经验修复失败并保留成功，然后进行最终确认。我们的分析刻画了由选择引发的乐观偏差，并将遗憾分解为选择、吸收和确认错误。与接受率相同的随机继承相比，HeirCommit 将被接受更新中的有害部分减少了 68–83%。在四种骨干模型上，EvoHeir 的数学和通用推理平均成绩均为最佳；与最强基线 Agent0 相比，其数学平均成绩提高了 5.3%。即使产出这些经验的模型没有被继承，该框架也能让有用经验得以保留。

    本文测试隐藏状态探针能否识别推理失败类型并定位失败步骤，发现探针的排序取决于训练设计，而失败步骤定位效果并未超过基于轨迹长度的规则。这为评估推理行为和探针局限提供了大量实证证据，但并未揭示内部机制或表征结构。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Verifying the final answer of a long reasoning trace may show that the trace is wrong but it does not distinguish three cases. The problem may lie beyond the model's capability, another attempt would succeed, or one step in an otherwise recoverable trace made the trace fail. Standard hidden-state probes are trained on final-answer correctness, a label that conflates these cases. Monte Carlo rollouts distinguish the cases and locate the failing step at additional inference cost. We test the hidden states of 4B and 8B reasoning models for the failure type and the failing step and compare each probe with the strongest baseline that uses no hidden states. On incorrect 8B traces, the confidence probe, a calibrated correctness probe at a midpoint cutoff, misses 81% of cases in which a single step makes the trace unrecoverable and 47% of cases in which another attempt would succeed. A probe with a different training design over the same states reverses the ordering of these two kinds of failure, so either ordering can be read from those states. At both scales, no single tested probe locates the failing step more accurately than a rule based only on trace length, and at 4B a probe trained to predict that step fails to outperform this rule in any of 10 runs on identical traces. The confidence probe therefore indicates that an answer is wrong, but its failure-type ordering depends on its training design.

    Progress Reward Model for Reinforcement Learning via Large Language Models

    通过大型语言模型实现强化学习的进展奖励模型

    Xiuhui Zhang, Ning Gao, Xingyu Jiang, Yihui Chen, Yuheng Pan, Mohan Zhang, Yue Deng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PRM4RL decomposes long-horizon tasks into subtasks and uses progress-based rewards to improve policy learning, with theoretical guarantees and robotics results. This substantially advances RL for task execution and planning; subtask decomposition offers a partial compositional connection, while the abstract does not study model internals or system architecture.

    PRM4RL 将长时程任务分解为子任务，并使用基于进展的奖励改进策略学习，同时提供理论保证和机器人实验结果。这实质性推进了面向任务执行与规划的 RL；子任务分解与组合有一定关联，而摘要没有研究模型内部机制或系统架构。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Traditional reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms face significant limitations in handling long-term tasks with sparse rewards. Recent advancements have leveraged large language models (LLMs) to enhance RL by utilizing their world knowledge for task planning and reward generation. However, planning-based approaches often depend on pre-defined skill libraries and fail to optimize low-level control policies, while reward-based methods require extensive human feedback or exhaustive searching due to the complexity of tasks. In this paper, we propose the Progress Reward Model for RL (PRM4RL), a novel framework that integrates task planning and dense reward to enhance RL. For high-level planning, a complex task is decomposed into a series of simple manageable subtasks, with a subtask-oriented, fine-grained progress function designed to monitor task execution progress. For low-level reward generation, inspired by potential-based reward shaping, we use the progress function to construct a Progress Reward Model (PRM), providing theoretically grounded optimality and convergence guarantees, thereby enabling effective policy optimization. Experimental results on robotics control tasks demonstrate that our approach outperforms both LLM-based planning and reward methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance. Code is available at https://github.com/deng-ai-lab/PRM4RL.

    传统强化学习（RL）算法在处理奖励稀疏的长期任务时面临显著局限。近期进展利用大型语言模型（LLM）的世界知识进行任务规划和奖励生成，以增强 RL。然而，基于规划的方法往往依赖预定义的技能库，无法优化低层控制策略；基于奖励的方法则因任务复杂而需要大量人工反馈或穷举搜索。本文提出用于 RL 的进展奖励模型（PRM4RL），这是一种融合任务规划与密集奖励以增强 RL 的新框架。在高层规划中，复杂任务被分解为一系列简单、可管理的子任务，并设计了面向子任务的细粒度进展函数来监控任务执行进度。在低层奖励生成中，受基于势函数的奖励塑形启发，我们使用进展函数构建进展奖励模型（PRM），提供具有理论依据的最优性与收敛保证，从而实现有效的策略优化。机器人控制任务上的实验结果表明，我们的方法优于基于 LLM 的规划方法和奖励方法，并达到最先进的性能。代码见 https://github.com/deng-ai-lab/PRM4RL。

    FAOPs：AI 智能体工作流的范式形式与代数

    Ali Mohammadi Shanghooshabad (JPMorgan Chase & Co.)

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    FAOP formalizes typed, scoped agent workflows with sound refactoring rules and runtime guarantees, making agent-system organization its central contribution. Its decomposition and factoring concern workflow structure, but the abstract does not establish insight into compositional generalization or model reasoning.

    FAOP 通过可靠的重构规则和运行时保证，对类型化、作用域受限的智能体工作流进行形式化，因此智能体系统组织是其核心贡献。其分解和因式分解针对的是工作流结构，但摘要并未证明其能深入揭示组合泛化或模型推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Organizations increasingly encode operational procedures as multi-step agent skills, here called Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs), that must be traceable, auditable, reproducible, access-controlled, and bounded in time and cost, requirements that regulated sectors make mandatory. Yet AOPs are typically kept as coarse-grained files, in which steps bundle actions, copied procedures drift apart, any step may reach any tool, and refactoring goes unchecked. We present Functional Agent Operating Procedures (FAOP), a formal theory that brings database-grade discipline to AI agent workflows. FAOP recasts each workflow as a typed function over scoped state and subjects an entire library to four progressive normal forms: Decomposed (FNF-1) splits a workflow into atomic steps, Typed (FNF-2) makes its data flow explicit and type-checked, Factored (FNF-3) gives each shared procedure a single canonical definition so a change propagates instead of drifting, and Scoped (FNF-4) confines every step to least-privilege tool access. Once normalized, every atomic step is a separate entity with a declared contract and can be type-checked, scope-confined, bounded, tested, traced, and audited on its own. A FAOP algebra of provably sound equalities turns refactoring and parallelization into compiler rewrites; orthogonal extensions add verified termination (+V), optimization (+O), and time and cost bounds (+B); and an architectural-level classifier (0-3) determines whether a workflow needs AI at all. Together, these make integrity, isolation, typing, termination, cost, and optimization compile-time concerns across the whole library, not runtime hopes. We implement the theory in SkillBase, an AOP management system (what PostgreSQL is to data, SkillBase is to AOPs), together with a separate executor that enforces these guarantees at run time. A worked financial workflow illustrates the approach end to end.

    中文

    各类组织越来越多地将操作流程编码为多步骤智能体技能，本文称之为智能体操作规程（AOP）。这些规程必须可追踪、可审计、可复现、受访问控制，并受时间和成本限制；在受监管行业中，这些要求是强制性的。然而，AOP 通常以粗粒度文件保存，其中步骤将多个操作捆绑在一起，复制的规程逐渐产生偏差，任何步骤都可能访问任何工具，重构也缺乏检查。我们提出函数式智能体操作规程（FAOP），一种为 AI 智能体工作流引入数据库级严谨性的形式理论。FAOP 将每个工作流重新表述为作用于受限状态的类型化函数，并对整个规程库应用四种逐级递进的范式形式：分解式（FNF-1）将工作流拆分为原子步骤；类型化（FNF-2）明确数据流并进行类型检查；因式分解式（FNF-3）为每个共享规程提供唯一的规范定义，使更改能够传播而非逐渐产生偏差；作用域受限式（FNF-4）将每个步骤限制为最小权限的工具访问。规范化后，每个原子步骤都是独立实体，具有声明的契约，可单独进行类型检查、作用域限制、边界约束、测试、追踪和审计。FAOP 代数通过可证明可靠的等式将重构和并行化转化为编译器重写；正交扩展增加了经验证的终止性（+V）、优化（+O）以及时间和成本界限（+B）；架构层分类器（0-3）则判断工作流是否需要 AI。总之，这些机制使完整规程库中的完整性、隔离性、类型、终止性、成本和优化都成为编译时关注事项，而非依赖运行时侥幸。我们在 SkillBase 中实现了该理论；SkillBase 是一个 AOP 管理系统（PostgreSQL 之于数据是什么，SkillBase 之于 AOP 就是什么），并配有独立执行器，在运行时强制执行这些保证。一个完整的金融工作流示例展示了端到端的方法。

    Beyond Context Length: Characterising the Difficulty of Long-Context Reasoning

    超越上下文长度：刻画长上下文推理的难度

    Shiwen Qin, Cameron Barker, Henry Gouk, Elliot J. Crowley, Shay B. Cohen, Mirella Lapata, Miao Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper contributes a benchmark and measurable factors—evidence scope, dispersion, and reasoning depth—for characterizing long-context reasoning difficulty, supported by evaluations across models. Its focus is reasoning capability and evaluation; the evidence integration findings are relevant to composition but do not primarily develop compositional mechanisms.

    本文提出一个基准以及证据范围、分散度和推理深度等可测量因素，用于刻画长上下文推理难度，并通过跨模型评估加以验证。其重点是推理能力与评估；关于证据整合的发现与组合相关，但并非主要致力于发展组合机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-context language models support ever longer context windows, and evaluations typically treat context length as the main indicator of difficulty. However, context length alone cannot explain why models fail on long-context tasks that require reasoning over complex information. Contexts of equal length can pose very different challenges: a task may be solvable from a single local passage, or it may require integrating evidence distributed across the full context. We quantitatively characterise this difficulty through three properties: evidence scope, how much necessary information must be found; evidence dispersion, how widely that information is scattered within the context; and reasoning depth, how many dependent steps are needed to derive an answer from it. We construct LURCH, a multi-domain question-answering benchmark of 6,550 instances with supporting evidence and reasoning graphs, enabling all three properties to be quantified. Evaluations of proprietary and open-weight models show that: (1) at fixed context length, all our three properties are strongly negatively correlated with model performance; (2) as context length increases, performance degrades sharply on samples with dispersed evidence, whereas it remains relatively stable on samples with localised evidence; and (3) difficulty compounds across properties, as questions with moderately high values on all three are harder than those with an extreme value on just one. These findings establish evidence scope, dispersion and reasoning depth as measures of long-context reasoning difficulty that complement context length.

    中文

    长上下文语言模型支持越来越长的上下文窗口，而评估通常将上下文长度视为难度的主要指标。然而，仅凭上下文长度无法解释模型为何会在需要对复杂信息进行推理的长上下文任务中失败。长度相同的上下文可能带来截然不同的挑战：任务可能只需依据一个局部段落即可解决，也可能需要整合散布于整个上下文中的证据。我们通过三个属性对这种难度进行定量刻画：证据范围，即必须找到多少必要信息；证据分散度，即这些信息在上下文中的分布有多分散；推理深度，即从这些信息推导答案需要多少个相互依赖的步骤。我们构建了 LURCH，这是一个包含 6,550 个实例、覆盖多个领域的问答基准，其中提供了支持性证据和推理图，使这三个属性都能够被量化。对专有模型和开放权重模型的评估显示：（1）在上下文长度固定时，我们的三个属性都与模型性能呈强负相关；（2）随着上下文长度增加，在证据分散的样本上性能急剧下降，而在证据局部集中的样本上则相对稳定；（3）不同属性的难度会叠加：三个属性均为中等偏高的问题，比只有一个属性极高的问题更难。这些发现确立了证据范围、分散度和推理深度作为衡量长上下文推理难度的指标，可对上下文长度形成补充。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SAFE-PRO uses risk-conditioned uncertainty to trigger clarifying questions and path optimization, with a new cross-modal dialogue dataset and theoretical analysis of safety risks. This substantially advances safety-oriented reasoning and agent interaction, while cross-modal composition is mainly the application setting and no internal interpretability contribution is described.

    SAFE-PRO 利用风险条件不确定性触发澄清问题和路径优化，并引入了新的跨模态对话数据集及安全风险的理论分析。这显著推进了以安全为导向的推理和智能体交互；跨模态组合主要是其应用场景，且文中未描述对内部可解释性的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can act unsafely when individually benign images and texts are interpreted jointly. Beyond implicit reasoning risk, where reasoning drifts toward harm, we identify intent-level risk, where cross-modal ambiguity silently commits the model to a hazardous premise that path-level optimization alone cannot correct. We propose SAFE-PRO, which uses a Risk-Conditioned Uncertainty (RCU) signal, combining predictive entropy with a learned cross-modal risk score, to decide when to ask safety-grounded clarifying questions and where to apply path optimization, under a reward that prioritizes safety and penalizes over-refusal. We also build SSUI-Dialog, a multimodal multi-turn dataset with dual-intent supervision, and theoretically analyze gradient variance and unsafe-completion risk under RCU. Across seven benchmarks and two base MLLMs, SAFE-PRO consistently improves safety over SRPO, roughly halves its over-refusal, and surpasses GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet in average single-turn safety.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MaLoW's main contribution is a recurrent HyperNetwork that consolidates streaming video history into evolving LoRA weights, with evidence of transfer to vision-language-action models. This offers substantive insight into model memory and its organization (Systems 4); internalizing knowledge in weights is relevant to knowledge mechanisms but the abstract does not analyze internal representations (MechInterp 3), while composition and reasoning are not central.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Streaming vision-language models (VLMs) must continuously integrate information from the past while remaining responsive to current observations and user queries. Existing memory mechanisms typically compress, retrieve, or cache historical observations and reintroduce them into the input context, forcing historical memory and current observations to compete for limited context. We propose MaLoW, a streaming memory framework that instead internalizes historical context into evolving lightweight parameter updates. MaLoW uses a recurrent HyperNetwork to incrementally consolidate incoming video observations into fixed-size LoRA weights, allowing historical information to be carried forward without revisiting the full video stream. In doing so, MaLoW represents history as weights, while keeping the current observation as input. To support training, we further construct MaLoW-Instruct, a large-scale streaming video dataset containing 381K question-answer pairs over 56K videos. We conduct extensive experiments to demonstrate that MaLoW achieves strong performance on OVO-Bench, StreamingBench, and StreamArena. On the backward split of OVO-Bench, MaLoW outperforms prior memory approaches by 3.9% to 11.8% across different video backbones while incurring only modest latency overhead. Beyond streaming video understanding, MaLoW also generalizes to vision-language-action models, improving the action success rate on Simpler WidowX by 9.3%.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TIPS learns when to reveal or remask tokens in diffusion language models, using supervised warmup and reinforcement learning to improve mathematical problem-solving accuracy per decoder evaluation.     TIPS 学习在扩散语言模型中何时显露或重新掩码词元，并通过监督预热和强化学习提高每次解码器评估的数学问题求解准确率。这显著推进了推理训练和自适应计算；不过，摘要并未研究内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Masked diffusion language models expose an inference-time choice: which positions become visible after each denoising pass. Many existing decoding methods use hand-designed rules or require visibility to grow monotonically. We present a $\textbf{T}$iny $\textbf{I}$nference-time $\textbf{P}$olicy for $\textbf{S}$caling ($\textbf{TIPS}$), an approximately $600$K-parameter controller that learns both unmasking and remasking while keeping the underlying language model frozen. TIPS uses visibility-aware confidence features and a shallow transformer to select which tokens should be visible, while a fixed schedule controls the expected visible fraction. We train the controller through supervised warmup followed by reinforcement learning from terminal correctness rewards. On GSM8K and MATH-500 with LLaDA-8B-Instruct, the full-canvas and two-block TIPS variants achieve $58.46\%$ and $57.97\%$ micro-averaged accuracy at a budget of $32$ decoder evaluations, exceeding the strongest baseline in our main comparison by $12.1$ and $11.6$ percentage points, respectively. Both variants are trained at a budget of $32$ evaluations and remain competitive at higher budgets without retraining. These results demonstrate that learning when to reveal and reconsider tokens can improve the accuracy-compute trade-off without updating the decoder backbone.

    Patch where the text is new: a compression view of where byte-level models should spend compute

    在文本出现新内容之处进行分块：从压缩视角看字节级模型应将计算资源用在哪里

    Nicol\'as Vera Z\'u\~niga

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a simple novelty-based patching rule that reallocates computation in byte-level language models and reports gains on written math, including computed results; its boundary analysis explains where the gains arise. This is a substantial contribution to adaptive computation and a partial contribution to mathematical problem-solving, while composition and internal mechanisms are not directly studied.

    本文提出了一种简单的新颖性分块规则，用于重新分配字节级语言模型的计算资源，并报告了其在书面数学（包括计算结果）上的增益；对分块边界的分析解释了增益产生的原因。这是对自适应计算的重要贡献，也在一定程度上推动了数学问题求解；但本文没有直接研究组合能力或内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Byte-level language models such as the Byte Latent Transformer (BLT) run their large global model once per patch and start a patch where a small model's next-byte entropy is high. This rule rarely starts a patch at in-line computed results, such as the number after "=" in a worked solution, and accuracy on them collapses under tight patch budgets. We propose novelty patching, motivated by LZ77-style compression: start a patch where the upcoming bytes are unlikely to repeat the recent context. The rule is a lookup table over the previous two bytes, fitted in seconds on raw text with no labels, reference model or losses. In BLT-style models trained from scratch on a 1.9 GB math corpus at a matched ~11% patch rate (3 seeds each), it has no clear effect at 1M parameters, raises final-answer accuracy from 47% to 72% at 12M, and at 50M raises computed-result accuracy from 21% to 57% and final-answer accuracy from 60% to 90%; a table fitted on the raw pretraining corpus keeps the gain. Outside math the advantage shrinks: novelty lowers bits per byte on prose and ties entropy on source code and on synthetic execution traces. An analysis of where boundaries fall explains the pattern. Computed results have ordinary surprisal for the patcher's model, so surprisal-seeking rules pass over them: entropy concentrates patch starts on high-surprisal bytes most strongly of all rules (boundary enrichment 1.61) and is the worst on computed results, while the best rules sit near chance enrichment. Novelty works where new content begins at segment starts close to the computation, as in written math; a learned chunker (H-Net) finds such structure on its own, in math and in code. We also report what did not work: typed uncertainty as a training rule, switching rules after training, and a context-aware novelty predictor.

    中文

    字节级语言模型（如 Byte Latent Transformer（BLT））每个分块运行一次大型全局模型，并在小型模型的下一字节熵较高之处开始一个分块。这条规则很少会在行内计算结果处开始分块，例如解题过程里“=”后面的数字；在严格的分块预算下，模型对此类内容的准确率会骤降。我们提出新颖性分块，其灵感来自 LZ77 式压缩：在后续字节不太可能重复近期上下文的位置开始分块。该规则是一个基于前两个字节的查找表，可在原始文本上数秒内拟合完成，无需标签、参考模型或损失函数。在数学语料上从头训练的 BLT 式模型中，我们将分块率匹配为约 11%（每种设置各用 3 个随机种子）；在 1M 个参数时，该方法没有明显影响；在 12M 个参数时，最终答案准确率从 47% 提升到 72%；在 50M 个参数时，计算结果准确率从 21% 提升到 57%，最终答案准确率从 60% 提升到 90%。在原始预训练语料上拟合的查找表也保留了这一增益。在数学以外，该方法的优势有所减弱：新颖性方法降低了散文文本的每字节比特数；在源代码和合成执行轨迹上，其表现与熵方法持平。对分块边界位置的分析解释了这一模式。对分块器模型而言，计算结果具有普通的意外度，因此追逐意外度的规则会略过它们：在所有规则中，熵方法最集中地在高意外度字节处开始分块（边界富集度为 1.61），并且对计算结果的处理最差；而表现最好的规则，其富集度接近随机水平。当新内容在靠近计算过程的分段起点处开始时（如书面数学中），新颖性方法便能奏效；学习得到的分块器（H-Net）会在数学和代码中自行发现这种结构。我们还报告了未奏效的方法：将类型化不确定性用作训练规则、训练后切换规则，以及考虑上下文的新颖性预测器。

    PROBE: Learning to Audit Policy Compliance in Tool-Using LLM Agents

    PROBE：让工具调用型 LLM 智能体学会审计策略合规性

    Kshitij Mishra, Abhijith Sharma, Nils Lukas, Salem Lahlou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PROBE trains auditors to discover policy violations through realistic, multi-turn tool use, formalizing the interaction as a Markov game and comparing optimization objectives. This substantially advances agent evaluation and auditing; the game framing and training comparisons provide limited reasoning insight, while tool use alone does not imply compositional generalization or mechanistic interpretability.

    PROBE 训练审计器通过逼真的多轮工具使用发现策略违规，将这种交互形式化为马尔可夫博弈，并比较不同优化目标。这显著推进了智能体评估与审计；博弈框架和训练比较提供了有限的推理洞见，而仅有工具使用本身并不意味着组合泛化或机制可解释性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Modern agentic systems extend language models with external tools, enabling them to complete complex tasks through multi-turn interactions. As these agents are deployed in consequential settings, they are often constrained by policies governing pricing, privacy, confirmation, safety, and other requirements. However, existing evaluation methods leave a critical gap: capability benchmarks measure what agents can accomplish, while content-safety red-teaming measures harmful generations, but neither tests whether agents comply with predefined policies during otherwise valid tool use. Such policy violations are difficult to audit because their effects may emerge only after several turns, span multiple tool calls, or surface in downstream systems. We propose PROBE (Policy Rule Observation via Behavioral Exploration), an algorithm for training LLM-based auditors that interact with deployed agents as realistic users and probe them for policy violations through multi-turn, tool-mediated dialogue. We formalize agent auditing as a two-player Markov game and propose a composite reward that balances violation discovery, behavioral plausibility, conversation progress, and policy diversity. To study training objectives and reward design, we compare GRPO, DPO, and GFlowNet-based optimization in a controlled setting. Across extensive experiments, auditors trained with PROBE uncover substantially broader and higher-yield policy violations than same-architecture zero-shot adversaries, even when the auditor is significantly smaller than the target agent. Our results show that multi-turn behavioral auditing is a distinct and necessary axis of agent evaluation, complementing capability and safety benchmarks. PROBE offers a scalable path toward automated policy auditing for real-world agentic systems and suggests a co-evolutionary loop in which auditors expose failures and agents improve from auditor feedback.

    中文

    现代智能体系统通过外部工具扩展语言模型，使其能够通过多轮交互完成复杂任务。当这些智能体部署于影响重大的场景时，通常会受到有关定价、隐私、确认、安全及其他要求的策略约束。然而，现有评估方法存在一个关键缺口：能力基准衡量智能体能完成什么，而内容安全红队测试衡量有害生成，但两者都不检验智能体在其他方面有效的工具使用过程中是否遵守预先设定的策略。此类策略违规很难审计，因为其影响可能要在数轮之后才显现，可能跨越多次工具调用，也可能出现在下游系统中。我们提出 PROBE（Policy Rule Observation via Behavioral Exploration，基于行为探索的策略规则观测），这是一种用于训练基于 LLM 的审计器的算法；审计器以真实用户的方式与已部署的智能体交互，并通过多轮、工具介导的对话探查策略违规。我们将智能体审计形式化为双人马尔可夫博弈，并提出一种复合奖励，在违规发现、行为可信度、对话进展和策略多样性之间取得平衡。为研究训练目标和奖励设计，我们在受控设置下比较了 GRPO、DPO 和基于 GFlowNet 的优化。大量实验表明，即使审计器显著小于目标智能体，经过 PROBE 训练的审计器也比同架构的零样本对手发现范围更广、收益更高的策略违规。我们的结果表明，多轮行为审计是智能体评估中独立且必要的维度，可补充能力和安全基准。PROBE 为现实智能体系统的自动化策略审计提供了一条可扩展路径，并提出一种协同演化循环：审计器揭示失败，智能体则根据审计器反馈加以改进。

    DropKV：解耦残差输出扰动，实现近乎最优的 KV 缓存淘汰

    Aozhong Zhang, Selcuk Gurses, Yanxia Deng, Naigang Wang, Chi-Chun Liu, Davis Wertheimer, Derrick Liu, Xin Li, Zi Yang, Felix X.-F. Ye, Penghang Yin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DropKV develops a provable approximation method and efficient kernels for reducing KV-cache memory costs while preserving model output, a substantial contribution to inference computation and memory systems. Its connection to reasoning is incidental through enabling long-context inference; the abstract does not study reasoning mechanisms or capability.

    DropKV 提出了一种具有可证明近似保证的方法和高效内核，在保留模型输出的同时降低 KV 缓存的内存成本，是对推理计算和内存系统的重要贡献。它与推理的联系仅在于支持长上下文推理；摘要并未研究推理机制或能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Key-value (KV) cache management has become a critical bottleneck for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs) to long-context scenarios due to linear memory growth. While recent eviction methods have moved beyond simple attention-score heuristics to incorporate value representations, they typically face a fundamental trade-off: the underlying optimization for minimizing output perturbation is an NP-hard combinatorial problem, leading to mathematically suboptimal heuristics or implementations that are difficult to kernelize. In this work, we propose DropKV, a simple principled eviction framework based on Decoupled Residual-Output Perturbation. By decoupling the joint eviction decision into independent per-token scoring, DropKV circumvents combinatorial intractability and admits a provable constant-factor approximation guarantee under a cone condition that we empirically verify on three long-context LLMs. To ensure practical viability, we provide a high-performance implementation using fused Triton kernels that avoid materializing the full attention matrix, delivering a 19.8x scoring-kernel speedup that translates to up to a 9.9% matched-batch end-to-end prefill speedup. Extensive evaluations on the RULER and LongBench benchmarks demonstrate that DropKV consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines at equivalent cache budgets, achieving the lowest inference latency among eviction methods while also remaining faster than the dynamic cache baseline.

    中文

    由于内存随上下文长度线性增长，键值（KV）缓存管理已成为将大型语言模型（LLM）扩展到长上下文场景的关键瓶颈。近期的淘汰方法已不再局限于简单的注意力分数启发式，而是纳入了值表示；但它们通常面临一个根本性权衡：用于最小化输出扰动的底层优化是一个 NP-hard 组合问题，因此会导致数学上次优的启发式方法，或难以转化为内核的实现。在本文中，我们提出 DropKV，这是一种基于解耦残差输出扰动的简单且有原则的淘汰框架。通过将联合淘汰决策解耦为针对每个词元的独立评分，DropKV 避开了组合问题的难解性；在锥条件下，它还具有可证明的常数因子近似保证，我们在三个长上下文 LLM 上通过实验验证了该条件。为确保实用性，我们使用融合 Triton 内核提供了高性能实现，避免物化完整注意力矩阵；该实现使评分内核提速 19.8x，并转化为匹配批次设置下最高 9.9% 的端到端预填充提速。RULER 和 LongBench 基准上的广泛评估表明，在相同缓存预算下，DropKV 始终优于最先进的基线；它在淘汰方法中实现了最低推理延迟，同时也比动态缓存基线更快。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Interactive agents repeatedly choose among a finite set of actions, labels, or ordinal outcomes. Generating a free-form response for each choice adds latency and complicates the interface between a model and its environment. We present Intern-Decision, a family of 0.8B, 2B, and 4B multimodal decision models that return structured choices and candidate probabilities from text and optional images. Our autoregressive masked language modeling objective places one decision placeholder per field in a complete assistant JSON skeleton. Ground-truth symbols appear only in supervision, while all fields are evaluated in a single causal forward pass using the backbone's native language-model head. The 4B model achieves a 90.02% unweighted average accuracy across seven evaluation suites, compared with 88.74% for Jev v1.13.0. For a fixed 289-token request with three fields on one RTX 4090, mean latency is 44.16 ms for the 4B model and approximately 33--34 ms for the smaller models. On a separate 96-case known-distribution pilot, temperature scaling reduces expected multiclass Brier from 0.628 to 0.550 and expected calibration error from 0.213 to 0.089. A confidence-based handoff study on 111 public Jevbench-Hard items improves accuracy from 82/111 (73.87%) to 97/111 (87.39%) by routing 42 items to Atria-Dawn-Preview. We also describe qualitative game, visual interface, and browser demonstrations. These results support compact decision models as a practical component of larger agent systems.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CART coordinates task-specific experts across a multimodal projector and language model to reduce representation drift and catastrophic forgetting, making model adaptation and routing a substantial systems contribution. The representation change is studied as an adaptation problem rather than internal mechanisms or geometry, and expert mixtures alone provide only a limited connection to compositional generalization.

    CART 协调多模态投影器与语言模型中的特定任务专家，以减少表征漂移和灾难性遗忘，是对模型适配和路由的重要系统贡献。本文将表征变化作为适配问题研究，而非内部机制或几何结构；仅凭专家混合只能有限地说明其与组合泛化的联系。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance through instruction tuning, yet real-world applications often require them to continually acquire new capabilities from sequential tasks, i.e., Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT). In typical MLLMs, a projector is employed to align visual representations with the language model. However, existing methods primarily protect the language model from forgetting while continuously updating the projector across tasks. Such asymmetric adaptation can cause substantial representation drift in the projector, increasing the mismatch between the projector and language model and consequently exacerbating catastrophic forgetting. To address this issue, we propose Compatible Routing (CART), which explicitly coordinates the adaptation of the projector and language model. Specifically, CART maintains task-specific experts for both modules and combines them through weighted mixtures. CART jointly infers their weights by considering both expert relevance and cross-module compatibility, thereby promoting coordinated adaptation between the two modules. To further control model growth, we introduce relevance-guided expert consolidation, which merges experts exhibiting similar relevance profiles across samples within each module. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CART achieves state-of-the-art performance.

    多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）通过指令微调取得了强劲表现，但现实应用通常要求模型从连续任务中持续获取新能力，即多模态持续指令微调（MCIT）。在典型的 MLLM 中，投影器用于将视觉表征与语言模型对齐。然而，现有方法主要保护语言模型免于遗忘，同时在不同任务间持续更新投影器。这种不对称适配可能导致投影器中的表征大幅漂移，使投影器与语言模型之间的失配加剧，进而加重灾难性遗忘。为解决这一问题，我们提出兼容路由（Compatible Routing，CART），明确协调投影器和语言模型的适配。具体而言，CART 为两个模块都维护特定于任务的专家，并通过加权混合将其组合。CART 综合考虑专家相关性和模块间兼容性，联合推断它们的权重，从而促进两个模块之间的协同适配。为进一步控制模型规模增长，我们引入相关性引导的专家整合方法，在每个模块内合并不同样本间相关性概况相似的专家。大量实验表明，CART 达到了最先进的性能。

    Liangjie Huang and Henry Peng Zou and Wei-Chieh Huang and Wooseong Yang and Yuwei Han and Philip S. Yu

    本文测量了对抗性主张如何改变多智能体讨论中智能体的私下答案和公开立场，揭示了隐性的信念转变和错误答案的传播。多智能体组织是核心内容，但对于一般推理机制或组合性的见解有限，也没有考察模型内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM systems increasingly rely on groups of agents that discuss, critique, and check one another, assuming that peers will catch individual errors. We test this assumption against a minimal adversary. In a ten-agent factual discussion, one or three adversarial agents repeatedly assert a plausible false answer. After each round we probe each benign agent's private answer through a separate call whose response is hidden from its peers, and we separately label its public stance toward the claim. Across six models and three factual-QA datasets, groups remain stable without an attacker: only 0.6% of benign agents finish with the false answer. A single adversarial agent increases this rate to 44.8% and three to 60.5%. Studies of conformity typically report public agreement without private change; we find the reverse. With three adversarial agents present, benign agents hold the false answer in 51.6% of exposed turns but publicly endorse it in only 19.7%. Much of the influence therefore remains invisible in the discussion, and the false answers persist when agents are asked for their own views. Agents that retain the true answer often fail to defend it; once adopted, the false answer spreads among benign agents, and baseline knowledge does not predict robustness.

    Wei Xia, Yehui Tang, Zhi-Hong Deng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    EMO combines iterative context updates with logit steering at test time and provides a KL-based analysis plus broad benchmark gains, advancing adaptive computation for problem solving.     EMO 将迭代上下文更新与测试时 logit 引导相结合，并提供基于 KL 的分析以及广泛的基准测试提升，从而推进了用于问题求解的自适应计算。使用 logits 并不等于分析内部表征，摘要也未讨论组合性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Test-time context optimization adapts frozen language models through textual feedback, but ordinary conditional generation provides no separate control over how strongly to reinforce the distributional changes induced by a context update. We introduce EMO, a training-free framework inspired by expectation--maximization that alternates question-specific context estimation (E-step) and distribution refinement (M-step). The E-step revises a system context using textual gradients from an external judge without access to gold answers. The M-step contrasts next-token distributions under the revised and preceding contexts at a shared prefix to construct a confidence-constrained logit correction. Feedback on the steered response drives the next context update, coupling adaptation across rounds with intervention within each generation. Theoretically, we connect parameter and context optimization through a shared target-KL objective and additive logit representations, and derive the steering vector from context-induced logit displacements. Under context-improvement and faithful-steering assumptions, we prove a one-round decrease in target KL divergence for sufficiently small steering strength. Under greedy decoding across eight models and six benchmarks, EMO improves the zero-shot baseline in 39 of 40 aggregated settings, averaging $+9.10$ percentage points. With the same judge, it adds $+1.53$ points on average over context-only optimization (TextGrad), with consistent MMLU-Pro gains across models. At matched target-model generation budgets, accuracy advantages over best-of-$N$ are strongest on Llama, while oracle coverage is higher in most comparisons despite fewer candidates. The coverage--selection gap motivates allocating test-time computation jointly to candidate generation and verification.

    测试时上下文优化通过文本反馈来适配冻结的语言模型，但常规条件生成无法单独控制对上下文更新所引起的分布变化进行强化的力度。我们提出 EMO，这是一种受期望最大化启发的免训练框架，交替进行问题特定的上下文估计（E 步）和分布细化（M 步）。E 步利用外部评审者提供的文本梯度来修订系统上下文，且无需访问标准答案。M 步在共享前缀处比较修订前后上下文条件下的下一词元分布，以构造受置信度约束的 logit 修正。对引导后响应的反馈推动下一次上下文更新，从而将跨轮次适配与每次生成中的干预结合起来。在理论上，我们通过共享的目标 KL 目标函数和加性 logit 表示，将参数优化与上下文优化联系起来，并从上下文引起的 logit 位移推导出引导向量。在上下文改进和忠实引导这两个假设下，我们证明，当引导强度足够小时，单轮即可降低目标 KL 散度。在八个模型和六个基准上采用贪心解码时，EMO 在 40 个汇总设置中的 39 个优于零样本基线，平均提高 $+9.10$ 个百分点。使用相同的评审者时，相比仅进行上下文优化（TextGrad），它平均额外提高 $+1.53$ 分，在各模型上的 MMLU-Pro 得分均有稳定提升。在目标模型生成预算相同的情况下，相比 best-of-$N$，准确率优势在 Llama 上最明显；尽管候选数量较少，多数比较中的 oracle 覆盖率仍然更高。覆盖率与选择之间的差距表明，测试时计算应同时分配给候选生成和验证。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CLUE trains models to find evidence in conversations and use it for pragmatic inferences, with a reward balancing grounded inference and reasoning effort.     CLUE 训练模型在对话中寻找证据，并将其用于语用推断，同时通过奖励平衡有依据的推断与推理耗费。其推理训练和评估具有实质内容；而社会语境和自包含交互与组合性及智能体系统的联系仅属附带。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Understanding a conversation requires connecting what is said to the speakers' relationships, expectations, and earlier exchanges. Prior work shows that supplying relevant context can improve models' social judgments, but much of this information may already be present in the conversation. This motivates training models to discover the cues that matter and use them to support an interpretation. We propose CLUE, a two-stage training pipeline that combines supervised evidence reasoning with GRPO guided by Grounded Information Utilization ($\mathrm{IU}_{\mathrm{G}}$). This reward credits new, evidence-supported social inferences while accounting for reasoning effort. We train on a small set of conversational examples to assess effectiveness and generalization across tasks, languages, and genres. At inference time, the trained model reasons over the supplied interaction in a self-contained manner. Compared with base Qwen, CLUE achieves relative gains of 17.3% in-domain and 9.3% out-of-domain in average weighted F1, with higher F1 on four of five out-of-domain evaluations. These gains are accompanied by over 80% fewer reasoning tokens on average in both domains. Human evaluation further finds that CLUE more often grounds its explanations in specific conversational content, with closer alignment between its quoted evidence and human-selected context.

    理解对话需要将说出的内容与说话者之间的关系、预期以及先前交流联系起来。以往研究表明，提供相关语境可以改善模型的社会判断，但这些信息中的很大一部分可能已经包含在对话中。这促使我们训练模型发现重要线索，并用其支持一种解释。我们提出 CLUE，这是一种两阶段训练流程，将有监督的证据推理与由有依据的信息利用（$\mathrm{IU}_{\mathrm{G}}$）引导的 GRPO 相结合。这一奖励会认可新的、有证据支持的社会推断，同时考虑推理所耗费的努力。我们使用少量对话示例进行训练，以评估其在不同任务、语言和体裁上的有效性与泛化能力。在推理时，训练好的模型会以自包含的方式对给定交互进行推理。与基础 Qwen 相比，CLUE 的平均加权 F1 在域内相对提升 17.3%，在域外相对提升 9.3%，且在五项域外评估中的四项取得更高的 F1。这些提升同时伴随着两个领域中平均推理词元数减少 80% 以上。人工评估还发现，CLUE 更常将解释依据建立在具体对话内容上，其引用证据与人类所选语境之间的一致性也更高。

    We introduce REKI, a 2.4B vision-language-action model (VLA) pretrained exclusively on public data that sets a new Pareto frontier between performance and model size: on LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin Clean2Rand and RoboCasa365, it is outperformed only by models about twice its size. Additionally, we endow it with a memory that gives the policy access to its recent past at negligible cost: a few register tokens in the action expert summarise the output of the VLM at each frame and persist in the expert's cache. This memory improves success in simulation and on real robots, and makes oscillations between poses about four times rarer.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LCT develops GPU kernels and a lossless compression framework for storing training tensors, reducing memory use at a measured step-time cost. This is a substantial systems contribution to training computation and memory, while its effects on internal representations, composition, and reasoning are not addressed.

    LCT 开发了用于存储训练张量的 GPU 内核和无损压缩框架，以可测量的步进时间成本降低内存使用。这是对训练计算与内存具有实质意义的系统贡献；摘要未涉及其对内部表征、组合性和推理的影响。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Lossless tensor compression could reduce memory usage during training, but training requires tensors to be repeatedly re-encoded. We introduce Losslessly Compressed Tensors (LCT), a GPU execution framework designed for this repeated encode-decode regime. LCT exploits the natural redundancy in floating point data to reduce storage for weights, activations and optimizer states. Highly optimized GPU kernels implement Huffman coding with precomputed codebooks for low compression and decompression overhead, essential for training. Our analysis characterizes LCT's storage costs and adaptation to magnitude shifts. LCT achieves a compression ratio of up to $1.455\times$, and is demonstrated in training and finetuning settings. On a 162M-parameter NanoGPT, LCT reduces memory usage by $24.6\%$ for a $7.2\%$ step-time increase. In Qwen3-4B fine-tuning, LCT saves up to $23.8\%$ of peak memory, enabling a $3.5\times$ larger context length in training on the same GPU.

    AutoSFT 提出一个用于自动化 SFT 数据研究的多智能体工作流，将执行、分析和数据合成分开，并报告了其在指令任务和代码任务上的组件级迁移结果。智能体组织是主要贡献；组合性和推理仅作为数据及任务表现中附带的方面出现。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Language model agents increasingly automate post-training, but when given the full training stack they converge on supervised fine-tuning and spend most effort revising training data. Existing systems give the agent one kind of control, selecting rows from a fixed pool or calling a generator, whereas a human data engineer adjusts proportions, prunes, repairs, replaces and synthesizes the data. We design a data action space for these changes and ask whether an automated system can make the full range rather than one of them, and what structure that requires. We first run this loop with a single agent, and it reaches only one action, adjusting category proportions, while its context fills with execution output and is discarded mid-search. We therefore introduce \textbf{AutoSFT}, a multi-agent system where a meta agent separates execution from analysis, gathers proposals from independent angles, and calls a synthesis subagent for capabilities the pool cannot cover, with the model, the trainer, and the budget fixed within each comparison. Adding each component in turn helps: the executor halves context loss, the analysis subagents lift the best IFEval by $+6.5$, and synthesis adds $+3.4$ IFEval and $+2.9$ IFBench. The same loop transfers to code, where analysis adds $+3.7$ MBPP+ over a single agent that does not improve. Every result comes from runs that retrain from the base model each round, so each component's effect is individually attributable. Our findings suggest that automating SFT data research depends more on covering diverse data actions than on a stronger single action.

    语言模型智能体越来越多地用于自动化后训练，但当它们获得完整训练栈时，最终会转向监督微调，并将大部分精力花在修改训练数据上。现有系统只赋予智能体一种控制方式：从固定池中选择数据行，或调用生成器；而人工数据工程师会调整数据比例、删减、修复、替换并合成数据。我们针对这些修改设计了一个数据操作空间，并探究自动化系统能否执行完整范围的操作，而非只执行其中一种，以及这需要怎样的结构。我们首先用单个智能体运行这一循环，它只会执行一种操作，即调整类别比例；与此同时，其上下文被执行输出填满，并在搜索过程中途被丢弃。因此，我们提出 \textbf{AutoSFT}，一个多智能体系统，其中元智能体将执行与分析分离，从不同角度收集方案，并在数据池无法覆盖所需能力时调用合成子智能体；每项比较中，模型、训练器和预算均保持固定。依次加入各组件都有帮助：执行器将上下文丢失减半，分析子智能体使最佳 IFEval 提高 $+6.5$，合成组件使 IFEval 提高 $+3.4$、IFBench 提高 $+2.9$。同一循环也可迁移到代码任务：分析使 MBPP+ 提高 $+3.7$，而单智能体系统没有提升。所有结果均来自每轮都从基础模型重新训练的实验，因此可以单独归因于各组件的效果。我们的研究结果表明，自动化 SFT 数据研究更依赖于覆盖多样的数据操作，而非增强某一种操作。

    通过序贯拍卖实现去中心化 LLM 工作流

    Ian Gemp, Shubhendu Trivedi, Adam Fisch, Fantine Huot, Michael Kaisers, Mirella Lapata, William W. Cohen, Alekh Agarwal, Kate Larson, Jacob Eisenstein

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies auction protocols and bidding algorithms for coordinating agents on multi-step tasks, with the central contribution being a decentralized agent system under imperfect competition. Task solving gives a limited reasoning connection, but the abstract focuses on market incentives and coordination rather than reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    本文研究拍卖协议和竞价算法如何协调智能体完成多步骤任务，核心贡献是在不完全竞争下构建去中心化智能体系统。任务求解与推理有一定关联，但摘要关注的是市场激励与协调，而非推理机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We present a scalable framework for solving multi-step tasks through a decentralized market of self-interested agents. Prior theoretical work demonstrated that agents organized through sequential auctions can converge to a globally optimal policy in a Markov decision process (MDP), but relied on the restrictive assumption of the existence of perfect clones as a model of perfect competition. In reality, exact clones drive agent profit to zero, violating the natural risk-reward incentives of participants. Conversely, we empirically demonstrate that the opposite extreme, absence of competition, also leads to market failure and value extraction collapse. Between these two extremes, we investigate how heterogeneous agents can survive in markets that span the critical middle ground of imperfect competition. To be profitable, agents learn to strategically shade bids to secure positive individual profit margins, while still ensuring that the marketplace functions effectively enough so that collaborative tasks posed by market consumers can still be solved. We formulate and evaluate four bidding algorithms (Mirror Descent, Thompson Sampling, Bayes-Optimal, and PPO) across three auction protocols (1st-Price, 2nd-Price, and Credit-Conserving Vickrey). Across a diverse set of domains, we demonstrate that imperfect competition successfully sustains necessary agent profit margins while maintaining high task success rates at low costs.

    中文

    我们提出一个可扩展框架，通过由利己智能体构成的去中心化市场来解决多步骤任务。此前的理论工作表明，通过序贯拍卖组织起来的智能体能够在马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中收敛到全局最优策略，但依赖于一个限制性假设：存在完美克隆体作为完全竞争的模型。现实中，完全相同的克隆体会使智能体利润降为零，违背参与者自然的风险收益激励。相反，我们通过实证表明，另一个极端——缺乏竞争——也会导致市场失灵和价值提取能力崩溃。在这两个极端之间，我们研究异质智能体如何在涵盖不完全竞争这一关键中间地带的市场中生存。为了盈利，智能体会学习策略性地压低报价以确保获得正的个体利润，同时仍保证市场有效运作，使市场消费者提出的协作任务能够得到解决。我们针对三种拍卖协议（一价拍卖、二价拍卖和信用守恒维克里拍卖），制定并评估了四种竞价算法（镜像下降、汤普森采样、贝叶斯最优和 PPO）。在一系列不同领域中，我们证明，不完全竞争能够维持智能体必要的利润空间，同时以低成本保持较高的任务成功率。

    Agent memory benchmarks evaluate whether an agent's responses reflect correct knowledge, measuring downstream question-answering accuracy as a proxy for memory quality. We show this evaluation paradigm is incomplete: it conflates memory correctness with retrieval and generation quality, producing both false positives where correct responses mask broken memory and false negatives where incorrect responses blame correct memory for retrieval failures. We introduce FEB-30, a benchmark of 30 fact-evolution trajectories spanning 6 diagnostic categories and 3 difficulty levels, constructed via paradigm inversion: documents are generated from known fact trajectories, yielding deterministic ground truth without human annotation. Each trajectory defines how a fact should evolve across multi-author artifacts (documents, emails, conversations), enabling direct inspection of the memory store after each ingestion step. Applying FEB-30 to a representative memory system, we demonstrate that intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation diverge by an average of 16 percentage points, with 44% of trajectories exceeding meaningful divergence thresholds. Diagnostic decomposition reveals that the system correctly classifies memory operations (create, update, reinforce, supersede) only 20% of the time, a failure entirely invisible to extrinsic evaluation, and that failure modes differ systematically by category and difficulty. We release the benchmark, document generation pipeline, and scoring framework to support reproducible evaluation of agent memory systems.

    The paper derives a model-disagreement approximation for routing weak-model responses to stronger models and evaluates its cost–accuracy trade-off, including on agentic tasks.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Small language models are increasingly deployed on edge devices and robotic systems to meet cost and latency constraints, yet their limited capabilities can make reliable deployment challenging. Stronger models can provide assistance when needed, but deciding when to route a weak-model response to a stronger model often relies on signals of response correctness. In open-ended and agentic tasks, however, obtaining such signals can require costly ground-truth supervision that is difficult to obtain at scale. We revisit the foundations of weak-to-strong routing and ask whether routing decisions can instead be guided by signals that do not require ground-truth supervision. We first characterize the optimal weak-to-strong routing policy, while allowing for multiple weak-model responses generated through local inference. Building on this characterization, we derive a principled approximation to the optimal routing based on model-to-model comparison. In particular, we introduce a notion of model disagreement that can be measured directly from model-generated responses, without ground-truth supervision. Importantly, the approximation becomes increasingly accurate as the strong model becomes a better proxy for the ground-truth distribution. Across agentic and single-turn tasks, our approach effectively navigates the trade-off between routing cost and response accuracy without ground-truth supervision. Moreover, even when ground-truth correctness signals are available for training, disagreement-based routing can outperform methods trained directly to predict correctness

    Reasoning over long document contexts remains a challenge for large language models (LLMs). Standard retrieval methods are inherently reactive, bottlenecking agents with complex, cross-document reasoning at inference time, while precomputed structures like knowledge graphs often fall short because they rely on rigid heuristics. Instead, can we allow agents to perform anticipatory directed curation: learning to proactively reorganize unstructured corpora prior to inference to efficiently serve diverse future queries. We build on a key asymmetry in modern agentic harnesses (e.g., Claude Code): while LLM agents are adept at navigating existing filesystems to solve an immediate task, they are rarely trained to construct reusable workspaces for future use. To instantiate this capability, we introduce Librarian Agents, a framework in which a builder agent transforms raw documents into a hierarchical filesystem of synthetic files and reference links, which forms a workspace tailored for a downstream answering agent. We formulate workspace construction as a Markov decision process and optimize the builder policy via reinforcement learning to directly maximize downstream answering accuracy. Empirically, Librarian Agents outperforms the strongest retrieval and precomputation baselines by 33 percentage points on BrowseComp-Plus, amortizes upfront construction costs across repeated queries, and generalizes zero-shot to unseen domains on BRIGHT with a 31-point average accuracy improvement.

    LEASH：面向计算机使用智能体的感知不确定性弱到强升级与监督

    Qingni Wang, Changdae Oh, Yuzhe Yang, Sharon Li, Jiachen Yang, Ang Li, Xin Eric Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LEASH uses a weak agent’s hidden-state similarity to successful and failed trajectories to route and oversee computer-use agents while reducing inference cost. This gives a limited, operational use of internal activations, but does not explain model mechanisms; its main contribution is adaptive agent control and compute allocation, rather than improving reasoning capability.

    LEASH 利用弱智能体隐藏状态与成功和失败轨迹的相似度来路由和监督计算机使用智能体，同时降低推理成本。这在操作层面有限地利用了内部激活，但并未解释模型机制；其主要贡献是自适应智能体控制和计算资源分配，而非提升推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Computer-use agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks, where running a frontier model at every step is expensive and a small open-weight model alone often fails. Weak-to-strong escalation offers a middle ground where a weak agent acts by default and hands control to a strong one only when needed. The core challenge is deciding when to escalate, which requires an uncertainty signal cheap enough to check at every step. However, even after handoff, the strong agent can still get lost, but a black-box API that the strong agent is usually served exposes no internals to monitor. To this end, we propose LEASH, a training-free framework that unleashes the strong agent only when the weak agent's latent uncertainty signals it is needed, and keeps it on a leash afterward. LEASH has three layers: (1) initial task uncertainty for early routing, (2) step-level uncertainty for runtime escalation, and, after handoff, (3) a shadow observer for continued oversight of the strong black-box agent. Here, we use latent uncertainty as a fuel for all three layers. Specifically, we compare the weak model's hidden states with those from its past successful and failed trajectories, and a state that looks more like the failures signals higher uncertainty. During weak-agent execution, our uncertainty estimator reuses activations already produced during action generation, so it needs no extra forward pass or dedicated monitor training. Experiments on OSWorld across four contemporary model backbones show that LEASH consistently improves over standalone weak agents and outperforms random escalation by 6.55--11.94 points at matched escalation rates. With Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, LEASH achieves 73.66% task success at $0.4117 per task, matching always-on Claude Opus 5 (72.90%) while reducing inference cost by 19.2%.

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning has become a common post-training technique to improve the accuracy of LLMs on verifiable tasks. However, such training can narrow the set of solutions the model can produce. Several approaches have attempted to address this behavior-sharpening effect, but they often optimize metrics that do not reflect the diversity of correct solutions. Ideally, we want a model that can produce multiple good solutions, not only a single reliable one. We propose EliteReplay, a post-training recipe that pairs GRPO with an "elite" archive built by quality-diversity search. Before training, we use the frozen base model to collect solutions that span distinct approaches; during training, GRPO is combined with a replay loss on this archive. The result is a post-trained model that improves accuracy while preserving more of the base model's solution diversity. On multiple text-to-SQL tasks, EliteReplay achieves a higher pass@128 than all baselines, producing up to 77% more distinct correct strategies than the strongest baselines. It preserves most of the base model's correct strategies, outperforming existing methods in strategy retention. This diversity translates into practical benefits on ambiguous questions, where EliteReplay covers both interpretations nearly twice as often as the strongest baseline on AmbiQT.

The agents planned, wrote, and debugged every program themselves. Researchers could watch the run on a live dashboard and pause or stop it at any time, but they had no cause to intervene. Complex real-world software engineering and enterprise tasks demand the same long-horizon coding and multi-agent coordination. We describe the setup, how the run unfolded, the team's strategies (dividing the work, sharing what they learned, recovering each other's items), and the limits of the result.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes combining line plots with normalized delay embeddings, whose distinct invariance profiles preserve complementary information, and reports gains in time-series prediction and reasoning.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Time Series Language Models (TSLMs) enable language-based understanding and reasoning over temporal data, yet a fundamental question remains: what information should their time-series representations preserve, and what variation should they factor out? Existing TSLMs typically expose the language model to a single representation, imposing a fixed inductive bias across downstream tasks. We instead introduce complementary representations as a design principle for time-series reasoning. Our model combines two visual views: line plots preserve absolute measurements and the observed coordinate frame, while normalized delay embeddings factor out positive amplitude rescaling and offsets while exposing temporal structure. Dedicated visual encoders integrate both views into a shared language model through visual tokens and multi-level feature fusion. Evaluation-time interventions verify that the two views exhibit distinct invariance profiles, while single-view ablations show that their combination is particularly beneficial beyond basic perception, with the large gains in prediction and reasoning. Built on Qwen3-VL-8B, our dual-view model improves overall TSRBench accuracy from 44.5% with line plots alone to 53.2%, substantially exceeding the strongest evaluated dedicated TSLM baseline at 36.7%. It further achieves 89.9% accuracy on TSExam and 86.8% numerical accuracy on multivariate ChatTS alignment. Together, these results demonstrate that complementary representations provide an effective design principle for general-purpose TSLMs, enabling models to exploit temporal structure without sacrificing access to the original measurement frame.

    中文

    时间序列语言模型（TSLM）支持对时间数据进行基于语言的理解和推理，但一个根本问题仍未解决：时间序列表征应保留哪些信息，又应消除哪些变化？现有 TSLM 通常只向语言模型提供一种表征，因而对下游任务施加固定的归纳偏置。我们则提出将互补表征作为时间序列推理的一项设计原则。我们的模型结合两种视觉视图：折线图保留绝对测量值和观测坐标系，而归一化延迟嵌入则消除正幅度缩放和偏移，同时呈现时间结构。专用视觉编码器通过视觉词元和多层级特征融合，将两个视图整合到一个共享语言模型中。推理时的干预验证了两个视图具有不同的不变性特征；单视图消融则表明，二者结合的益处尤其体现在基础感知以外的任务上，在预测和推理方面提升显著。我们的双视图模型基于 Qwen3-VL-8B 构建，在 TSRBench 上的总体准确率从仅使用折线图时的 44.5% 提升至 53.2%，显著超过评测中最强的专用 TSLM 基线（36.7%）。此外，该模型在 TSExam 上达到 89.9% 的准确率，在多变量 ChatTS 对齐任务上达到 86.8% 的数值准确率。总之，这些结果表明，互补表征为通用 TSLM 提供了一项有效的设计原则，使模型能够利用时间结构，同时保留对原始测量坐标系的访问。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    KnowGPO groups search trajectories by acquired task-relevant knowledge and uses incremental knowledge gain as process reward, improving long-horizon search through reinforcement learning.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Deep search agents solve knowledge-intensive tasks through long-horizon, multi-turn interactions, where assigning credit to individual search decisions is fundamentally difficult. Outcome-based reinforcement learning provides only a single terminal reward shared across an entire trajectory. Recent process-supervision methods aim to assign credit at finer granularity, but they typically anchor credit to either surface-level trajectory states or model-internal signals, both of which become unreliable in deep search where observations are heterogeneous and retrieved contexts are long and noisy. We propose KnowGPO, a reinforcement learning framework that aligns trajectories by the task-relevant knowledge they have acquired rather than by their surface observations. For each query, KnowGPO decomposes the information required to derive the answer into atomic knowledge conditions, and represents the state of a trajectory at each step by the subset of conditions it has satisfied. Trajectories sharing the same knowledge state are grouped for within-group comparison, and the incremental knowledge gain between consecutive steps serves as an environment-grounded process reward. Experiments on Xbench, BrowseComp-ZH, and GAIA show KnowGPO consistently outperforms outcome-only (GRPO) and process-supervision baselines (GiGPO, IGPO) by 3.8 to 4.2 points, with our 8B model rivaling or exceeding most 32B open-source systems.

    中文

    深度搜索智能体通过长时程、多轮交互解决知识密集型任务，而将功劳归因于单个搜索决策从根本上说十分困难。基于结果的强化学习只为整条轨迹提供一个共享的终端奖励。近期的过程监督方法试图以更细的粒度分配功劳，但它们通常以轨迹的表层状态或模型内部信号作为依据；在深度搜索中，观测异质、检索上下文冗长且嘈杂，这两种依据都会变得不可靠。我们提出 KnowGPO，这是一种强化学习框架，依据轨迹已获得的任务相关知识而非其表层观测来对齐轨迹。对于每个查询，KnowGPO 将推导答案所需的信息分解为原子知识条件，并用每一步已满足的条件子集来表示轨迹状态。共享相同知识状态的轨迹会被分组，以便进行组内比较；相邻步骤之间的增量知识收益则作为基于环境的过程奖励。在 Xbench、BrowseComp-ZH 和 GAIA 上的实验表明，KnowGPO 的表现始终优于仅基于结果的基线（GRPO）和过程监督基线（GiGPO、IGPO）3.8 至 4.2 分；我们的 8B 模型可媲美或超过大多数 32B 开源系统。

    Yihan Xu, Jia-Chen Gu, Junyi Zhang, Di Wu, Haikang Deng, Po-Nien Kung, Kai-Wei Chang, Amit Sahai, Wei Wang, Nanyun Peng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LeanGraphSearch uses multi-hop dependency graphs to retrieve supporting lemmas and improve theorem proving, offering a substantive algorithmic contribution to mathematical reasoning; its use of reusable proof dependencies also gives a partial connection to composition. The abstract does not study model internals or broader system design, so those directions remain low.

    LeanGraphSearch 使用多跳依赖图检索支持性引理并改进定理证明，为数学推理带来实质性的算法贡献；它对可复用证明依赖的运用也与组合能力存在一定联系。摘要没有研究模型内部机制或更广泛的系统设计，因此这些方向的贡献较低。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Retrieving relevant lemmas is crucial for formal theorem proving, enabling provers to build machine-checkable proofs from established mathematical results. Recent retrieval systems match library declarations to a target theorem or its intermediate proof steps, but make limited use of multi-hop dependencies among declarations. These dependencies can reveal supporting lemmas that are not necessarily lexically similar to the target theorem but recur in proofs of related problems. To this end, we propose LeanGraphSearch, a graph-based retrieval method for Lean 4 that constructs a graph from Mathlib's forward dependencies and traverses it to uncover supporting lemmas through multi-hop dependency chains. Specifically, LeanGraphSearch links each declaration to the premises it depends on, uses a graph-based ranking algorithm to propagate relevance from semantically matched declarations to their dependencies, and reranks the expanded candidates against the original query. Across two mathematical retrieval benchmarks, LeanGraphSearch improves recall by up to 12% over the strongest baseline, LeanSearch v2, on MathlibQR and increases coverage of complete annotated proof routes on MathlibMPR, covering up to 3.7% of extra groups. More importantly, we evaluate whether these retrieval gains translate into improved end-to-end theorem proving by integrating LeanGraphSearch into an iterative proving loop guided by Lean feedback. Across three theorem proving benchmarks, LeanGraphSearch improves pass rate at {8, 16, 32} reflection turns by as much as 40% compared to vanilla prover and at most 10% compared to LeanSearch v2, showing higher accuracy-cost efficiency. These findings highlight the value of dependency graph search for theorem proving and motivate further research on structure-aware search for proof discovery.

    中文

    检索相关引理对形式化定理证明至关重要，它使证明器能够根据已有数学结果构建机器可检验的证明。近期的检索系统将库中的声明与目标定理或其中间证明步骤进行匹配，但很少利用声明之间的多跳依赖关系。这些依赖关系能够揭示支持性引理：它们不一定在词汇上与目标定理相似，却会反复出现在相关问题的证明中。为此，我们提出 LeanGraphSearch，这是一种面向 Lean 4 的基于图的检索方法。它根据 Mathlib 的前向依赖构建图，并遍历该图，通过多跳依赖链发现支持性引理。具体来说，LeanGraphSearch 将每个声明链接到它所依赖的前提，使用基于图的排序算法将语义匹配声明的相关性传播到其依赖项，并根据原始查询对扩展后的候选项重新排序。在两个数学检索基准上，LeanGraphSearch 在 MathlibQR 上的召回率比最强基线 LeanSearch v2 最多提高 12%，并提高了 MathlibMPR 上完整标注证明路径的覆盖率，最多多覆盖 3.7% 的组。更重要的是，我们通过将 LeanGraphSearch 集成到由 Lean 反馈引导的迭代证明循环中，评估这些检索提升能否转化为端到端定理证明能力的提升。在三个定理证明基准上，与原版证明器相比，LeanGraphSearch 在 {8, 16, 32} 次反思轮次下的通过率最高提升 40%；与 LeanSearch v2 相比最高提升 10%，体现出更高的准确率与成本效率。这些发现凸显了依赖图搜索对于定理证明的价值，并推动对面向结构的证明发现搜索开展进一步研究。

    How can robots autonomously collect the contact-rich experience needed to learn dexterous manipulation? We present DSP: Dexterity from supervised play, a framework in which a robot learns a play policy from minutes of human play through behavior cloning, then deploys it autonomously to collect hours of interaction data to train a world model. During inference, the same play policy then guides model-predictive control (MPC) by proposing candidate action sequences for evaluation under the learned world model. To accelerate inference, we also introduce a method for distilling a closed-loop, goal-conditioned policy through self-play within the learned world model. We evaluate this framework on underactuated pushing and any-to-any in-hand pose reorientation with a multifingered hand, in simulation and real world. In real world experiment, our method outperforms hindsight behavior cloning by 69.6% in success rate and achieves comparable success to reinforcement learning with 490 times less interaction data. These results demonstrate that supervised play can autonomously collect interaction data, guide model-based planning, and enable policy learning without any task-specific demonstrations or sim-to-real transfer.

Each program is packaged with the source files and associated assets required for execution in its declared environment, along with available descriptions and verification records.     Existing agent benchmarks typically evaluate agents on well-specified tasks defined by issue reports, specifications, or task tickets. Real-world customer delivery is different: forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must clarify ambiguous requirements, work in live systems, and uncover unstated constraints. We introduce FDE-Gym, a benchmark of 95 end-to-end delivery tasks from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors, each adapted by industry experts from real-world delivery projects. In simulated customer environments with scripted stakeholders and modifiable customer systems, agents interact with stakeholders and operate on production-like systems to deliver working solutions. FDE-Gym scores a delivery by how much it improves the customer's own success metric, normalized between 0 (unchanged system) and 1 (reference solution), with penalties for stakeholder interactions (messages, trial runs, and waiting time). An online platform lets humans practice FDE skills under the same grading criteria. We evaluate 13 model configurations from seven providers. In the realistic setting, where unstated constraints must be discovered, the best configuration achieves a mean FDE-Gym score of 0.56 and resolves only 14 of the 95 tasks (a score of at least 0.8 with no incident). Discovering unstated constraints is the primary bottleneck: performance drops sharply when models must uncover them without explicit guidance. Yet information discovery alone does not account for the gap: even on the 23 tasks where the best configuration obtains every key fact from stakeholders, it reaches a normalized business uplift of 0.8 or above on only 10. These results reveal a substantial gap between solving well-specified tasks and delivering effective AI systems for real customers.

    中文

    现有的智能体基准通常评估智能体在明确界定的任务上的表现，这些任务由问题报告、规格说明或任务工单定义。现实世界中的客户交付则有所不同：前线部署工程师（FDE）必须澄清含糊的需求、在运行中的系统里工作，并发现未明说的约束。我们推出 FDE-Gym，这是一个基准，包含来自 18 个行业的 20 种客户场景中的 95 项端到端交付任务，每项任务均由行业专家根据真实世界的交付项目改编而成。在包含脚本化利益相关方和可修改客户系统的模拟客户环境中，智能体与利益相关方互动，并操作类似生产环境的系统，以交付可用的解决方案。FDE-Gym 根据交付对客户自身成功指标的提升幅度进行评分，将分数归一化到 0（系统未改变）至 1（参考解决方案）之间，并对与利益相关方的互动（消息、试运行和等待时间）施加惩罚。在线平台还让人们能够按照相同的评分标准练习 FDE 技能。我们评估了来自七家提供商的 13 种模型配置。在必须发现未明说约束的现实设置中，表现最佳的配置平均 FDE-Gym 得分为 0.56，且在 95 项任务中仅解决了 14 项（得分至少为 0.8 且没有事故）。发现未明说的约束是主要瓶颈：当模型必须在没有明确指导的情况下发现这些约束时，性能会急剧下降。然而，仅靠信息发现并不能解释这一差距：即使在最佳配置从利益相关方处获取了所有关键信息的 23 项任务中，它也只在 10 项任务上实现了 0.8 或以上的归一化业务提升。这些结果揭示了明确界定任务的求解能力与为真实客户交付有效 AI 系统之间存在显著差距。

    OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling

    OmniVerifier-C1：面向规则约束生成式世界建模的分解式分级验证器

    Bowei Liu, Xinchen Zhang, Xuhuan Li, Tianlin Zhang, Kaian Jiang, Jingwei Liu, Congyang Zhao, Yifei Qian, Junhong Liu, Zhiheng Li, Yujiu Yang, Yang Cai, Ling Yang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a decomposed, graded visual verifier and a training strategy that improve generalization to compositional and rule-governed tasks, a substantial contribution to compositional evaluation. Its interpretable outputs and world-modeling context do not establish insight into internal model mechanisms or agent system design; reasoning is present mainly as an evaluated application.

    本文开发了一种分解式分级视觉验证器及相应训练策略，提升了模型在组合性任务和规则约束任务上的泛化能力，是对组合评估的重要贡献。其可解释输出和世界建模背景并未揭示模型内部机制或智能体系统设计；推理主要作为被评估的应用出现。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Generative visual verifiers play a crucial role in advancing multimodal intelligence. To enhance the robustness of visual verifiers in complex multimodal scenarios involving compositional requirements, we move beyond conventional binary verifiers that produce only True/False discrete judgments and introduce a verifier that automatically decomposes complex prompts or environmental rules into fine-grained components and assigns pointwise scores to provide a continuous and more informative critique signal. Our experiments further demonstrate that these structured and interpretable outputs improve the verifier's generalization to out-of-domain multimodal critic tasks. To train this verifier, we introduce a Decoupled RL training strategy that jointly optimizes sub-question-level binary judgment and global alignment scoring, using precise local feedback to develop fine-grained verification capabilities that provide a foundation for reliable continuous scoring at the global level. Under a general reinforcement learning framework, we first empirically demonstrate that the proposed pointwise graded verifier significantly outperforms binary verifiers in traditional text-to-image scenarios. We then extend our investigation to rule-governed generative world modeling where generative models are leveraged for world simulation and world reasoning under explicit rules. From a theoretical standpoint, we further show that a pairwise verification paradigm yields more accurate critiques than the pointwise formulation when ground-truth images are available, with empirical results on diverse structured world-modeling tasks such as Maze and Sudoku further validating the effectiveness of our approach. Overall, our findings suggest a key insight: the transition from generative models to structured world-modeling agents critically hinges on the availability of accurate pairwise graded visual verifiers.

    中文

    生成式视觉验证器在推动多模态智能发展方面发挥着关键作用。为增强视觉验证器在涉及组合要求的复杂多模态场景中的鲁棒性，我们不再局限于仅输出 True/False 离散判断的传统二元验证器，而是引入一种验证器，可自动将复杂提示或环境规则分解为细粒度组成部分，并逐项评分，从而提供连续且信息更丰富的批评信号。我们的实验进一步表明，这些结构化且可解释的输出能提升验证器对分布外多模态评判任务的泛化能力。为训练该验证器，我们引入一种解耦式 RL 训练策略，联合优化子问题层面的二元判断和全局对齐评分，并利用精确的局部反馈来培养细粒度验证能力，为全局层面的可靠连续评分奠定基础。在一个通用强化学习框架下，我们首先通过实验证明，所提出的逐项分级验证器在传统文生图场景中显著优于二元验证器。随后，我们将研究扩展到规则约束的生成式世界建模，其中生成模型被用于在明确规则下进行世界模拟和世界推理。从理论角度看，我们还证明，当存在真实图像时，成对验证范式比逐项验证形式能够给出更准确的批评；在迷宫和数独等多种结构化世界建模任务上的实验结果进一步验证了我们方法的有效性。总体而言，我们的发现揭示了一项关键见解：从生成模型迈向结构化世界建模智能体，关键取决于能否获得准确的成对分级视觉验证器。

    CoDA: Co-Evolution of Data Engines and Action Policies

    CoDA：数据引擎与动作策略的协同进化

    Tianjiao Yu, Zhilin Ou, Yifan Shen, Xinzhuo Li, Yuanzhe Liu, Onkar Kishor Susladkar, Fan Wang, Ismini Lourentzou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CoDA co-evolves a robot policy and simulation data engine using shared memory, critic diagnoses, and staged value-learning supervision, with strong results under distribution shifts. Its main contribution advances agent training and memory-organized systems; reusable generation and training programs and action learning support partial connections to composition and reasoning, while the critic does not reveal model internals.

    CoDA 利用共享记忆、评判器诊断和分阶段价值学习监督，使机器人策略与仿真数据引擎协同进化，并在分布偏移下取得了显著结果。其主要贡献推动了智能体训练和基于记忆组织的系统发展；可复用的生成与训练程序以及动作学习与组合和推理存在部分联系，而评判器并未揭示模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Generative simulation can automate robot environment construction, but physically valid environments are not necessarily useful for training. The challenge is to identify environments that address a policy's failures and supervision that helps it overcome them. We introduce CoDA, a framework in which a simulation data engine and an action policy co-evolve through a shared heterogeneous memory of environment construction, policy failures, and learning progress. The memory compiles validated diagnoses from a vision-language critic into generation programs that recreate difficulties and training programs that help the policy overcome them. We further propose Text2potential to convert these diagnoses into staged potentials for action-chunk value learning, providing dense supervision for policy updates while preserving the task's optimal policy under standard shaping assumptions. Measured learning progress guides further generation and program refinement. Across four manipulation task families, CoDA improves out-of-distribution success from 5.3% after supervised fine-tuning to 27.6%, exceeding the strongest closed-loop baseline by 9.5 percentage points with the same generation budget. On LIBERO-Pro, 15 rounds of generation and training raise success from 25% to 84% under position perturbations and from 1% to 76% under instruction perturbations.

    中文

    生成式仿真可以自动构建机器人环境，但物理上有效的环境未必有助于训练。挑战在于找到能够针对策略失误的环境，以及帮助策略克服这些失误的监督信号。我们提出 CoDA，这一框架让仿真数据引擎与动作策略通过共享的异构记忆协同进化；该记忆涵盖环境构建、策略失误和学习进展。记忆将视觉语言评判器给出的经验证诊断编译为生成程序，用以重现困难情形；同时编译为训练程序，帮助策略克服这些困难。我们进一步提出 Text2potential，将这些诊断转换为用于动作块价值学习的分阶段势函数，在为策略更新提供稠密监督的同时，根据标准塑形假设保留任务的最优策略。测得的学习进展会指导后续生成和程序优化。在四类操作任务中，CoDA 将分布外成功率从监督微调后的 5.3% 提升至 27.6%；在生成预算相同的情况下，其表现比最强的闭环基线高 9.5 个百分点。在 LIBERO-Pro 上，经过 15 轮生成和训练，位置扰动下的成功率从 25% 提升至 84%，指令扰动下则从 1% 提升至 76%。
